The Experience

Design at Qualified is small and intentional. There's no design systems team or research ops function, just close access to the product, fast feedback loops, and problems that rarely have obvious solutions.

Most of those problems are about AI where the interface is rarely the hard part. The challenge is helping users understand what the AI is doing, trust it when it's right, catch it when it's wrong, and shape it toward what they actually need. That takes judgment more than process.

We're building Piper, an AI SDR that runs autonomous sales conversations, follows up with prospects, and moves pipeline without a human in the loop. Piper is not a chatbot and not a copilot. Piper is an agent. You will work on two of its most interesting surfaces: the AI brain (how Piper understands prospects and explains its reasoning) and conversational presence (the live chat and video experience where the AI is the rep).

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • The first surface is Piper's brain: how Piper understands a lead, forms a plan, and explains its reasoning. You'll design the interface for shaping its personality, goals, and objection handling. Not a settings panel. Something closer to a thinking partner you can tune.
  • The second is Piper's live presence, the chat and video experience where the AI is the rep. The work is in the details: the micro-interactions, latency handling, turn-taking, and tone that make it feel credible instead of uncanny.
  • The design patterns for autonomous agents in enterprise sales are still being figured out. You'll be part of that.

You're Our Person If...

  • 6+ years of product design, with at least 2 years on AI or conversational experiences
  • You understand LLM behavior (latency, streaming, confidence, failure modes) and design for it honestly
  • Fluent in AI tooling as a core part of how you work, not an experiment
  • Strong visual and interaction craft. You have taste.
  • Comfortable without a detailed brief. You define the problem alongside the solution.
  • Works directly with eng and ML. No handoff culture here.

Even Better If...

  • Voice, video, or real-time communication design background
  • Familiarity with enterprise sales or CRM workflows
  • Experience designing multi-step autonomous workflows


How you work

Taste over process. Prototypes over presentations. Speed is a quality, judgment is the craft. You think of yourself as a creative director of AI collaborators, not a solo craftsperson. Concretely:

  • You prototype in code or with AI tools, not just Figma
  • You're faster with agents than most designers are without them
  • You ship design decisions, not just document them

The design patterns for AI agents in enterprise sales are still being established. You'd be one of a few people defining them at production scale, on a product that's already live and growing.

Ownership here is genuine. You'll work directly with leadership, influence product direction, and own your work from problem definition through ship. No gatekeeping, no waiting for a brief.

The Salesforce acquisition puts our work in front of one of the largest enterprise customer bases on the planet. It is important that the team remains nimble and autonomous to keep innovation moving.

You are a builder of trust—with customers, with delivery teams, and with internal partners. You bring credibility through proximity to the work, and you help teams navigate the unique demands of a Public Sector, cleared environment.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Delivery Governance: Own and manage the day-to-day delivery health of assigned engagements, ensuring strict adherence to Salesforce Professional Services Methodology (SPSM) standards, project gates, and outcome-based delivery practices.
  • Project Planning & Control: Create, lead, and review project plans; monitor timelines and dependencies; adjust schedules and plans as needed; track utilization of resources against prioritization and budget.
  • Program & Project Scope: Lead one or two large enterprise projects or multiple small-to-medium interrelated projects requiring complex multi-functional collaboration at the program level.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Monitor project health signals (RYG/PSA Pulses) to proactively identify, track, and resolve project risks before they become issues.
  • Project Recovery: Lead or support project recovery efforts on at-risk engagements; partner with the PDL on escalations that require additional oversight.
  • Methodology & Execution: Adopt a standardized development lifecycle methodology across engagements; oversee end-to-end implementation planning, issue management, risk tracking, and organizational change.
  • Primary Interface: Serve as the primary delivery relationship owner and interface for customer stakeholders at the program management, operational, and executive levels—building trust through consistent communication, transparency, and follow-through.
  • Advisory & Strategy: Establish and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders by providing vision, future product roadmapping, and driving business process improvements.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate client review sessions, requirement-gathering workshops, and status meetings.
  • Escalation & Alignment: Lead difficult conversations regarding scope, budget, timelines, and resourcing; formally document and communicate outcomes while resolving partner concerns.
  • Value Realization: Contribute to value realization conversations by helping customers connect delivery progress to mission outcomes and KPIs.
  • Technical Alignment: Facilitate and guide the creation of technical design documents for complex projects by collaborating directly with Technical Architects and Developers.
  • Quality & Deliverables: Responsible for all project deliverables, reviewing work products prepared by the team prior to submission to the client.
  • Testing & UAT: As necessary, write and review QA and UAT test scripts; coordinate and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with end users to secure formal sign-offs.
  • Technology Adoption: Identify opportunities to demonstrate and leverage the full range of Salesforce technologies (e.g., Agentforce).
  • GTM & Sales Alignment: Partner closely with the PDL on sales-to-delivery handoffs to ensure scoped commitments are honored in execution.
  • Pre-Sales Collaboration: Collaborate with Solution Consulting, Technical Consulting, and Services Sales partners to support pre-sales engagements, LOE reviews, and pursuit activities.

  • Practice Enablement: Contribute to internal practice-building efforts, enablement initiatives, and delivery standards.


You're Our Person If...

  • Project Execution: Demonstrated leadership running project teams, budgeting, scheduling, and negotiating contract commitments.
  • Salesforce Knowledge: Solid knowledge of the Salesforce product suite and implementation experience across Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery frameworks.

descriptionHtml:

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience
 
  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures — and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.


What You'll Actually Be Building
 
  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.


You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…
 
  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through — ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.


Nice-to-Haves
 
  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
  • Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

 À propos du poste

Expérience en production requise. Mentalité Builder non négociable.

Salesforce recrute des Forward Deployed Engineers — des Technical Builders expérimentés qui conçoivent, développent et déploient des solutions d'IA agentique directement dans les environnements clients en entreprise. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe de delivery, en étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder — un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et pilote l'adoption) pour co-construire des solutions mises en production dès le premier jour. Les missions vont d'un grand compte stratégique unique à plusieurs comptes simultanés. Le fil conducteur : du vrai code, de vrais environnements, et un impact business mesurable. Ce travail couvre la configuration, la personnalisation et le déploiement full-stack — en livrant des solutions dont les clients dépendent.

L'expérience Builder
 
  • Développement assisté par l'IA : Livrez de vraies solutions clients, avec les meilleurs outils IA du marché — Cursor, Claude, et les produits Salesforce comme Vibes — intégrés à votre quotidien.
  • Delivery collaboratif : Vous travaillerez aux côtés de Senior Forward Deployed Engineers et d'un Deployment Strategist. Vous serez responsable de composants concrets, bénéficierez d'un mentorat structuré de personnes ayant déjà livré des systèmes agentiques à grande échelle, avec une trajectoire claire vers la conduite de projets complexes.
  • Accès à la frontière technologique : Notre plateforme d'IA agentique évolue en temps réel. Vous travaillerez sur des capacités que la plupart des ingénieurs n'aborderont pas avant des mois — couvrant Agentforce, la data, la plateforme et les architectures headless — et vos insights terrain alimenteront directement les équipes produit qui les développent.
  • Innovation continue : Vous devrez rester à la pointe, en expérimentant de nouveaux outils IA, modèles et frameworks, et en partageant vos apprentissages avec votre équipe et vos clients.


Ce que vous allez concrètement construire
 
  • Développer des agents IA et des expériences qui réalisent de vraies actions pour de vraies organisations. Nos solutions sont en production chez certaines des plus grandes entreprises mondiales. Ce travail a du sens parce que les clients en dépendent.
  • Concevoir l'intelligence des agents : prompts, raisonnement, appels d'outils et intégration avec les systèmes clients, en s'appuyant sur notre plateforme d'IA agentique et les techniques LLM actuelles.
  • Prendre en charge des composants techniques de bout en bout : du choix d'architecture jusqu'au déploiement, validé et observable en production.
  • Construire et intégrer des pipelines de données sur Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks et les plateformes de données clients. Modéliser la donnée, livrer le pipeline, valider les outputs.
  • Développer et maintenir des dashboards de performance des agents et des reportings KPI clients pour suivre la santé des déploiements et les résultats business.
  • Contribuer à des preuves de concept et des MVP qui passent de l'esquisse au déployable en jours, pas en mois.
  • Co-construire aux côtés des clients et partenaires, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en les montant en compétences au fil des missions. Laisser les équipes plus capables après chaque engagement qu'avant.
  • Remonter les lacunes de la plateforme, cas limites et insights terrain aux ingénieurs seniors et à l'équipe produit. Votre expérience terrain est la boucle de feedback produit.
  • Travailler en binôme avec le Deployment Strategist de votre pod pour traduire les enjeux business clients en solutions agentiques qui livrent vraiment.


Vous êtes notre Forward Deployed Engineer si…
 
  • Vous avez 3+ ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou en delivery technique, avec au moins un système en production dont vous seriez fier de nous parler — idéalement dans une stack IA, du développement full-stack, ou avec des modèles frontier.
  • Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme en Informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Vous avez une expérience préalable en delivery technique orienté client (conseil, services professionnels ou forward deployed engineering) — c'est une exigence, pas un bonus.
  • Vous maîtrisez au moins un langage parmi Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java ou Apex — et êtes prêt à en ajouter d'autres selon les besoins.
  • Vous avez une expérience pratique des LLMs et du prompt engineering. Vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi un prompt a échoué et ce que vous changeriez.
  • Vous comprenez la modélisation de données, les APIs et les patterns d'intégration suffisamment en profondeur pour les concevoir, pas seulement les consommer.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans une salle avec des équipes commerciales et des architectes clients.
  • Vous livrez du code de qualité et évaluez les outputs IA avec la rigueur d'un ingénieur.
  • Vous explorez activement le paysage IA/data en évolution — en testant de nouveaux outils, en expérimentant de nouveaux modèles, et en restant sincèrement curieux de ce qui arrive.
  • Vous vous épanouissez dans le groupe de travail qui construit quelque chose, pas seulement qui en parle.
  • Vous êtes enthousiaste à l'idée de voyager ~25% du temps pour travailler directement aux côtés des clients.

  • Familiarité avec les frameworks d'agents (LangChain, LlamaIndex) et les patterns d'orchestration

title: Principal, Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role
Technical depth required. Architectural judgment expected.
Salesforce is hiring Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — the Technical Builders, responsible for deciding that leads who design, build, and deploy the most complex agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll lead technical delivery on your team, mentor the next wave of engineers, and set the engineering standards that define how agentic AI gets deployed at scale. Partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption), you'll own outcomes end-to-end, from architecture decision to production. Your passion for well-crafted software that solves real problems will be supported by best-in-class AI tools and a team of talented builders around you.

The Senior Builder Experience
  • Technical Ownership: Partner with a Deployment Strategist to own customer outcomes end-to-end. You're the senior technical authority in the room, ensuring deliverables meet the  highest engineering  standards, whether it was generated by an AI tool by a colleague or written by you directly.
  • AI-Supported  Engineering: Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes are embedded in your  daily workflow. The conventions and patterns you develop tend to propagate through the team because other Builders look to your work as reference.
  • Roadmap Influence: Your field experience routes directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps you hit and the edge cases you encounter in real life customer environments become the features they ship. Senior Forward Deployed Engineers are the most credible voice in agentic AIproduct evolution.
  • Continuous Innovation: You're expected to stay at the forefront — piloting emerging AI tools, experimenting with new models and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building
  • Own end-to-end build and deployment of agentic AI solutions for Salesforce's most strategic customers — from architecture decisions through production handoff.
  • Design and ship agentic systems on the Agentforce platform: agent logic, tool calls, multi-agent orchestration, deterministic guardrails, and the integration patterns that hold up in enterprise environments. Your reference implementations become the basis for how other Builders approach similar problems.
  • Own the data lifecycle: model design, processing pipelines, and data readiness for AI applications across Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer-specific platforms.
  • Resolve the technical blockers that other engineers can't — data integration failures, model deployment issues, orchestration breakdowns, performance regressions. These problems are routed to you because of your track record of solving them.
  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes across engagements.
  • Develop proofs-of-concept and MVPs quickly, with the judgment to know which decisions can be deferred and which need to be right the first time.
  • Codify what you learn. The patterns, reusable assets, and internal frameworks that come out of your real customer work become the playbooks the rest of the org draws from.
  • Mentor other Engineers through code reviews, pair sessions, and shared work. Most of your influence on developing engineers happens inside the same codebases you're building in.
  • Provide technical depth on at-risk or strategically critical deployments when senior engineering judgment is needed.
  • Surface field insights directly to Product and Engineering. The gaps and edge cases you encounter in real customer environments are some of the most valuable inputs to the Agentforce roadmap.
  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist on your team to translate complex customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Senior Forward Deployed Engineer If…
  • You have 6+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with proven end-to-end ownership of scalable production systems in enterprise AI, cloud, or SaaS environments.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • You're an expert in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex, and conversant in the others.
  • You've integrated LLMs into production, used frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and applied prompt engineering and responsible AI practices in real customer contexts.
  • You have deep experience in data modeling, processing, and analytics, with demonstrable proficiency across platforms like Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, or Databricks.
  • You bring deep Salesforce platform expertise: Agentforce, Apex, LWC, Flows, and Salesforce APIs.
  • You have an entrepreneurial, get-things-done mindset focused on fast, impactful delivery — and the judgment to know when "fast" is the wrong call.
  • You've mentored technical talent and created reusable assets — frameworks, playbooks, internal tooling.
  • You communicate clearly and credibly with engineering peers, customer architects, and executive stakeholders.
  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.
  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, embedded with customer engineers.
Nice-to-Haves
  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Agentforce Specialist, System Architect)
  • Familiarity with DevOps/CI-CD practices, observability tooling, or data governance frameworks
  • Experience architecting multi-cloud, multi-system enterprise AI solutions for Global 500 customers
  • Track record of influencing enterprise software product roadmaps through field engineering insight
  • Open-source contributions, published technical writing, or conference presentations

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

À propos du rôle
Profondeur technique requise. Jugement architectural attendu.

Salesforce recrute des Senior Forward Deployed Engineers — les Bâtisseurs Techniques, responsables des décisions qui conduisent à la conception, au développement et au déploiement des solutions d'IA agentique les plus complexes directement dans les environnements clients entreprise. En étroite collaboration avec un Deployment Strategist (Bâtisseur Stratégique - un conseiller orienté client qui façonne la stratégie IA et favorise l'adoption), vous assumerez les résultats de bout en bout, de la décision d'architecture à la mise en production. Votre passion pour des logiciels bien conçus qui résolvent de vrais problèmes sera soutenue par des outils IA de premier plan et une équipe de bâtisseurs talentueux à vos côtés.

Vous êtes l'autorité technique senior dans la salle, veillant à ce que les livrables répondent aux plus hauts standards d'ingénierie, qu'ils aient été générés par un outil IA, par un collègue ou écrits directement par vous.
  • Ingénierie assistée par l'IA : Cursor, Claude et les produits de codage Salesforce comme Vibes sont intégrés dans votre flux de travail quotidien. Les conventions et patterns que vous développez ont tendance à se propager dans l'équipe, car les autres Bâtisseurs prennent votre travail comme référence.

Les Senior Forward Deployed Engineers sont la voix la plus crédible dans l'évolution des produits d'IA agentique.
  • Innovation continue : Vous êtes attendu·e à la pointe — en testant les outils IA émergents, en expérimentant de nouveaux modèles et frameworks, et en partageant ce que vous apprenez avec votre équipe et vos clients.

  • Prendre en charge le développement et le déploiement de bout en bout de solutions d'IA agentique pour les clients les plus stratégiques de Salesforce — des décisions d'architecture à la passation en production.
  • Concevoir et livrer des systèmes agentiques sur la plateforme Agentforce : logique d'agent, appels d'outils, orchestration multi-agents, garde-fous déterministes et patterns d'intégration robustes en environnements entreprise. Vos implémentations de référence deviennent la base sur laquelle les autres Bâtisseurs s'appuient pour aborder des problèmes similaires.
  • Gérer le cycle de vie des données : conception des modèles, pipelines de traitement et préparation des données pour les applications IA sur Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks et les plateformes spécifiques aux clients.
  • Résoudre les blocages techniques que les autres ingénieurs ne peuvent pas débloquer — échecs d'intégration de données, problèmes de déploiement de modèles, pannes d'orchestration, régressions de performance. Ces problèmes vous sont confiés en raison de votre historique de résolution.
  • Créer et maintenir des tableaux de bord de performance des agents et des reportings KPI clients pour suivre la santé des déploiements et les résultats business sur l'ensemble des engagements.
  • Développer des preuves de concept et des MVPs rapidement, avec le discernement nécessaire pour savoir quelles décisions peuvent être différées et lesquelles doivent être correctes dès le premier essai.

Customer impact from day one. Strategic clarity and Execution that sticks.

Salesforce is hiring Deployment Strategists — Strategic Builders who are customer-facing advisors, who define AI strategy, shape agentic solutions, and drive measurable adoption for enterprise customers. You'll work as part of a delivery team alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, translating complex business challenges into agentic AI deployments that go live and generate real value. Engagements are focused and time-bound — typically 12 weeks or less — and may span a single strategic account or multiple customers simultaneously. Your impact isn't just getting to deployment. It ensures customers realise lasting, scalable value from the solutions your team builds.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure

  • AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.

  • Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization

  • Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.

  • AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including

  • Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development. 

  • Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.

  • AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents

  • Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.

  • 4+ years experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

  • Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have

  • Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud

  • Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex

  • Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes

  • Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices

  • Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments

  • Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites

テクニカルアーキテクト（TA）は、プロフェッショナルサービス本部のファンクショナル・アーキテクト本部に所属するシニアレベルのポジションです。このポジションでは、Tableauをメインとしたデータ・アナリティクスソリューションを担当します。Tableauのミッションを理解し、Tableau Blueprint戦略に基づき、Tableau製品の専門知識、コンサルティング経験、データ分析知識、等を駆使し、お客様組織内のデータドリブンな文化の醸成を支援します。テクニカルアーキテクトとして、データ分析のプラットフォーム環境の構築、環境移行プロセスの設計、ユーザーセキュリティーガバナンスやデータガバナンスの設計を行い信頼されたデータ・ソースへのアクセスを実現します。データパイプラインにおける、データエンジニアリング、データ整備の分野を中心にお客様のデータ利活用、データドリブン文化の情勢の実現に貢献します。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Tableau製品のエキスパートになる - サーバ製品とクライアントソリューションへの統合について深く理解し、デスクトップ/フロントエンド製品については一般的な理解が必要です。
  • サーバ製品、クラウド製品の導入を支援しデータ分析のプラットフォーム環境の構築を実施する。
  • オンプレミスからクラウドへの環境移行の支援を実施する。
  • Tableauの専門家としてアドバイザリーサービスを提供するためにお客様先でのオンサイト対応を実施する。
  • データ分析を始める上での、ダッシュボードの開発支援、設計構築、パフォーマンスチューニング、データ準備技術支援を行う。
  • プラットフォーム環境構築や移行プロセス構築のための計画書、設計書、パラメータシート、テスト仕様書を作成する。
  • サービスデリバリー文書テンプレート（カスタムスクリプトやコーディングを含む）のライブラリの作成と管理
  • プリセールス活動に対して、営業担当者を支援し、お客様要件に対するフィージビリティチェックやSOW作成のための技術的なガイダンスを実施する。
  • Tableau Blueprintを理解しお客様環境をアセスメントして、データドリブンカルチャーを醸造するためのアクティビティと評価軸を定義するワークショップを実施する。
  • 戦略的アカウントにおけるお客様関係の維持
  • 他のコンサルタントのメンターやコーチとしての役割
  • 電話、電子メール、対面、Webミーティングを通じたお客様とのコミュニケーションを実施する。


You're Our Person If...

  • エンタープライズ向けソフトウェアデプロイメントのデリバリー経験(要件定義/設計/実装/)
  • サーバーソフトウェアの知識、デリバリー経験
  • サーバOS (Windows, Linux)の知識OSインストールやパラメータ調整経験あれば尚可
  • サーバーソフトウェアのインストール〜動作確認の経験仮想/物理サーバは不問作業手順書や報告書の作成経験Webサーバやアプリケーションサーバ、エンタープライズ向けサービスであれば尚可
  • サーバーサイジングの経験想定用途に対し十分なCPUコア数・メモリ容量・ストレージ容量の見積もり
  • AWS・Azure・GCPいずれかのPaaS管理操作の経験仮想サーバ上でソフトウェアインストール経験あれば尚可VMWareなど仮想サーバ/端末の管理経験
  • ネットワークの知識Proxyの概念と設定経験ロードバランサーの概念と設定
  • 認証・セキュリティSSOプラットフォームとの連携方法の知識SSLサーバー証明書と通信暗号化の知識
  • アーキテクトとしてシステム全体のアーキテクチャ設計をリードした経験
  • プログラミングや性能改善等の技術的な作業を自らがクイックに行えるハンズオンスキル

  • 顧客とのコミュニケーション、ファシリテーション能力
  • 新しい技術や製品を学習する能力、強い探究心
  • チームで仕事をする能力
  • 英語によるコミュニケーション


Even Better If...

  • Masterレベルの学位
  • TableauやBIツールの知識
  • アナリティクス技術とソフトウェアデプロイメントの経験8年以上
  • システムインテグレーション、シングルサインオン、大量データ処理、モバイル開発、アジャイル開発プロセス、DevOps等の専門的な知識
  • 様々なデータ統合と可視化のベストプラクティスに関する深い知識
  • データリテラシーとデータ活用を促進するためのTableau Blueprintの実装の経験
  • 統計、R、Python、SQL、カスタムスクリプトを含む高度なアナリティクスとテクニカルスキル
  • 大規模プロジェクトのマネジメント経験


この職務を通してのバリュー

  • TAは様々な業界のお客様と複雑で難易度の高いプロジェクトの最前線で支援活動を実施します。その活動を通じ、Tableauを含めたシステム全体での最適なアーキテクチャ・ソリューションを提供することで、お客様のビジネスおよびデジタルトランスフォーメーションを成功に導く経験を得られます。
  • TAは業務の遂行において、グローバルの知見・ナレッジに容易にアクセスすることが可能で、製品開発チームやトップレベルのアーキテクトの同僚と協働することで、一流のTableauおよびクラウドアーキテクトとして成長することができます。
  • またTAはTableau外部のオンプレミスシステムやクラウドサービス(IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, IDaaS等）とのシステム統合にも責任を持つため、Tableau以外のプロジェクト経験やテクニカルスキルを活用することができ、オープンでベンダーに依存しない最新のテクノロジー・標準仕様やクラウドアーキテクチャについても習得することができます。

The Experience
The Technical Architect (TA) is a senior-level position within the Functional Architect division of Professional Services. In this role, you will be responsible for data and analytics solutions centered on Tableau. Understanding Tableau's mission and drawing on the Tableau Blueprint strategy, you will apply your Tableau product expertise, consulting experience, and data analytics knowledge to help customers build a data-driven culture within their organizations. As a Technical Architect, you will build data analytics platform environments, design environment migration processes, and design user security governance and data governance to enable access to trusted data sources. Focusing on data engineering and data preparation in the data pipeline, you will contribute to customers' use of data and the realization of a data-driven culture.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Become a Tableau product expert: develop a deep understanding of the server products and their integration with client solutions, and a general understanding of the desktop/front-end products.
  • Support the deployment of server and cloud products and build the data analytics platform environment.
  • Support environment migration from on-premises to the cloud.
  • Work onsite at customer locations to provide advisory services as a Tableau expert.
  • Provide dashboard development support, design and build, performance tuning, and data preparation technical support for getting started with data analytics.
  • Create plans, design documents, parameter sheets, and test specifications for platform environment build and migration processes.
  • Create and manage a library of service delivery document templates (including custom scripts and code).
  • Support sales representatives in pre-sales activities by providing technical guidance for feasibility checks against customer requirements and SOW creation.
  • Understand Tableau Blueprint, assess customer environments, and run workshops that define the activities and evaluation criteria for fostering a data-driven culture.
  • Maintain customer relationships in strategic accounts.
  • Serve as a mentor and coach to other consultants.
  • Communicate with customers by phone, email, in person, and web meetings.


You're Our Person If...

  • Delivery experience in enterprise software deployment (requirements definition / design / implementation)
  • Knowledge of and delivery experience with server software
  • Knowledge of server OS (Windows, Linux)Experience with OS installation and parameter tuning is a plus
  • Experience from server software installation through operation verificationVirtual or physical servers both acceptableExperience creating work procedures and reportsWeb server, application server, or enterprise services experience is a plus
  • Experience with server sizingEstimating sufficient CPU cores, memory, and storage for the intended use
  • Experience with PaaS management operations on any of AWS, Azure, or GCPExperience installing software on virtual servers is a plusExperience managing virtual servers/endpoints such as VMware
  • Networking knowledgeConcepts and configuration experience for proxiesConcepts and configuration of load balancers
  • Authentication and securityKnowledge of integrating with SSO platformsKnowledge of SSL server certificates and communication encryption
  • Experience leading overall system architecture design as an architect
  • Hands-on skills to quickly carry out technical work such as programming and performance improvement yourself
  • Ability to work proactively and to lead complex projects with ownership
  • Consulting skills such as logical thinking and problem solving
  • Customer communication and facilitation skills
  • Ability to learn new technologies and products, with strong curiosity
  • Ability to work in a team
  • Communication in English


Even Better If...

  • Master's-level degree
  • Knowledge of Tableau and BI tools
  • 8+ years of experience in analytics technologies and software deployment
  • Specialized knowledge of system integration, single sign-on, large-scale data processing, mobile development, agile development processes, DevOps, etc.
  • Deep knowledge of best practices for various data integration and visualization approaches
  • Experience implementing Tableau Blueprint to promote data literacy and data utilization
  • Advanced analytics and technical skills including statistics, R, Python, SQL, and custom scripting
  • Experience managing large-scale projects


Value of This Role

  • TAs support customers across industries at the front line of complex, challenging projects. Through this work, you gain experience guiding customers' business and digital transformation to success by delivering the optimal architecture and solutions across the whole system, including Tableau.
  • In your work, you have easy access to global insight and knowledge, and by collaborating with the product development team and top-level architect colleagues, you can grow into a first-class Tableau and cloud architect.
  • TAs are also responsible for integration with on-premises systems and cloud services outside Tableau (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, IDaaS, etc.), so you can draw on non-Tableau project experience and technical skills, and learn open, vendor-neutral, modern technologies, standards, and cloud architecture.

Job Summary

While experience with the Salesforce platform is a plus, a proven track record in fullstack and integration development with expertise in modern web technologies is paramount. You will be expected to lead by example, mentor junior engineers, and contribute significantly to architectural decisions and best practices.


Responsibilities

  •  Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality, scalable, and secure fullstack applications.
  • Onboarding new customers by integrating their data sources with internal platforms.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, performing root cause analysis and implementing preventative measures.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our architectural patterns, tools, and processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and growth.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating and recommending new tools and frameworks.

  • 6+ years of experience in software development, with at least 4 years in a fullstack role.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce Configuration and Security, including managing permission sets, external credentials, and field-level security.
  • Experience with Application and Flow Management, including Salesforce 360 application management, flow integration, and utilizing custom actions within flows.
  • Proven experience configuring and troubleshooting complex API authentication mechanisms, with a strong emphasis on OAuth 2.0 and Bearer token authorization flows.
  • Experience designing dynamic API calls that utilize parameterized query parameters based on upstream workflow data
  • Strong expertise in back-end development with languages such as Java (Spring Boot), Python (Django), Node.js)
  • Familiarity with Slack APIs and integration patterns.Hands-on experience building custom REST API integrations with major enterprise systems such as Snowflake, Workday etc.
  • Experience with integration platforms such as MuleSoft, including designing and building APIs, connectors, or middleware for enterprise integrations.
  • Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud platforms (Heroku, AWS, GCP).
  • Capability to manage Salesforce deployment processes, including familiarity with deployment pipelines (such as Salesforce CLI/DX) and version control using repositories (Git).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (Git), and agile development methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and propose effective solutions.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the Salesforce platform development (Apex, Visualforce, Agentforce, Lightning Components, SOQL/SOSL).
  • Familiarity with Salesforce APIs and integration patterns.
  • Proficiency in modern front-end frameworks (e.g., LWC, React, Angular, Vue.js) and associated technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Hands-on experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (Anypoint Studio, API Manager, Runtime Manager, CloudHub)

Convincing established enterprise partners to commit their core products, services and revenue streams to a nascent marketplace is an exceptionally difficult, deeply sophisticated sales pitch. This role is not a traditional partner management function; it is a senior, strategic co-selling position.

Furthermore, as the GTM App evolves, this individual will architect a brand-new commercial capability for Salesforce: building the end-to-end framework that allows partners to list and transact their entire solutions—comprising both software products and attached professional/managed services—directly with customers.   • Elite Partner Overlay: Act as the specialized marketplace execution expert, stepping into high-stakes, complex partner engagements alongside the AgentExchange GTM Transformation team to deliver the marketplace value proposition and secure structural commitments.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Experience

Design, build, and maintain the backend services, APIs, data-platform automation, and AI platform / agent systems behind our data products. This is a backend-heavy role: distributed Python services, streaming. LLM/agent runtimes on AWS, RAG pipelines, and the dbt/Airflow automation that powers a Snowflake-based lakehouse.

You will work inside the Developer Experience team, whose mandate is to build the tooling, “paved paths,” and automation that let internal data teams ship discoverable, governed, and consumable data products quickly and safely.

About the platform you’ll work on

  • Lakehouse & warehouse — Snowflake with Apache Iceberg tables in a medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold → Semantic Views).
  • Transformation — dbt (Cloud on Fusion) with data contracts, tag-driven governance, and automated project-evaluation checks.
  • Orchestration — Airflow on AWS MWAA; DAGs and schedules authored and deployed through platform tooling and CI (metadata driven).
  • Developer tooling — an internal CLI and reusable utilities (dbt, Iceberg operations, Snowflake load, REST API based ingestions, etc.) that abstract the platform for data teams.
  • Data quality & governance — Monte Carlo for data observability (monitors as code) and centralized governance (tagging, lineage, PII classification, cataloging).
  • AI layer — Agent/MCP/Skill deployment framework, RAG, semantic router / broker agents, over our data products and catalog metadata; conversational agents in Slack; model access via AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, centralized LLM Gateway, and Snowflake Cortex.
  • Cloud & delivery — AWS (ECS Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, etc.), Terraform IaC, GitHub Actions CI/CD, containerized builds, structured logging, metrics, and tracing.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Backend servicesDesign, build, and maintain backend services in Python / Go to support our Data Platform Services — Agent runtimes on AWS Bedrock AgentCore / ECS Fargate, and event-driven Lambda handlers for our AI Platform ServicesDesign and maintain our abstraction layers for for our data domain customers via custom developed utilitiesMaintain and service our infrastructure using IaC (Terraform) for our AWS accounts
  • AI / agentsBuild RAG pipelines and tool-calling AI agents for our data products: retrieval, orchestration, grounding/citations, and evaluation.Integrate model providers with our LLM Gateway with response streaming, prompt caching, and structured outputs in an auditable way (OTeL)Stand up eval harnesses, guardrails, and tracing so agent quality, latency, and cost are measurable and regressions are caught before release.
  • Data-platform automationBuild and maintain data-platform automation: dbt services, MWAA/Airflow orchestration, and tooling that makes data products discoverable, governed, and consumable.Extend the platform CLI and shared utilities that data teams use as their day-to-day interface to the platform.
  • Identity & securityImplement auth and identity: OAuth/OIDC flows (per-user 3LO, token vaulting, session binding), least-privilege IAM, and secrets management.Enforce multi-tenant isolation and per-user identity/RBAC across services and agents.
  • Reliability & deliveryOwn service reliability and delivery: Terraform, GitHub Actions CI/CD, container builds, structured logging, metrics/tracing, alerting, and cost controls.Set technical direction: system and API design, code review, and mentoring.

The Experience

The Authentication Platform team owns the core identity services for Salesforce's production infrastructure — the Production IAM stack. The portfolio spans Kerberos-based authentication, TOTP, and FIDO2/WebAuthn, bridging legacy infrastructure protocols and modern cloud-native identity standards. Because the platform is a tier-0 dependency for the entire company, we run at massive throughput with a 4+ nines availability target across Public Cloud (AWS/GCP) and hybrid deployments on Kubernetes, with modern CI/CD. Our security posture is Zero Trust and least-privilege by default, and we partner closely with security architects on identity verification and credential-handling design.

You'll work on services in the Production IAM stack as an individual contributor — implementing features across the Kerberos, TOTP, and FIDO2/WebAuthn service portfolio, contributing to designs that senior engineers lead, and taking on-call for a tier-0 platform. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on strong execution, growing technical depth in identity protocols, and shipping high-quality, well-tested code in a security-critical environment.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Deliver features across the Authentication Platform's service portfolio - Kerberos, TOTP, FIDO2/WebAuthn - writing clean, well-tested backend code in Java, Go, or C#.
  • Contribute to design specs and research spikes for features in your area, alongside more senior engineers who lead the design.
  • Implement identity and federation protocols used by the platform, including Kerberos, LDAP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, and TOTP. Familiarity with SAML/OIDC is useful for interop conversations with adjacent teams.
  • Partner with the Product Owner and tech lead on story-level scope, sequencing, and dependencies for your own work, and help refine and clarify work items before they land in a sprint.
  • Reliably deliver as a developer, reviewer, and tester — high test coverage, clean code, and reviews that catch issues before they land, with a security-first mindset appropriate for tier-0 services.
  • Apply Salesforce engineering best practices to code, tests, and CI/CD pipelines. Leave code in better shape than you found it.
  • Use AI development tools (e.g.Claude Code) in your day-to-day workflow, and critically evaluate both human and AI-generated code for correctness, performance, and security compliance.
  • Analyze and fix bugs in your area, working with more senior engineers on the complex ones. Debug production issues and drive them to a fix.
  • Exhibit ownership beyond just coding your features — an active role in testing, review, and monitoring is part of the job, especially given the tier-0 nature of the platform.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for the Authentication Platform and handle common alerts confidently. On-call is a real, high-visibility part of this role because of the platform's tier-0 status.
  • Understand the platform's telemetry — metrics, logs, traces, SLIs — and extend it for the features you own. The availability target is 4+ nines.
  • Contribute to Root Cause Analyses for incidents in your area, and follow through on assigned action items.
  • Work with internal stakeholders — service teams and infrastructure owners who depend on the Authentication Platform — to answer integration questions about the features you own.
  • Author and maintain technical documentation and runbooks for your work.



You're Our Person If...

  • Strong programming ability in Java, Go, or C#, with production experience building backend services.
  • Working knowledge of at least one identity or federation protocol from this set: Kerberos, LDAP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, TOTP, SAML, OIDC. Deeper experience in one or more is a plus.
  • Experience building, deploying, and debugging distributed services in a Public Cloud environment (AWS or GCP) or a hybrid deployment, using Kubernetes and modern CI/CD.
  • Solid grasp of software fundamentals: data structures, testing, code review, source control, CI/CD, and Agile execution as a team member.
  • A security-first mindset — writing code with least-privilege defaults, threat-aware reviews, and thorough automated testing appropriate for identity-critical systems.
  • Ability to debug production issues in a distributed system using logs, metrics, and traces.
  • Comfortable executing an agreed-upon plan largely independently, escalating design-level and cross-cutting decisions to senior engineers.



Even Better If...

  • IAM specialist depth — familiarity with the internals of one or more of Kerberos, LDAP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, TOTP, and the interop story with SAML/OIDC.
  • Security hardening — familiarity with HSMs, PKI, and secure credential storage patterns.
  • Compliance and auditing — exposure to controls and evidence requirements under PCI, SOC 2, or HIPAA.
  • Operational grit — experience on-call for a high-visibility production service, and comfort debugging live incidents under pressure.
  • Experience integrating AI development tools into engineering workflows, including prompt design and reviewing AI-generated code for security-critical systems.



Education

  • Master's degree (or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or a related field. A Bachelor's degree (or foreign equivalent) is acceptable with additional years of experience.

The Experience
The Messaging Platform team is at the heart of how Salesforce connects with millions of customers and prospects today. We're building an intelligent, agentic platform that powers and prioritizes 1:1 messaging at global scale for Salesforce's own Marketing team. As the internal "customer zero," we partner closely with marketing, core products, and data teams to deliver always-on, always-optimizing communications that drive growth, engagement, and trust. Our charter includes replatforming, enabling advanced targeting and personalization, and streamlining content orchestration across channels — not only laying the foundation for the next generation of messaging experiences, but building them.

The key focus for this role is to lead the design and launch of a new Campaign Brief Agent an AI-powered agent that transforms how marketers initiate and plan campaigns. This agent's core job is to produce the campaign design brief and bill of materials (BOM) defining audience, content, and journey requirements which serves as the structured input to a downstream orchestration layer that delegates to specialized agents. These agents will help transform our marketing team from hands-off keyboard to hands-on, enabling them to design, build, and launch highly engaging and targeted campaigns driving pipeline growth and revenue for Salesforce. As a Director of Product Management, you will strategize, design, build, and execute against a roadmap that you define with your engineering, data scientist, architecture, user experience, and marketing partners. This is a fast-moving area with significant visibility within the organization — we are looking for someone up to the challenge of delivering next generation marketing tools for one of the most agentic-forward enterprises in the world.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Define the vision and roadmap for the Campaign Brief Agent that orchestrates and delegates to specialized agents built for specific jobs to be done in the campaign design process
  • Translate business goals (e.g., retention vs. awareness) into agent interaction models and subscriber-centric campaign strategies in partnership with marketing, engineering, data science, and compliance
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle: from ideation and technical scoping to launch and continuous iteration, including the interaction and delegation model between the Campaign Brief Agent and all downstream agents
  • Define standards for agent performance, reliability, safety, and guardrails — ensuring the system consistently produces high-quality, brand-safe, and effective campaign assets
  • Conduct in-depth customer interviews, analyze campaign performance data, and monitor the competitive landscape to identify pain points and unmet needs in the marketing campaign creation process
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to develop systems that consider engagement history, fatigue, inferred intent, journey state, and suppression rules
  • Develop explainability features that log and articulate agent handoffs, enabling transparency and trust across internal stakeholders
  • Measure performance of the agent using engagement lift, system accuracy, marketer confidence, and business outcomes
  • Act as a thought partner to internal stakeholders, helping them shift from hands-off marketers to hands-on-keyboard marketers
  • Evangelize the platform vision, gain alignment across teams, and drive adoption across all outbound messaging use cases

You're Our Person If...

  • Product Management Expertise:8+ years of experience owning end-to-end product development in complex, data-driven systems — ideally in messaging, marketing tech, or personalization platforms
  • Systems Thinking: ability to design and reason about multi-agent architectures, orchestration models, and delegation logic at scale
  • Data Fluency: strong understanding of behavioral data, engagement signals, fatigue models, and targeting logic; comfortable working with data scientists and interpreting model outputs
  • Customer-Centric Mindset: deep empathy for the end recipient of messages and for the internal teams (marketers, compliance, operations) who rely on your platform
  • Execution Leadership: proven ability to drive projects from concept through launch with cross-functional teams including engineering, data science, compliance, and marketing
  • Communication & Influence: excellent written and verbal communication skills; impressive presentation skills and experience influencing audiences across levels and functions
  • Prioritization & Tradeoffs: skilled at balancing business objectives, subscriber experience, and technical feasibility in high-stakes environments
  • Experience with Messaging Systems (nice to have): familiarity with journey orchestration tools, messaging APIs, campaign management, or customer engagement platforms

  • This position is based in San Francisco requires a flexible work schedule to support collaboration across North American time zones
  • Travel is expected to be less than 15%

And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.
 

Overview of the role


As an Account Solution Engineer (also known as a "Presales Consultant" or "Sales Engineer"), you are the visionary who transforms customer experiences. You aren’t just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner to Sales, owning the solutioning throughout the entire sales cycle. You will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, translating complex business objectives into enticing, practical recommendations that drive real change.


Business Acumen & Strategic Impact

  • Business Transformation Advocate: You are passionate about how technology solves real-world business puzzles. You enjoy digging into a company’s value chain to find where Salesforce can drive the most impact.

  • The "Bottom Line" Mentality: You understand that technology is only as good as the business outcome it creates. You are excited by the challenge of connecting high-level business strategy to technical execution.

Strategic Sales Partner: You thrive on the "win." You act as a co-pilot to the sales team, bringing a strategic lens to every deal to ensure we aren't just selling software, but building a long-term partnership.


The Ideal Profile: Passion & Mindset

Demonstrated Passion for Technology & AI

  • The "First to Know": You are a true technophile. You don't just wait for training; you are already experimenting with the latest in Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic workflows.

  • AI Visionary: You have a clear passion for how AI is transforming the workforce. You are eager to show customers how Agentforce and autonomous agents can augment human productivity.

  • Continuous Learner: You have a "Growth Mindset." Whether it’s passing a new Salesforce Certification or exploring a new API, you are driven by a natural curiosity to understand the how and why behind the tech.
     

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Sales Partnership: Act as the technical "North Star" for the sales team, aligning technical strategy with business outcomes to close complex deals.

  • Solution Innovation: Develop and deliver innovative custom solutions and demos (including Agentforce and Data Cloud) that address unique business challenges and prove tangible value.

  • Lead the Cycle: Coordinate and lead the entire solution cycle through close collaboration with other high-performing teams (Product, Marketing, Professional Services).

  • Value Communication: Articulate the benefits of Salesforce to audiences at every level—from IT Administrators to C-suite executives—using industry-specific insights.

  • Continuous Growth: Maintain expert-level knowledge of Salesforce products and industry trends to remain effective in a performance-driven environment.
     

Experience & Background

We are looking for a diverse range of backgrounds to join our high-performing South team. Whether you are a career SE or looking to pivot your technical and business acumen into a pre-sales career, we want to hear from you.
Core Experience (One or more of the following):

  • Solution Excellence: A proven track record in Solution Engineering (Pre-sales), technical consulting, or professional services delivery within an enterprise software organization.

  • Strategic Sales & Account Management: Experience in Account Management or Solution Selling, with a focus on navigating complex sales cycles and acting as a strategic partner to sales leadership.

  • SaaS & Cloud Fluency: Deep familiarity with the SaaS (Software as a Service) landscape, including an understanding of subscription-based business models and cloud architecture.

  • Consultative Mindset: A background in Business Consulting, with the ability to perform deep discovery, identify "pain points," and map them to high-value technology roadmaps.

  • Technical Foundation: A strong Technical Background—this could be a degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience with APIs, data modeling, or software development.
     

Required Skills & Qualifications

The Foundations

  • Professional Background: A track record in Solution Engineering, SaaS, Account Management, Management Consulting, or a deep Technical Background. We are open to a variety of backgrounds if you can demonstrate the core proficiencies of the role.

The Global Brand & Creative team within Marketing is responsible for our brand and marketing creative. From building brand awareness campaigns to designing experiences like Dreamforce, our multi-faceted team does it all. We are a collection of thinkers, makers and doers, whose sole purpose is to bring the brand to life across our incredible portfolio of work.

Within this team, the Events & Experiences Creative function is responsible for how Salesforce shows up in physical spaces — from flagship events and trade shows to brand partnerships, activations, and executive experiences.

Salesforce is looking for a Senior Lead, Art Direction to bring creative leadership and hands-on craft to our events portfolio. This is a leadership role for someone who can set a clear art direction vision and then get in the trenches to make sure it’s executed flawlessly — from first concept to final install.

You’re fluent in event design and know how to translate brand identity into physical space, but you also carry real brand design chops, so nothing you ship ever feels off-brand or half-finished. You know how to design a footprint and map a user journey through it, and you can direct copy so the narrative holds together from entrance to exit. You have an obsessive attention to detail, a strong point of view, and the ability to turn strategy into experience — taking an abstract brief and making it walkable, tangible, and on-brand.

This role travels. You’ll be on-site for major events, overseeing design execution and setup in real time, catching what needs catching, and making the calls that keep the work true to the vision when reality gets messy.

  • Demonstrated experience designing event footprints and user journeys for large-scale activations
  • Proven experience leading and mentoring designers or art directors
  • Deep fluency in environmental and spatial design — stage design, signage, wayfinding, large-format production
  • Strong brand design background, with an eye for how identity systems translate into physical space
  • Experience directing copy or working closely with copywriters to shape a cohesive event narrative
  • A track record of translating strategy into experience — turning briefs into tangible, on-brand spaces

At Salesforce, we believe AI is only as powerful as the trusted context that supports the actions it takes. We are looking for you to lead the charge in the Agentic Era, building deep specialism in Agent Fabric — the governance and orchestration layer that lets AI act safely and effectively inside the enterprise. MuleSoft’s integration and API backbone gives agents the trusted context and connectivity they need; your job is to turn that foundation into governed, orchestrated, real-world business results.

As a Consumption Value Manager, you own the business outcomes of MuleSoft adoption across your accounts, working in close technical partnership with the customer’s own teams and building enough yourself to speak their language. As a crucial member of the account teams, you’ll use your experience and leading AI tools to build and nurture relationships directly with customers, across Salesforce and the ecosystem. This is a customer-facing role. You will work directly with a set of customers, empowered to manage your portfolio autonomously to achieve the business goals. This role is rooted in stewardship informed by technical fluency; you will be responsible for the adoption and orchestration maturity of MuleSoft solutions including Agent Fabric within our most strategic accounts — building proofs-of-concept and prototypes yourself where they accelerate consumption and value, diagnosing where deeper governance or orchestration gaps sit, and directing the right capability to close them — and for the growth, health and retention that follows from getting that right.

You will act as a business partner to sales leaders, acting as the value and adoption anchor for MuleSoft across their entire territory. You are driving the business and your technical fluency means you can hold your own in a room with architects and enjoy getting hands-on. You bring the information and insights that matter, proactively highlighting where interventions are needed and identifying the customer stories that inspire others. Your goal is to ensure that no customer is left behind and that every organisation recognises the transformative value of their investment in governed, orchestrated AI agents.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Proactive Stewardship: You’ll manage a set of accounts, balancing and prioritising your time to build a range of relationships, gather key insights and deliver business impact
  • Innovation: Your use of Data & AI tools (both existing and ones you’ll create; at Salesforce you have access to the latest tools: Claude, Gemini, Cursor and more) to monitor consumption patterns across your accounts enables you to proactively identify opportunities and mitigate risks. You’ll be with the customer and celebrate new milestones of business outcomes together
  • Show not Tell: You’ll be hands-on with the various products, leading demos and building proof-of-concept projects to demonstrate how to solve new business problems

  • Value Realisation: Turn technical potential into business outcomes. Your influence and communication skills help stakeholders see the direct line between Data, Integration, Agentic Orchestration and ROI to get buy-in for transformation
  • Business Partnering: Act as a strategic consultant to sales leaders, providing holistic insights into account health and territory trends to ensure sustainable commercial relationships.
  • Lead the Ohana: Work in a highly supportive environment where you help “write the manual” for this new phase of growth, adopting and sharing best practices across a diverse, global team.

You understand enterprise IT and how applications and data connect together with APIs providing the context that powers AI. You understand how business processes turn into agentic actions that need orchestration and governance, and you have the technical curiosity to quickly build real fluency in how MuleSoft’s Agent Fabric governance and orchestration model works, even without prior hands-on exposure to it.
  • The Do-er: You bring demonstrated hands-on depth in a related discipline — Agentic technical capabilities such as AI agent orchestration, LLM governance/guardrails or MCP and A2A — with the technical aptitude to ramp quickly into MuleSoft’s Agent Fabric. We’re hiring for transferable technical depth and fast ramp-up.
  • Customer-First: You want to influence outcomes and see them through to fruition. Being given ownership of a territory and the autonomy to drive its success motivates you.

descriptionHtml:

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customization, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time.  You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures  and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them. 

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organizations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform  and current LLM techniques.

  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.

  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.

  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the  product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist  in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have 3+ years (6-10 years for Senior levels) of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.

  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.

The Experience

Salesforce's Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) provides 24x7x365 security monitoring and rapid incident response across every Salesforce environment, protecting company and customer data from adversaries.

As a Senior Incident Responder, you'll be a core member of the response team — investigating and handling security incidents end to end, taking a lead role on many of them, and escalating to Lead Incident Responders on the most severe or ambiguous events. You'll also help improve the playbooks, detections, and automation that make the team faster, and mentor newer analysts as you grow toward a lead role yourself.

This is a hands-on technical role focused on the detailed work of incident response.

What You'll Actually Be Doing
 
  • Investigate and respond to security incidents end to end — triage, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review — taking point on many incidents and supporting Lead Incident Responders on the highest-severity, highest-visibility events.
  • Investigate adversary activity, insider threats, and web application attacks across on-premises and multi-cloud environments.
  • Contribute to process improvements, playbooks, and automation — including Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) tooling and detection-as-code — that reduce time-to-detect and time-to-respond, and support strategic projects expanding detection and response capabilities.
  • Produce clear incident documentation and status updates for technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentor newer incident responders, and support the team's on-call rotation (core hours 10:30 AM–6:30 PM ET, Monday–Friday, with occasional overnight/weekend on-call as needed).


You're Our Person If...
 
  • You have 5+ years in information security, including hands-on operational security monitoring and incident response.
  • You can perform host and network forensics across Windows, macOS, and Linux — analyzing file system, memory, process, and network artifacts for indicators of compromise — and have responded to incidents in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), including familiarity with cloud architectures, CI/CD (continuous integration/continuous delivery) pipelines, and cloud logging/telemetry.
  • You've handled high-priority incidents, including insider investigations, adversary activity, and web application attacks, and have a solid, current understanding of the threat landscape — attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), tooling, and hardening best practices — including working knowledge of a framework such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, document incidents effectively, and build trusted relationships with peers inside and outside your team.


Even Better If...
 
  • You're developing depth in a specialty — malware analysis, detection engineering, forensics, cloud security, offensive security, or applied AI/ML for security.
  • You have prior experience in a 24x7x365 security operations environment, and have improved team capability through automation and tool development.
  • You hold relevant certifications: SANS GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GPEN, GREM, or Offensive Security OSCP.
  • You have experience applying AI and LLMs to SOC operations — AI-powered tooling, LLM-assisted threat analysis, and AI-driven detection — and a strong understanding of the Salesforce platform and its SaaS offerings.
