title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Data 360
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About the Role

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

 Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it. 

What You'll Do

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.

  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).

  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.

  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.

  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.

  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.

  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.

  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.

  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.

  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.

  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.

  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.

Our team operates at the intersection of cloud security, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and runtime security. We build and operate security guardrails that identify and prevent high-risk security issues from source code and Infrastructure as Code through CI/CD and into runtime environments.
You will be expected to operate at both strategic and hands-on technical levels, defining architecture and technical direction while also diving deeply into complex engineering problems, writing production-quality code, and driving solutions from concept through deployment and operation.
This role is an opportunity to shape security capabilities that operate at significant scale across Salesforce infrastructure and to influence how security is embedded throughout the engineering lifecycle.
 

Responsibilities

  • Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert for infrastructure security and security guardrails, providing architectural direction across teams.

  • Design and build scalable shift-left security capabilities that identify security risks in source code, Infrastructure as Code, containerized workloads, and deployment configurations before they reach production.

  • Architect and build shift-left security controls that identify security risks early while providing developers with actionable findings and straightforward remediation paths.

  • Design scalable policy-as-code and security enforcement frameworks for consistent security controls across multiple gates and environments.

  • Drive risk-based security engineering by identifying exploitable, high-impact, and meaningful security risks rather than treating all scanner findings equally.

  • Design mechanisms for security finding correlation, prioritization, deduplication, and enforcement when signals originate from multiple security systems.

  • Lead architecture and implementation of Kubernetes admission control and workload security capabilities.

  • Define technical strategies for reliability, scalability, performance, observability, fault tolerance, and operational readiness of security services.

  • Establish and evolve SLIs, SLOs, telemetry, rollout strategies, and operational practices for critical security services.

  • Own technical outcomes across the complete lifecycle — requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, production readiness, rollout, and ongoing operations.

  • Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale.

  • Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 15+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, security engineering with significant experience designing and delivering large-scale production systems.

  • Strong programming experience in one or more languages such as Go, Java, or Python, with the ability to design, implement, debug, and review production-quality systems.

  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure and cloud security, including experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers, and cloud-native infrastructure.

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD architecture and DevSecOps, including deployment pipelines, security gates, policy enforcement, and automation.

  • Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies.

  • Experience designing distributed, highly scalable, reliable, and secure systems.

  • Strong understanding of security engineering concepts including vulnerability management, configuration security, policy enforcement, workload security, identity/access controls, and risk assessment.

  • Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous security problems, identify the core technical challenge, and drive an architecture and implementation to completion.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex architectures and trade-offs to senior technical and business audiences.

  • Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience in cloud-native security, DevSecOps, infrastructure security, or application security.

  • Experience building security platforms/services or guardrails that operate at large enterprise scale.

  • Experience with Kubernetes Admission Controllers, admission policies, OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or similar policy enforcement technologies.

  • Experience with policy-as-code and security-as-code frameworks.

  • Experience with IaC security and tools such as Checkov, OPA, Terraform security scanning, or equivalent technologies.

  • Strong understanding of container and workload security, including Seccomp, Linux security mechanisms, container isolation, and runtime security.

  • Experience building systems that correlate security signals from multiple sources and prioritize findings based on risk, exploitability, exposure, and business impact.

  • Experience with vulnerability management, cloud security posture management, container security, or automated security remediation.

  • Experience designing developer-facing security products with a strong focus on actionable findings, low friction remediation, and developer experience.

  • Experience designing security controls across the complete lifecycle: source → IaC → CI/CD → deployment → admission → runtime.

  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, identity, workload architecture, and distributed systems.

  • Experience driving technical strategy across multiple engineering organizations.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify new security opportunities and turn them into scalable engineering solutions.

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and serving as a technical leader for complex, multi-team initiatives.
     

  • A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering — using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.

  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in development workflows.

What Success Looks Like

AFO powers the multi-agent orchestration layer, transforming messy operational workflows, unstructured data (emails, PDFs, spec sheets), and legacy ERP logs into autonomous execution engines with humans in the loop.

Operating in an agile deployment pod alongside a Deployment Strategist and Specialized AI Engineers, you will serve as the crucial link connecting advanced AI agents to the broader enterprise technology landscape.   • Field-to-Product Feedback: Serve as the direct connective bridge between frontline customer deployments and core Salesforce product/engineering teams to feed edge cases and gaps back into platform feature roadmaps.

Our core surface areas include SSO, DLP, SCIM, IDR, EKM, Data Retention, and comprehensive Audit Logs.

About the Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience

  • AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

  • Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

  • Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time.  You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures  and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them. 

  • Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

What You'll Actually Be Building

  • Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

  • Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform  and current LLM techniques.

  • Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.

  • Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

  • Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.

  • Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

  • Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

  • Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the  product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.

  • Partner with the Deployment Strategist  in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If…

  • You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models

  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

  • You are fluent in English + another EMEA language

  • You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

  • You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

  • You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.

  • You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.

  • You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

  • You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.

  • You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.

  • You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.

  • You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)

  • Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns

  • Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

The runtime plane is a dedicated extensible infrastructure layer facilitating service-to-service and customer-to-service communication via proxies managed by the control plane such that policies can be applied at these proxies. The runtime plane is built using Envoy and Istio. It is extensible and features are built into these proxies or are integrations at these proxies with no change to actual services.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure automation tools, frameworks, workflows, and validation platforms.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, configuration management and Infrastructure as Code principles (e.g. Spinnaker, Terraform).
  • Experience with Agile development methodology (e.g. Scrum) and Test-Driven Development, with attention to code quality, and delivering secure code.
  • Participation in the team's on-call rotation to address complex problems in real-time and keep services operational and highly available.
  • Experience in using telemetry and metrics to drive operational excellence.



What does success look like in your first 60-90 days?

  • Ability to quickly learn the technical stack. This includes understanding OSS service mesh technologies (e.g. Envoy, Istio, NGINX), kubernetes, helm charts, spinnaker, load balancing, security groups. Developing a strong understanding of network technologies, such as TCP/IP, DNS, TLS termination, HTTP proxies is a must. Openness to working in an agile environment, delivering within milestones and dependency constraints, while focusing on quality coding, test coverage, high availability, and security.

This includes events, messaging, connectors, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), and the agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors that let external tools and AI models talk to the platform.

  • Secure service-to-service authentication, external client apps, and agent and MCP connectors, where excessive privilege, secret leakage, and misuse of delegated access are key threats.
  • Build secure-by-default patterns into frameworks, connector software development kits (SDKs), and onboarding paths. Review Java, JavaScript, and TypeScript code in a large codebase to validate design assumptions and find risk in authentication, integration, and access-control flows.
  • Partner with architects, engineers, and product owners to move findings to resolution, and mentor junior security engineers on secure design and threat modeling.

About Slack & The Role

Slack is at an inflection point. We're evolving from the world's most beloved team communication tool into something fundamentally new: an AI operating system where humans and agents work together to get things done. This isn't incremental improvement. It's a reimagining of how work happens.

As Slack VP, Product Design (Individual Contributor; Principal Architect) you will be one of the most important design voices shaping that future. This is not a management role. It's a rare seat at the table for a designer who wants to define the product; to hold the vision, drive the craft, and personally execute at the highest level on the next generation of Slack.

You will report to the SVP & Chief Design Officer and partner deeply with product and engineering leadership to prototype, pressure-test, and shape the platform Slack must become. You'll make work that millions of people use every day and you'll help us make the hardest design problems look inevitable in hindsight.

The Opportunity: Designing Slack as the AI Operating System for Action

Slack's defining role in this next era is as the context layer for work: the intelligent interface where humans and AI agents collaborate fluidly to drive outcomes. Built on context, Slack becomes the single, personalized command center that replaces fragmented apps, inboxes, and point solutions.

As Slack VP, Product Design (Individual Contributor; Principal Architect) you will be the designer helping us answer the hardest questions at the frontier of this transformation:

  • Human-Agent Collaboration: What are the right interaction models for a world where AI agents are co-workers? How do agents present information, take action, and hand back control in ways that feel natural, not jarring?
  • Radical Simplification: How do we strip Slack down to its most essential, powerful form while making it capable of far more? How do we absorb complexity so users never have to feel it?
  • Dynamic & Ambient Interfaces: How do we design surfaces that appear when and where decisions need to be made (across voice, mobile, wearables, and desktop) rather than requiring users to navigate to them?
  • The AI Operating System: What does it look like when Slack becomes the single pane of glass for every kind of worker: the CEO, the service agent, the developer, the sales rep? How do we make that feel personal and not overwhelming?

Key Responsibilities

  • Vision & Concept Design: Define and prototype the long-range design vision for Slack's agentic future, producing the seminal concepts and vignettes that align the organization and inspire the roadmap
  • Executional Craft: Personal, hands-on design at the highest level, pixel-perfect, conceptually sharp, deeply considered. Uses whatever tools work best (AI, code, and emerging prototyping techniques) to turn ideas into working experiences fast, explore possibilities, and raise the bar. The bar you set becomes the bar for the team.
  • Strategic Design Influence: Partner with the CDO, CPO, and Engineering leadership to shape product strategy through design. Influence decisions at the SVP and C-level through the power of your work and your thinking
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Drive alignment across product, engineering, research, and brand through the quality and clarity of your design work, without needing formal authority
  • Simplification as a Design Discipline: Lead the work to radically simplify Slack's current experience, defining what we kill, what we keep, and what we transform as we move toward an AI-first paradigm
  • Emerging Interaction Patterns: Invent new design patterns for agentic UX, for voice-anchored experiences, ambient AI surfaces, multiplayer human-agent co-creation, and dynamic UI generation
  • User Advocacy at Scale: Be a relentless champion for the user, particularly the enterprise user under pressure; the worker with 500 unread messages, zero configuration tolerance, and no time to learn a new paradigm

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of product design experience, with senior IC work at significant scale
  • A portfolio that demonstrates both visionary concept work and exceptional executional craft
  • Proven ability to define product direction through design, not just respond to it
  • Experience designing consumer-grade experiences, deeply intuitive, delightful, effortless, in complex product contexts
  • A track record of influencing product strategy at the leadership level without relying on hierarchy
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills; can make complex ideas simple and make simple ideas compelling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing for AI, machine learning, or human-agent collaboration. Ideally at the interaction pattern level, not just the UI level
  • Experience with enterprise software and the unique constraints of B2B SaaS at scale
  • Familiarity with emerging modalities: voice UX, ambient/wearable surfaces, AI-generated UI
  • Experience working directly with C-suite leadership to define and evolve product vision
  • Understanding of Slack, its ecosystem, and what makes it uniquely powerful; and what needs to change

What Makes This Role Different

Most senior IC design roles ask you to execute within a defined vision. This one asks you to be the vision while still doing the work. You'll have the strategic altitude of a leadership role and the craft latitude of a builder role. You'll ship things that change how millions of people experience their working lives.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 戦略的伴走とロードマップ策定:顧客のビジネス・技術目標をヒアリングし、現状分析から目標達成を加速する「導入パス(アダプション・パス)」やイネーブルメント計画を策定・実行する。顧客と共にロードマップを作成し、四半期ごとにQBR(Quarterly Business Review)を実施する。
  • 製品活用とガバナンス推進:Salesforce全クラウド・製品群(Sales、Service、Slack、Tableau等)の機能を駆使して活用を推進し、組織戦略・ガバナンス・変更管理(チェンジマネジメント)のベストプラクティスを指導する。
  • プロジェクトのオーケストレーションとリスク管理:顧客の期待値に応じた支援プランを立案・推進し、社内リソース(SA、アーキテクト、営業等)を適宜アサイン・連携させる。目的達成に対するリスクを早期に察知し、アカウントチームと協力して軽減策を講じる。
  • エグゼクティブ・コミュニケーション:CIO、CTO、ビジネス役員などの経営層・意思決定者とエグゼクティブレベルの関係を築き、安定稼動やビジネス効果創出をリードする。技術的な製品変更、障害、サポート終了(EOL)などのアップデートを能動的に伝達する。

  • ビジネスコンサルティング、カスタマーサクセスマネージャー、テクニカルアカウントマネジメントなどのバックグラウンドをお持ちの方(特にBtoC・営業領域での経験)

  • 顧客経営層とのスムーズなコミュニケーション能力をお持ちの方
  • 日本語が流暢な方
  • 社内外のメンバーを巻き込みながら、全体をオーケストレーションするリーダーシップスキルをお持ちの方

弊社では「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。

充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。

Join a team of 10 within Salesforce AI Labs, bringing computer-use AI into production with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Salesforce. We’re building a product that learns from human demonstrations and turns complex workflows into repeatable automation across enterprise applications.

Making computer use dependable raises hard engineering questions. How does an agent know it succeeded? When should it reason, and when should it follow a deterministic path? How should it recover when an application changes or ask for help before making a consequential mistake?

You’ll help answer those questions in production. Our team works directly with customers, building alongside them and turning discoveries into reusable product capabilities. You’ll own substantial systems from design through deployment and help take a new offering from early customer adoption through general availability, backed by Salesforce’s scale and reach.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Drive Agent Development & Architecture

  • Build systems that learn from demonstrations and combine AI reasoning with deterministic execution to complete workflows reliably.

  • Develop recovery and verification capabilities so agents can adapt to changes, confirm outcomes, and recognize when human intervention is needed.

  • Build backend services with robust workflow state management, failure handling, and secure access to customer environments.

  • Create evaluations and diagnostics that measure task success, expose regressions, and make failures understandable.

Build Directly With Customers

  • Work alongside customers to understand their workflows, prototype solutions, and validate results in their environments.

  • Investigate where automation succeeds or fails, then turn those findings into improvements to the core product.

  • Help customers move from their first successful workflow toward repeatable, increasingly self-service adoption.

  • Partner with forward-deployed engineers and product management to decide which customer needs should shape the roadmap.

Shape Technical Direction & Grow the Team

  • Own technical decisions for substantial components, from initial design through production operation.

  • Evaluate model selection, tool use, and context management against reliability, latency, and cost.

  • Mentor peers through design discussions and code reviews, and participate in hiring.

  • You’ve independently owned a substantial backend service or system through design, deployment, production failures, and subsequent improvements.

  • You have hands-on experience building and evaluating LLM-powered systems, and can explain how you assessed their quality and failure modes.

  • You can reason through concurrency, persistent state, retries, and partial failures in systems that perform consequential actions.

  • You’re proficient in Python, Go, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

  • You can turn an unclear customer problem into a bounded technical approach, test it with users, and carry it through to production.

  • You want direct customer engagement to be part of your engineering work, including investigating problems and discussing technical tradeoffs.

  • You use AI development tools thoughtfully and take responsibility for the correctness, security, and maintainability of what you ship.

  • Browser automation, workflow orchestration, or enterprise integrations.

  • チームメンバーとのコミュニケーションを通じて、少しずつ業務範囲を広げていきたい方
  • AIツールを使った新しい働き方に興味がある方

主な業務内容

IT・SaaS市場の最新情報のリサーチ

  • 国内外のSaaSベンダー・AI企業・IT企業に関するニュース・製品発表・サービスアップデート・事例などを、各社のWebサイト・ニュースリリース・ブログ・SNSなどから継続的に収集する。

  • SlackbotやClaudeなどのAIツールを活用することで、リサーチプロセスの効率化を推進する。

社内データ・ダッシュボード・コンテンツの運用・更新サポート

  • 既存のAIエージェントについて、定期的に回答の精度・品質を確認する（テストの実施、古い情報や誤りのチェックなど）。問題が見つかった場合は、担当者と連携して修正対応を行う。

  • 日本語での基本的なビジネスコミュニケーション能力（読み・書き中心。業務はオンライン・非同期でのやりとりが基本です）

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

The Forward Deployed Consultant owns a customer engagement end to end: from the executive business case, through rapid design and deployment of automated process solutions (“Blueprints”) on the Agentforce platform, to a clean handoff to partners and client teams. You will advise enterprise leaders, quantify ROI, and map multi-year automation roadmaps. You bring domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes, including where people patch over system gaps. You will also roll up your sleeves to build, test, and iterate Blueprints with AI agents and prompting tools, proving value fast in live production. You are customer-obsessed, strategic, and execution-focused, with the speed and quality to turn fragmented manual workflows into scalable, value-driven solutions.


Responsibilities

Strategic advisory and business case

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor to enterprise stakeholders, building a deep understanding of business goals and operational pain points.
  • Build business cases and define success criteria up front: KPIs such as cycle time and cost per transaction, with a measured baseline.
  • Own multi-year roadmaps for process Blueprints and automation, balancing strategic direction with near-term execution.
  • Present to executives in terms of their priorities; flag when work is off track early and plainly, with a fix, and drive to a decision.

Blueprint design and rapid value proof

  • Lead structured discovery (workshops, process maps) and turn it into a solution design and a first working version in days to weeks.
  • Automate business processes end to end (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, supplier onboarding), deciding what stays in the ERP, what is automated around it, and what AI decides versus people.
  • Build hands-on with AI agents and prompting tools: design prompts, structure outputs with schemas and examples, and debug and iterate when they fail.
  • Identify integration points with core systems (REST, event-based), managing risks such as auth, latency, payload limits, and retries.

Specification and delivery

  • Translate strategic goals into clear PRDs and technical acceptance criteria.
  • Deliver in continuous build loops (design, build, validate, refine), where each loop proves value and expands scope toward AI-first operations.
  • Lead an AI-first delivery experience, using AI agents and skills to accelerate requirements, build, testing, and documentation.
  • Own delivery end to end through go-live: scoping, build, UAT, data migration, and cutover, managing scope change along the way.
  • Cut scope to the highest-value slice(Day 1 Scope/MVP)) when needed to get live, and justify the trade-off to the customer.

Ownership transfer to customer or partner

  • Design and run handoff processes, documentation, and enablement that transition ownership to implementation partners and customer teams.
  • Set handoff guidelines, solution architecture documentation, and success criteria for sustained post-deployment success.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years in Solutions Consulting, Forward Deployed roles, Strategic or Management Consulting, Product Management, Process Automation, or Business Analysis.
  • Domain depth in supply chain, ERP, or finance operations processes (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, AP/AR, supplier onboarding), including where people patch over system gaps.
  • Hands-on experience building AI or agent-based automation yourself, including prompt design, output structuring, and iterating on failures.
  • Experience engaging enterprise executives in B2B SaaS to build business cases and long-term roadmaps.
  • Proven track record owning engagements from discovery through go-live (UAT, data migration, cutover), not just POCs, followed by structured handoffs.
  • Strong grounding in workflow mapping, process modeling, process improvement, and change management.
  • Experience translating business requirements into automated workflows, PRDs, and user stories.
  • Working knowledge of integration patterns (REST, SOAP, event-based) and common risks such as auth, latency, and payload limits.
  • Track record of setting success KPIs and baselines up front and measuring outcomes after go-live.
  • Executive presence: confident with skeptical executives and willing to deliver bad news early, with a plan.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with the Salesforce platform ecosystem (APIs, platform services).
  • Track record building or navigating partner ecosystems and implementation channels.
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or related process improvement certification.
  • Technical or business degree; MBA a plus.

Success metrics

  • Time to first working version: days to weeks from discovery, not months.
  • Go-live rate: share of engagements that reach production, not just a POC.
  • Measured value against baseline: KPI movement after go-live (such as cycle time or cost per transaction) compared with the baseline set up front.
  • Roadmap and expansion: each go-live earns the next swing, with adjacent processes added to the roadmap and expansion driven in the account.

ROLE OVERVIEW
The Senior Technical Consultant — Marketing Cloud Next is a hands-on delivery specialist responsible for
executing the build, configuration, data migration and testing workstreams within Marketing Cloud Next
migration waves. Working under the direction of the Technical Architect and Solution Architect, the STC owns
specific delivery workstreams end-to-end — including Email Studio configuration, Journey Builder
implementation, subscriber data migration, AMPscript and SSJS development, Data Cloud data stream
configuration and automated migration validation tooling. The STC also mentors Technical Consultants on the
wave team, reviewing their work and ensuring factory quality standards are upheld across all MCN
deliverables.

RESPONSIBILITIES
● Execute Marketing Cloud Next platform configuration — building Email Studio sending domains, IP
configurations, Content Builder templates, Automation Studio programs, Journey Builder flows and
subscriber data extension schemas as specified in the Technical Architect's solution design.
● Execute subscriber data migration — running the full data migration lifecycle: data profiling,
transformation scripting, data extension population, suppression list loading, consent record migration
and bulk data load execution using ETL tools and Salesforce Bulk API.
● Develop AMPscript and SSJS personalisation — writing dynamic content personalisation scripts for
migrated email templates, recreating legacy segmentation logic, lookup functions and conditional content
rules in MCN native scripting.
● Configure Salesforce Data Cloud data streams — setting up data stream ingestion from source
systems, configuring DLO schemas, mapping fields to DMOs and validating data completeness per the
Data Cloud Architect's design.
● Migrate and rebuild Journey Builder flows — translating legacy marketing automation workflows,
drip campaigns and triggered sends into Journey Builder — recreating entry sources, decision splits, wait
steps, send activities and exit criteria.
● Build migration validation and reconciliation tooling — developing Apex batch utilities, LWC
dashboards and Salesforce Flow automations for subscriber count reconciliation, data extension record
validation and consent flag verification.
● Execute and manage dry run cycles — coordinating migration dry runs against SIT/UAT environments,
capturing reconciliation counts, logging validation failures and iterating until dry run success criteria are
met.
● Configure sender authentication and deliverability — implementing SPF, DKIM and DMARC DNS
records, private domain configuration, reply mail management and IP warm-up scheduling as directed by
the TA.

● Develop and execute unit and system integration tests — writing test scripts for migrated journeys,
data extensions and automations; executing SIT cycles; logging defects; retesting fixes against factory
quality thresholds.
● Support go-live cutover execution — following the cutover runbook: executing final subscriber data
loads, activating journeys, validating data extension record counts and confirming suppression lists are
active.
● Prepare technical handover documentation — producing configuration workbooks, data mapping
sheets, AMPscript library documentation and journey flow diagrams for client team handover post go-
live.
● Mentor Technical Consultants — reviewing TC deliverables for quality, explaining MCN platform
patterns, unblocking technical issues and providing feedback aligned to factory standards.
● Contribute to the factory accelerator library — after every wave, updating reusable MCN
configuration templates, AMPscript snippet libraries, data migration scripts and validation toolkits in the
shared accelerator repository.

CORE TECHNICAL SKILLS — MUST HAVE
● Marketing Cloud Next — Hands-On Configuration: Proven ability to configure Email Studio, Journey
Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder and Contact Builder end-to-end, including sending domain
configuration, journey entry sources, decision splits and triggered sends.
● AMPscript & SSJS Development: Proficiency in AMPscript and SSJS for dynamic email personalisation
— lookup functions, conditional content, row sets, attribute rendering and legacy personalisation logic
recreation.
● Subscriber Data Migration Execution: Hands-on experience executing subscriber data migrations —
data extension population, bulk data loading via Import Wizard and API, suppression list management,
consent record migration and reconciliation validation at scale.
● Salesforce Data Cloud — Configuration: Working knowledge of Data Cloud data stream setup,
DLO/DMO schema configuration, field mapping and data ingestion validation.
● ETL Tools & Data Loading: Experience using at least one ETL tool (Informatica Cloud, Talend, Azure
Data Factory, MuleSoft) or scripted Bulk API / REST API approaches for subscriber data extraction,
transformation and loading.
● Apex & Platform Development: Ability to write Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, REST callout handlers
and Apex test classes for migration utility development, including subscriber reconciliation tools and
consent flag verification.
● Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC migration dashboards, subscriber
count trackers and Salesforce Flow automations as internal factory tooling.
● CI/CD & Source Control: Comfortable working within Salesforce DX and Git-based workflows —
committing changes, following branching conventions, submitting PRs and using Gearset/Copado for
environment promotion.

PREFERRED SKILLS — GOOD TO HAVE
● Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud
Next
● Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) for cross-channel reporting post-migration
● Experience with WhatsApp, Push, SMS or LINE channel configuration in Marketing Cloud Next

● Familiarity with Marketing Cloud REST and SOAP API for programmatic data operations and triggered
sends
● Understanding of IP warm-up strategy and email deliverability monitoring tools (250ok, Validity/Return
Path)
● Exposure to Agentforce journeys triggered from Data Cloud activation segments

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS
● 5–8 years of Salesforce and marketing technology delivery experience
● 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Marketing Cloud Next configuration experience
● Experience executing at least 1 end-to-end Marketing Cloud migration or large implementation project as
a key delivery contributor
● Demonstrated hands-on experience with subscriber data migration — bulk loading, data extension setup,
consent migration and reconciliation validation
● Experience mentoring junior Technical Consultants on MCN configuration and data migration tasks

● Required: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Administrator
● Required: Salesforce Administrator

● Preferred: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant

The Experience

AI agents can reason about what needs to happen. Getting them to reliably do work inside the software businesses actually run on is the next frontier.

We’re building Systems Integration Agent: computer use for the enterprise. It learns how to operate applications like SAP, Oracle, and Workday, then turns that knowledge into reusable, code-backed actions. The challenge goes beyond making an impressive demo: customers need automation they can trust with consequential business processes.

Our team operates as a small startup within Salesforce AI Labs, separate from the main engineering and product organizations. You’ll work directly with the team’s leader and engineers, alongside customers, with the autonomy to shape an early product and the resources of Salesforce to back you up.

As a Value Acceleration Engineer, you’ll write code, build alongside customers, and get real workflows into production. This is forward-deployed engineering on an emerging product: what you learn in deployments will help determine what we build next.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Build Directly With Customers

  • Work with process owners and customer IT to select workflows, define success, and secure the test access and data needed to build.
  • Run hands-on sessions that help customers use the product themselves, with clear scope and readiness expectations.
  • Help customers understand where the product can deliver value, explain its capabilities and limitations clearly, and connect technical results to business outcomes.

Engineer Reliable Automation

  • Write custom JavaScript tools when existing capabilities cannot complete a task.
  • Debug failures across browser behavior, agent execution, application state, and backend services.
  • Build tests for business outcomes, exceptions, partial completion, and recovery.
  • Help launch and stabilize workflows, documenting monitoring and recovery procedures and establishing support ownership with the team.

Make the Next Deployment Easier

  • Turn deployment lessons into reusable tools and tests, and work with core engineering to address recurring product gaps.
  • Use AI development tools thoughtfully while remaining accountable for code quality, security, and maintainability.

Working With Customers

  • Expect approximately 40–60% travel, typically several days onsite at a time, for customer discovery, hands-on build sessions, and launches.

You’re Our Person If…

  • You can write and debug JavaScript or TypeScript and reason about web applications, APIs, and data flow.
  • You enjoy working directly with users: asking precise questions, building alongside them, and explaining technical problems clearly.
  • You’ve led complex customer-facing deployments and built tools or practices that improved outcomes beyond your own projects.
  • You can align stakeholders on when to extend the product, narrow scope, or stop an unsafe rollout.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience.

Even Better If…

  • Playwright, browser automation, browser extensions, RPA, or enterprise integration.
  • Agent systems, tool execution, evaluations, or failure recovery.
  • SAP, Oracle, Workday, Salesforce, or similarly complex enterprise applications.

D360 FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER

About Salesforce

Salesforce brings customer data, CRM, analytics, and AI together on a trusted platform. Our teams help organizations turn complex business and data requirements into secure, scalable solutions. In this role, you will help customers put Data 360 into production and build the technical foundation for reliable, enterprise-grade use cases.

About the Role

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.

What You'll Do

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.

You're Our Data 360 Forward Deployed Engineer If...

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You've built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You've implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

The ideal candidate pairs deep SOX/internal audit technical fundamentals with a builder's mindset: comfortable evaluating which controls are ripe for automation, partnering with control owners, AI, and tooling teams to implement monitoring solutions, and leveraging data analytics to increase testing precision, reduce reliance on point-in-time sampling, and optimize program spend.

Partner collaboratively with vendor leadership to ensure continuous monitoring innovations directly convert into reduced billable testing hours and program cost efficiencies.

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Solution Engineering Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both solution engineering and sales. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Solution Engineering careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned an experienced Solution Engineering Buddy who will provide hands-on coaching and involve you in some of their live deals. You will also be paired with experienced Sales Development Buddies during the Sales Rotation and you also get to call your first salesforce leads and find your first deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior solution engineering and sales professionals during our inspiration sessions.

By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.

Who are we looking for?


  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree)
    • For the Solution Engineering Path, we consider applicants from the following academic backgrounds:
      Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Science/Data Engineering, Information Systems, or other adjacent disciplines
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English and Hebrew is essential

What does our new EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:

Introduction Month

During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni


Rotations

During the Graduate Program, you will experience both the Solution Engineering Path and the Sales Path. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.

If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Solution Engineering, you will then join the Sales Graduate Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will gain exposure to both roles. The time spent mastering the fundamentals of these complementary disciplines will enable you to be more productive and impactful upon promotion.

Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

Examples of what you can expect during the rotations


Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation

  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

Sales Graduate Rotation

  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

What’s in it for you?

  • A clear and structured career path within our Solution Engineering organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years

With the EMEA Graduate Program - Solution Engineering Path, you can continue to progress:

  • After completing the Graduate Program rotations, you may progress to Associate Solution Engineer, with opportunities to work across ESB, SMB, and GRB customer segments, or join our Specialist SE team. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change.

À propos d'Apromore

Apromore est un leader mondial de la technologie de process intelligence pilotée par l'IA. Faisant désormais partie de Salesforce, Apromore fournit aux entreprises un « jumeau numérique de processus » (Intelligent Process Twin) pour leur offrir une transparence opérationnelle totale. Alors que les entreprises s'efforcent d'incrémenter l'IA à grande échelle, Apromore comble le fossé entre la perception des processus et leur réalité du terrain. La solution sert de socle critique permettant aux organisations de découvrir, sécuriser, déployer et gouverner de manière systématique l'automatisation par l'IA agentique à l'échelle de l'entreprise.


À propos du rôle

Au sein de notre équipe de vente spécialisée Apromore, vous agirez en tant que chasseur stratégique et évangéliste pour Apromore, la plateforme de process intelligence de Salesforce, avec une forte orientation vers l'adoption de l'IA agentique. Stimuler l'expansion des comptes (upsell) en vendant de nouvelles capacités de process intelligence pour garantir que la valeur générée suive la croissance de leur activité.
  • Collaboration transversale : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes internes d'Ingénierie de la Valeur (Value Engineers), les Consultants Avant-Vente (Solution Consultants) et les équipes commerciales Salesforce afin d'offrir une expérience entreprise unifiée (« One Salesforce »).

This role offers the opportunity to identify emerging threats in artificial intelligence (AI)-driven and agent-based products and to design security controls and processes that enable rapid, secure product innovation across Salesforce. Overview of the Role 

Global supply chains still rely on slow, manual processes - email, spreadsheets, and fragmented data. The economy moves fast but supply chains don’t, creating an inefficiency that affects the $13T of goods shipped annually and is one of the largest untapped opportunities in modern enterprise.


Agentforce for Supply Chain is reimagining the supply chain with an AI-powered platform for designing, automating, and running end-to-end business processes. Customers are clamoring for more, rapidly expanding their use cases as we enter an exhilarating growth phase.


We are looking for an early-career, highly driven Value Acceleration Engineer to join us for a unique, high-impact "tour of duty." In this forward-deployed role, you will be on the front lines of our post-sales engine, embedding directly with our enterprise customers and Customer Success teams to bring AI concepts to life and compress their time-to-value. You will be the technical muscle that unblocks implementations, designs agentic workflows, and helps gets 1-2 critical business processes live in production during an intensive 90-day window.


This role is designed as a rotational "Field Residency." After spending your first 6-12 months mastering production edge cases, developing deep customer empathy, and learning the real-world complexities our customers face, you will rotate back into a core AFO product and engineering pod. You will bring those invaluable frontline insights with you to help us build the paved pathways of our future platform.

Day-to-Day & Project Execution

  • Work hands-on with strategic customers to design and build "Day 1" agentic workflows and blueprints.

  • Facilitate working sessions with customers and deployment strategists, bridging the gap between business needs and technical feasibility.
  • Enable and support implementation partners to take over ongoing build work post-engagement.

Long-Term Goals & Strategic Impact

  • Document design decisions and build patterns from your bespoke customer engagements to feed our use case library and core product roadmap.

  • Successfully graduate from your forward-deployed rotation, transitioning your hands-on deployment expertise into a permanent builder role within the core product pods.

Through our Value Acceleration Residency curriculum, you will move rapidly from shadowing senior team members to independently owning end-to-end customer projects. You will learn how large enterprise supply chains operate on the ground, master customer empathy, and build a unique techno-functional skillset.
  • Impact Made: Your work will directly accelerate time-to-value for our most strategic accounts, clearing onboarding blockers, and setting the stage for massive account expansion. You will be the critical link that turns a signed deal into a highly successful, live deployment.

  • High empathy and exceptional written and verbal communication skills; you must be comfortable presenting to external customers and navigating complex enterprise environments.
  • A strong desire to learn both technical systems and business processes.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment where quick problem-solving is required to unblock implementations.
  • Enthusiasm for a rotational model: excited to spend the first phase of your career at the company deployed in the field before transitioning into core product engineering.

  • Experience with modern programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, JavaScript) and a proven ability to pick up new technologies quickly.

  • Proven track record influencing product direction and strategy with actionable insights

About Salesforce & Role Summary


The Director, Data Foundation Delivery is a senior leader who owns the strategy, architecture, and successful delivery of enterprise Data Foundation engagements for Salesforce Professional Services customers. executives at the CxO level, and lead the delivery of a governed, AI-ready data foundation across a progressive, customer-calibrated maturity journey. You are the definitive authority on bringing the Data Foundation Delivery to life including core data capabilities, associated frameworks, and ability to operate

across one or more of the platform stack (Salesforce Data 360, Informatica IDMC, MuleSoft).


As a Salesforce leader, you help customers bring the Salesforce ecosystem into the broader landscape of technology investments they have already made — directing both platform-agnostic execution (interoperable, open-standards, multi-vendor) and platform-centric execution (Salesforce-native), so thedata foundation fits the customer's reality rather than forcing a single stack. Every foundation is built with governance, quality, security, and privacy embedded from day one, and serves both traditional analytics for people and agentic AI for machines.


Above all, you champion AI-based professional services delivery: you set the standard for how engagements use AI tools like (Claude Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) to compress delivery effort while raising quality and consistency, and you author the reusable IP — prompt templates, skills, and

agents — that scales delivery. You are an industry thought leader who shapes the practice's point of view on the agentic future of the SaaS industry, translating where enterprise data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem are heading into how we advise and deliver for customers today.


This is a customer-billable delivery role — a senior individual contributor accountable for engagement outcomes and hands-on technical leadership, not an internal people-management position.

Strategic Advisory & Executive Alignment


● Serve as trusted advisor to customer CxOs; shape data strategy and the business case

● Own executive discovery, maturity assessment, and the phased, customer-calibrated roadmap

● Frame guidance as adaptable options, meeting customers at their entry point (customer-360,

regulatory governance, analytics modernization, unstructured/RAG)

Architecture Leadership

● Balance platform-agnostic and platform-centric execution — position Salesforce as the center of

gravity while integrating cleanly with the customer's existing multi-vendor technology

investments (data platforms, warehouses, lakes, and tools)

● Approve architecture decisions; validate through scoped POCs before production build

● Ensure value is delivered every phase (no big-bang), with governance-first discipline

● Guarantee dual-consumption design: analytics for people and agentic AI for machines

● Provide architectural governance and quality assurance across concurrent engagements

● Own delivery risk: exec buy-in, business engagement, scope, and dependency management

● Ensure security, privacy, and governance controls are embedded from the start

● Set the standard for AI-augmented professional services delivery — embed AI tools (Claude

Code, Gemini, Lucid AI, NotebookLM) across the full engagement lifecycle to compress effort and

raise quality

● Define the practice's approach to capability-driven (not tool-centric) reusable assets — prompt

templates, skills, and agents that any consultant can run to deliver a capability

● Establish measurable AI-acceleration targets and quality guardrails; institutionalize what works

into the playbook

● Ensure human-at-the-helm governance so AI-accelerated delivery stays trusted, auditable, and

grounded


Industry Thought Leadership (Agentic SaaS Future)

● Own the practice's point of view on the agentic future of the SaaS industry — where enterprise

data, AI agents, and the SaaS ecosystem are heading, and what it means for customers

forward-looking roadmaps for AI-ready, agent-native data foundations

● Represent the practice externally and internally — publish POVs, brief executives, and shape the

market conversation

● Bring experience-based thought leadership into engagements, positioning customers ahead of

the agentic shift

● Author and evolve the Data Foundation Delivery Playbook, accelerators, and reference IP

● Provide hands-on technical leadership to the engagement delivery team; guide Senior Advisors,

Architects, and Consultants on the account

Governance & Handoff

● Establish stewardship, RACI, and sustainable customer operating models

● Ensure executive-ready summaries accompany deep technical detail on every engagement

● Unified Identity & Harmonization — identity resolution, match/merge, golden records

● Master Data Management — domains, survivorship, hierarchies, 360 views

● Unstructured Data Management — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, RAG grounding

● Data Architecture & Semantic Modeling — conceptual/logical/physical models, semantic layer,

glossary

● Data Integration, Orchestration & Activation — API-led connectivity, CDC, real-time events,

activation

● Data Governance & Stewardship — catalog, lineage, data quality, stewardship & policy

integration, and governance

We're hiring DevOps talent across levels — from Senior DevOps Engineer to DevOps Architect — to support enterprise Salesforce implementations. This posting covers both levels; candidates will be matched to the appropriate role based on experience.

The Salesforce DevOps Architect/Engineer is responsible for advising, designing, and managing deployment orchestration solutions for complex Salesforce implementations. This role requires close collaboration with Delivery Managers, Technical Architects, Solution Architects, and Account Teams, as well as direct client engagement to architect and deliver DevOps solutions tailored to client needs.

This is a hands-on role involving both architectural work and, when necessary, deployment execution. You are both a big-picture thinker and an in-depth problem solver, with broad and deep technical expertise, taking pride in designing resilient systems that withstand high volumes and critical demands while balancing technical and enterprise-level considerations.

  • Drive the selection and implementation of DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Lead DevOps design sessions, architect solutions, and document best practices (Architect level); lead setup and execution of DevOps frameworks for small-to-medium projects and support Architects on larger engagements (Senior Engineer level).
  • Develop and enforce DevOps frameworks and governance models for consistency across deployments.

  • Practical fluency with AI coding assistants and modern development/DevOps ecosystems to maximize productivity, automate workflows, document implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, high-quality solutions.
  • Travel to client sites as needed (estimated 50-75%, Architect level).

  • Expert/strong knowledge of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Experience, Industries (Vlocity), and Data Cloud.
  • Strong understanding of environment management, release management, version control best practices, and deployment methodologies.
  • Understanding of branching strategies (Git Flow, Trunk-based development, Feature branching).

Brings a builder mindset, proactively experiments with new AI capabilities, and identifies opportunities to scale the speed, quality, and effectiveness of change.

The Experience


The Internal Audit Organization is an independent and objective function that assists Salesforce to meet its goals through independent reviews and assessments. Specifically, the Internal Audit Organization evaluates and provides recommendations to enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability of the company’s processes, information systems, and underlying internal control environment. The Internal Audit Organization also evaluates and assists in improving the effectiveness of the Company’s risk management and governance processes. This function reports administratively to the President and Chief Operating and Financial Officer (COFO) and directly to the Audit and Finance Committee of the Company’s Board of Directors.


Internal Audit is modernizing the way we perform our audits, using technology, AI, and analytics to fuel the transformation. We are looking for an Internal Auditor to excel with an amazing team to support you. You will have the opportunity to support audit activities for the Company’s technology and product functions (e.g., Business Technology, Engineering, Product Management), with a growing focus on how AI and agentic capabilities are adopted, governed, and controlled across these functions.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

Success will be measured upon the Auditor successfully executing key tasks, including:

  • Support audits that assess risks and controls over AI and agentic capabilities embedded in business processes — including access and authorization, guardrail enforcement, data grounding, third-party AI/LLM dependencies, and Responsible AI considerations
  • Help evaluate how company and customer data is used by AI tools and connected platforms, including data minimization, masking, consent, logging, and monitoring
  • Be intellectually curious and passionate about internal audit, learning about new processes, systems, and technologies (including AI) and how to make them better, driven by “doing the right thing”, effectively maneuver through the organization, influence others, and keep up with a dynamic and fast-changing environment
  • Be a team-oriented individual who can effectively work at all levels within the organization, both within Audit and by collaborating with other 2nd line risk and compliance teams and 1st line business partners
  • Be a “self-starter” with the ability to manage project commitments independently, with minimal oversight
  • Assist Senior Auditors and Audit Managers / Senior Managers with planning and general team functions
  • Assist with planning, fieldwork, and reporting throughout the audit life cycle
  • Develop a strong understanding of Salesforce's business model, processes, systems, and underlying controls, and influence positive change in these areas

    • Comfort adopting and experimenting with new AI/GenAI tools in a controlled, responsible manner (“builder” / Customer-Zero mindset)

  • Highest level of ethics, independence, and professionalism
  • Strong analytical and data analysis skills
  • Ability to work in a high-growth, fast-paced environment, often on multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to work with minimal day-to-day supervision
  • Understanding of business processes related to technology companies
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities
  • Intellectual curiosity 
  • Experience with data analysis and visualization tools, such as Tableau (including Tableau Next), and modern data platforms 
  • Experience auditing IT general controls
  • Exposure to auditing or using AI/ML systems, LLM-based applications, or agentic workflows 
  • Comfortable working and supporting a fully global, multicultural, and distributed team
  • Knowledge about cloud computing, AI, or technology businesses and processes

Even Better If...

  • CPA, CIA,CISA, or other relevant audit certifications, including AI-audit / AI-governance certifications (e.g., ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent)

Preferred Locations
