title: Salesforce 架構師 (Salesforce Architect)
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience
我們正在尋找對協助客戶進行數位轉型與業務流程優化有熱情、有想法的夥伴。您將主導從企業系統願景規劃、策略擬定，到實際導入與落地運行的完整流程，並帶領客戶與團隊運用 Salesforce 平台實現業務願景與目標。同時，您也將有機會持續接觸最前沿的 AI 與 CRM 趨勢及技術，拓展專業能力和職涯邊界。

職位特色

  • 結合策略規劃及落地執行：作為顧問或主要合作夥伴（Prime Vendor）的角色，參與具代表性的轉型專案，從前期策略規劃到實際導入上線，協助客戶將轉型藍圖落實為可執行的成果。
  • 應用前沿 AI 技術：協助客戶評估與導入 Agentforce 等新一代 AI 解決方案。使用各式 AI 工具，提升分析深度、設計品質與交付效率。
  • 端到端 (End-to-End) 參與：從願景規劃、架構設計到上線後的落地運行與持續優化，參與專案各個關鍵階段，累積完整且具深度的實戰經驗。


主要角色類型
依據您的專業背景，入職後將主要參與以下其中一類角色：

  • PM (Project Manager/Engagement Delivery Manager)：負責專案規劃、進度推動與交付管理。
  • BA (Business Architect)：負責商業策略、流程設計與應用推廣。
  • SA (Solution Architect)：負責整體解決方案、資料模型與多雲架構設計。
  • TA (Technical Architect)：負責技術架構、系統整合、資安與效能優化。


What You'll Actually Be Doing
本職位將根據專案需求及您的專業領域，參與以下各階段的任務：

  • A. 戰略與轉型設計 (Strategy & Change Design)：負責制定組織及系統整體的轉型構想與藍圖。組織與業務領域轉型設計：策劃業務流程改革及組織變革的整體架構。規劃組織與業務流程轉型方向，協助客戶建立整體藍圖。系統領域轉型設計：設計企業 IT 架構與 Salesforce 平台發展策略。Salesforce Org 戰略：制定 Salesforce Org（Instance）的活用戰略、治理戰略及發展藍圖規劃 Salesforce Org 的治理模式、使用策略與長期發展方向。Salesforce CTO 顧問：從企業架構或 CTO 顧問角度，協助客戶推動 AI 與數位轉型。變革推動與應用推廣落地：規劃變革管理與推動方案，應用推廣，提升解決方案導入後的落地成效。概念驗證 (PoC)：參與 PoC 設計與驗證，評估方案可行性。
  • B. 專案執行與支援 (Project Execution & Support)：從需求定義到上線發佈，在各階段提供支援或執行實務工作。根據專案特性選擇瀑布式（Waterfall）或敏捷式（Agile）開發。專案管理：參與專案規劃、進度推動與執行管理。需求定義：進行需求訪談、需求分析與流程引導。設計：主導或參與應用設計、架構設計與詳細設計，並審查相關成果。開發與測試：領導實作與測試工作，或制定開發標準及品質管理流程。遷移與部署：執行資料遷移與部署上線，或制定遷移策略並支援執行。CI/CD：協助建立開發標準，開發環境設計、構建與運維等 DevOps 流程。
  • C. 治理與最佳化 (Governance & Optimization)Salesforce 治理 (Governance)：協助建立 Salesforce 治理機制與 CoE (Center of Excellence) 運作模式。設計權威 (Design Authority)：建立或參與設計審查與架構治理流程，確保設計品質。設計品質最佳實踐 (Best Practice)：提供設計最佳實務與優化建議，提升專案交付品質。架構最佳化 (Architecture Optimization)：針對既有環境進行 Org 健檢、架構診斷與最佳化建議。



You're Our Person If...

  • 實務經驗：在以下任一領域具備 7 年以上的實務經驗，並曾擔任主要推動角色：A. 策略規劃與轉型設計 (Strategy & Change Design)；B. 治理與持續優化 (Governance & Optimization)；C. 專案推動與執行 (Project Execution & Support)
  • 領導力：具備 3 年以上團隊帶領或專案領導經驗（職稱不限）。
  • 溝通能力：能與客戶高階主管（含C-Level）及相關利害關係人進行有效溝通，推動共識形成與專案進展。
  • 溝通能力：具備良好的跨部門及跨角色溝通與協作能力，能與不同成員有效合作。
  • 學習及理解力：能快速理解業務需求、Salesforce 相關技術概念及專案方法
  • 學習及理解力：具備學習新技術的意願與行動力，並願意善用 AI 工具提升工作效率與產出品質
  • 核心思維：具備實踐「批判性思考 (Critical Thinking)」與「歸零學習 (Unlearning)」的能力。
  • 核心思維：不過度執著於過去的成功經驗，能針對 AI 等新技術靈活調整自身的思考模式與方法論。
  • 語言能力：中文：母語等級。
  • 語言能力：英文：商務英文溝通能力。



Even Better If...

  • AI 與數據領域實務經驗：具備 AI、資料應用、資料治理或 AI Agent 相關專案經驗。
  • 全球化專案執行能力：具備以英文進行專案溝通與跨國協作的實務經驗。
  • 運用 AI 提升業務效率之績效：曾在顧問服務或系統建置過程中，實際運用 AI 工具提升工作效率或交付品質。
  • 認證：具備 Salesforce 相關認證者佳，如 Application Architect 或 System Architect等



本職位提供的職涯價值

  • 成長為全方位架構師： 透過參與不同階段的轉型專案，累積策略規劃、架構設計、專案交付與治理優化等完整實務經驗。
  • 拓展 AI 與 CRM 專業能力： 持續接觸 AI 與 CRM 領域的最新趨勢與技術應用，拓展專業深度與職涯發展空間。
  • 累積關鍵轉型專案歷練： 透過參與具挑戰性與代表性的客戶專案，強化架構判斷、跨部門協作與專案推動能力。
  • 發展多元職涯方向： 我們將依據您的專業背景、職涯方向與個人特質，提供合適的發展機會與成長舞台。

The Experience
We are looking for passionate, forward-thinking partners who want to help customers with digital transformation and business process optimization. You will lead the full journey, from enterprise system vision and strategy through to actual implementation and live operation, guiding customers and teams to use the Salesforce platform to achieve their business vision and goals. You will also keep getting exposure to the latest AI and CRM trends and technologies, expanding your professional capabilities and career boundaries.

Role Highlights

  • Strategy and execution combined: As a consultant or Prime Vendor, take part in representative transformation projects, from early-stage strategic planning through to go-live, helping customers turn their transformation blueprint into actionable results.
  • Apply cutting-edge AI: Help customers evaluate and adopt next-generation AI solutions such as Agentforce. Use a range of AI tools to improve analytical depth, design quality, and delivery efficiency.
  • End-to-end involvement: Take part in every key project phase, from vision planning and architecture design to post-launch operation and continuous optimization, building complete and in-depth hands-on experience.



Role Types
Based on your background, after joining you will mainly take on one of the following roles:

  • PM (Project Manager/Engagement Delivery Manager): Responsible for project planning, driving progress, and delivery management.
  • BA (Business Architect): Responsible for business strategy, process design, and adoption.
  • SA (Solution Architect): Responsible for the overall solution, data model, and multi-cloud architecture design.
  • TA (Technical Architect): Responsible for technical architecture, system integration, security, and performance optimization.



What You'll Actually Be Doing
Depending on project needs and your area of expertise, you will take part in tasks across the following phases:

  • A. Strategy & Change Design: Define the overall transformation vision and blueprint for the organization and its systems.Organization and business transformation design: Plan the overall framework for business process reform and organizational change. Plan the direction of organizational and process transformation and help customers build the overall blueprint.System transformation design: Design the enterprise IT architecture and Salesforce platform development strategy.Salesforce Org strategy: Define the utilization strategy, governance strategy, and development roadmap for the Salesforce Org (Instance), including its governance model, usage strategy, and long-term direction.Salesforce CTO advisory: Help customers drive AI and digital transformation from an enterprise architecture or CTO advisor perspective.Change enablement and adoption: Plan change management and enablement programs and drive adoption to improve results after the solution is introduced.Proof of Concept (PoC): Take part in PoC design and validation to assess solution feasibility.
  • B. Project Execution & Support: Provide support or hands-on work at every stage, from requirements definition to release. Waterfall or Agile development is chosen based on the nature of the project.Project management: Take part in project planning, driving progress, and execution management.Requirements definition: Conduct requirements interviews, requirements analysis, and process facilitation.Design: Lead or take part in application design, architecture design, and detailed design, and review related deliverables.Development and testing: Lead implementation and testing, or define development standards and quality management processes.Migration and deployment: Carry out data migration and deployment to production, or define the migration strategy and support its execution.CI/CD: Help establish development standards and DevOps processes such as development environment design, build, and operations.
  • C. Governance & OptimizationSalesforce Governance: Help establish Salesforce governance mechanisms and the operating model of a CoE (Center of Excellence).Design Authority: Establish or take part in design review and architecture governance processes to ensure design quality.Design quality best practices: Provide design best practices and optimization recommendations to improve project delivery quality.Architecture Optimization: Run Org health checks, architecture diagnostics, and optimization recommendations for existing environments.


You're Our Person If...

  • Hands-on experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in any one of the following areas, having served in a main driving role: A. Strategy & Change Design; B. Governance & Optimization; C. Project Execution & Support
  • Leadership: 3+ years of experience leading teams or projects (title not required).
  • Communication: Able to communicate effectively with customer senior executives (including C-level) and relevant stakeholders, building consensus and moving projects forward.
  • Communication: Strong cross-department and cross-role communication and collaboration skills, able to work effectively with different members.
  • Learning and comprehension: Able to quickly understand business needs, Salesforce-related technical concepts, and project methodologies
  • Learning and comprehension: Willing and proactive in learning new technologies, and willing to use AI tools to improve efficiency and output quality
  • Core mindset: Able to practice critical thinking and unlearning.
  • Core mindset: Not overly attached to past successes, and able to flexibly adjust your thinking and methodology for new technologies such as AI.
  • Language: Chinese: native level.
  • Language: English: business-level communication skills.


Even Better If...

  • AI and data experience: Experience in projects involving AI, data applications, data governance, or AI agents.
  • Global project execution: Hands-on experience with project communication and cross-border collaboration in English.
  • Results from using AI to improve efficiency: Have actually used AI tools to improve efficiency or delivery quality in consulting services or system implementation.
  • Certifications: Salesforce-related certifications preferred, such as Application Architect or System Architect.


What This Role Offers for Your Career

  • Grow into a full-spectrum architect: Build complete hands-on experience in strategic planning, architecture design, project delivery, and governance optimization by taking part in transformation projects at different stages.
  • Expand AI and CRM expertise: Keep up with the latest trends and applications in AI and CRM to deepen your expertise and widen your career path.

The role also supports monthly and quarterly processes and shares responsibility for SOX compliance, the integration of acquired entities, and system projects within the Revenue Recognition team. You will complement the digital experience with tactile elements. This position requires someone who has great technical understanding as well as interpersonal skills to work with many different departments within the company. You’ll spend time with product teams designing and prototyping future features and product launches of Salesforce products. You're naturally curious and experiment with technologies like AI, robotics, image processing, beacons, AR, blockchain and more. We're always looking at how to push Salesforce products to empower people to solve more of the world's challenges.
Join our team of dreamers & doers and get ready to create high quality, interactive product visions that will be experienced by customers, business leaders and technologists all around the world.


Responsibilities:

  • Partner closely with product marketers, demo architects, and designers to understand the product strategy and distill key functionality and benefits into engaging demo experiences
  • Develop innovative and compelling/palpable stories and demonstrations that showcase the power of Salesforce
  • Ideate and build prototypes for important Salesforce product launches

  • Optimize display settings and UI treatments for large-venue legibility (opacity transitions, screen bezels, resolution standards)
  • Support speakers during rehearsals and provide technical coaching on demo execution

  • Experience with Java, Python or similar lenguages
  • Familiarity with tools such as Git, Heroku, and AWS
  • Driven, self-motivated, and flexible team player with proven ability to lead/inspire through influence
  • Creative thinker that can generate innovative ideas and lead a cross-functional team to drive execution
  • A proven track record in the design, development and delivery of creative and engineering concepts
  • Experience implementing from concept to production through field installation for small to medium projects

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner equally with Product Marketing Managers and Designers within your working group — you share ownership of demo success
  • Build deep relationships with Salesforce product engineering teams to stay ahead of feature availability, GA timelines, and known limitations
  • Coordinate with production teams (show callers, video directors, AV specialists) on technical integration and timing
  • Communicate proactively with stakeholders about build status, risks, and tradeoffs — especially when live stage demos require explicit escalation to product teams
  • Collaborate with localization teams for multi-language and multi-market demo delivery

Technical Strategy & Innovation

  • Evaluate emerging Salesforce features and recommend which to showcase in upcoming demos
  • Make architectural decisions about build approaches: real product vs. mocked, single-org vs. multi-org, live vs. static
  • Contribute to the team's proof pattern library covering core enterprise scenarios
  • Contribute to the teams enablement and distribution documentation for SE and global events
  • Drive continuous improvement in demo stability, build efficiency, and technical quality
  • Partner with development team members on complex builds

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience building live product demonstrations for large audiences (conferences, keynotes, executive briefings, or webinars)
  • Experience with Slack platform development (Slack apps, Slackbot skills, workspace administration, federation)
  • Knowledge of Tableau integration and data visualization
  • Ability to turn high fidelity designs into functional prototypes using HTML/HTML5, CSS/CSS3, Javascript
  • Experience developing on the Salesforce platform (Aura, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Administration etc.) - MUST
  • Experience with Salesforce unit testing and package management - MUST
  • Experience developing user interfaces in non-traditional formats such large format screens, car dashboards, AR/VR etc.
  • Strong object orient programming background
  • Familiarity with backend development concepts such as creating servers, REST APIs, and microservices
  • Familiarity with iOS, xCode, and Swift development
  • Experience designing, specifying, integrating, and testing cutting edge hardware with software APIs
  • Collaborate and communicate on multiple, complex projects concurrently, with a team of designers, developers and marketers from concept to completion


What Makes This Role Unique
This is not a typical Software Engineer position. Here's what sets it apart:

  • Innovation: You'll be among the first to work with unreleased features and shape how the world first sees new Salesforce capabilities
  • Impact: When done right, your demos don't just impress — they become the reference architecture that customers and partners adopt

The CSM works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

This role specializes in guiding organizations through seamless migrations from legacy marketing automation platforms—including Granicus GovDelivery, Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Engagement—to Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next and Salesforce Data Cloud. By identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, the CSM strategically aligns solutions with the customer’s top priorities, projects, and goals.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

We are looking for candidates who have experience supporting customers in one or more of the following industries:

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

  • Develop strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership, acting as a trusted advisor by understanding the customer’s business model and applying proven solutions to their problems.
  • Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder, identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume tiers), and align platform features with customer priorities.

  • Proactively monitor, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement. As a Principal AI Architect (or AI and Data Technical Architect), you will act as a senior, hands-on technical leader and trusted advisor to our customers. You will be responsible for designing, validating, and operationalizing enterprise-grade data and AI architectures centered on Salesforce D360 and the Agentforce platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.

Responsibilities

  • Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.
  • Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.
  • Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.
  • Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.
  • Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.

  • Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.
  • Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.
  • Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.
  • Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.
  • Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.
  • Advise on Data & Integration - Integrate Data Cloud (D360), CRM, MuleSoft APIs, and external agent endpoints ensuring cohesive architectures that align with compliance and governance policies.
  • Support Early Adoption - Occasionally assist in proof-of-value engagements post-sale by tuning agents and guiding customers toward self-sufficient enablement.
  • Own Technical Architecture Decisions - Oversee data modeling, identity resolution, real-time vs. batch patterns, data graph design, and activation strategies within D360.
  • Own Technical Enablement - Create and manage accessible technical documentation, knowledge bases, and FAQ resources to rapidly resolve internal technical inquiries, empowering specialist teams to handle technical discussions confidently.

  • Technical Pre-Sales & Solution Engineering: 7+ years in customer-facing technical pre-sales, solution architecture, or technical advisory, partnering side-by-side with Account Executives (AEs) to drive enterprise deal cycles and business outcomes.
  • Enterprise AI & Hyperscaler Ecosystem Depth: Proven experience designing and delivering AI, GenAI, and Data architectures within platforms such as AWS (Bedrock/SageMaker), Microsoft (Azure AI Foundry/Copilot), Databricks, Google Cloud (Vertex AI), Snowflake, or Palantir.
  • Hands-On Modern AI & Agentic Builder Experience: Direct hands-on experience building, prototyping, or solutioning with frontier LLMs and modern AI tools—including OpenAI, Claude, LangChain / LangGraph, Cursor, or multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Agent Interoperability & Open Standards: Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, background/conversational agents, voice AI integrations, or open protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol - MCP, A2A).
  • Rapid Prototyping & Whiteboarding: Demonstrated ability to lead technical discovery workshops and co-create rapid proof-of-value prototypes (<2 weeks) for C-suite stakeholders (CDO, CTO, Enterprise Architects).
  • Location: Based in London, UK (hybrid model).

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have):

    • CRM / Salesforce Context: Prior familiarity or hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Agentforce Studio, or Data Cloud (D360).
    • Multi-Modal & Advanced AI Frameworks: Experience with voice pipelines, MLOps, vector search, or custom model fine-tuning.

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. Who are we looking for?

  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
  • You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & Norwegian (essential)

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations

  • During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
  • If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond.
  • Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

Examples of what you can expect during the rotations


Sales Graduate Rotation

  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation

  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

What’s in it for you?

  • A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years


With the EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path, you can continue to progress:

  • After your Grad Program Rotations you can progress to Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative and then Account Executive, where you will position our solutions to potential customers. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change.

This role focuses on identifying root causes, architectural weaknesses, and recurring security anti-patterns, and implementing secure-by-default solutions that prevent vulnerabilities.

You will work alongside engineering teams to analyze design decisions, improve security posture, and support overall application security maturity.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Conduct offensive security assessments (manual testing, code review, architectural analysis, threat modeling) across application ecosystems.
  • Identify critical, high-impact, and systemic vulnerabilities alongside isolated issues.
  • Perform security research to identify emerging attack vectors, abuse cases, and bypass techniques relevant to our applications and platforms.
  • Partner closely with software engineers, tech leads, and architects to:Explain risk, impact, and exploitability.Design and implement effective remediations.Ensure fixes are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with engineering realities.
  • Execute Secure by Default initiatives by:Applying security guardrails, patterns, and baseline controls.Remediating insecure defaults and unsafe configurations.Preventing vulnerabilities through platform-level and framework-level updates.
  • Review application and platform designs early in the development lifecycle to prevent vulnerabilities before release.
  • Apply security standards, best practices, and architectural guidance during application development.
  • Share security knowledge and offensive techniques with engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with detection, monitoring, and incident response teams to improve visibility into real-world exploitation.

  • Demonstrated experience finding and remediating vulnerabilities in complex applications.
  • Strong understanding of:Web application security (OWASP Top 10 and beyond)Authentication & authorization flawsAPI securityInjection attacks, logic flaws, and access control bypassesSecure design and threat modeling
  • Hands-on experience with manual security testing (beyond automated tools).

  • 顧客経営層とのスムーズなコミュニケーション能力をお持ちの方

Even Better If...

  • 特定の業界、事業部門(LoB)、またはクラウドにおける深い専門知識をお持ちの方

As an IC, Program Executives hold no direct reports, and yet expertly lead large numbers of our most senior talent across our most complex Life Sciences customer engagements: multi-workstream transformations, strategic accounts, and enterprise implementations where the margin for error is narrow and the consequences of failure are visible at the C-suite.
The PE is fully allocated to a single flagship Life Sciences transformation program or a set of strategic accounts. They own the end-to-end program P&L, lead the Salesforce project team, run the steering committee, manage the executive customer relationship, manage scope, govern the budget, and surface risk before it becomes an escalation. The ideal candidate brings a deep background in Life Sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech, or related sectors) combined with IT or management consulting delivery experience, leveraging that industry credibility as a strategic advisor to customers, partners, and internal teams across Salesforce.
Life Sciences Program Executives sit at the helm of AI and Agentforce transformations that accelerate drug commercialization, streamline field engagement, and modernize clinical and commercial operations through intelligent, autonomous agents. They lead cross-functional teams deploying digital workforces that bridge the gap between complex Life Sciences data and actionable business outcomes, driving the next frontier of Life Sciences innovation.
Their success is defined by what they deliver, what they prevent, and the customer confidence they command.

Your Impact
* AI and agentic delivery are embedded in how you work: you actively leverage AI tooling and agentic workflows to optimize how your program teams deliver. You reduce manual overhead, accelerate insight, and model the productivity gains Life Sciences customers are investing in Salesforce to achieve.

* Customer outcomes are owned with clear accountability: you are the executive-facing delivery contact for your engagement and are responsible for communications with the client and within Salesforce up to the CxO level regarding expectations, performance, governance, and issue escalation and resolution. * The delivery team performs at a higher level because you're in it: you effectively lead, inspire, and uplift Salesforce Professional Services team members, coaching them to perform at a higher level while contributing to the internal processes, artifacts, and methodologies that raise the floor for service delivery across our most strategic Life Sciences accounts. * Value delivered translates into real adoption and consumption: you drive the transformational changes, especially around AI and agentic capabilities, needed to achieve customers' objectives, informed by deep Life Sciences industry and product expertise. You align IT strategy, governance, processes, and stakeholder decisions to ensure adoption and consumption directly deliver measurable customer impact.
* Risk is managed before it manages you: you anticipate, mitigate, and manage risk to Salesforce and the customer, taking decisive program action to address risk profiles. You raise signals with a recommended path, not just a problem statement. Surfacing a risk is success; being surprised by one is not.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full Lifecycle Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer engagement across the complete value lifecycle — Identify → Commit → Deploy → Consume — owning outcomes at every stage, not just discovery or deal closure
  • AI Strategy & Architecture: Define the customer's Agentic AI strategy and roadmap. Lead design workshops, agent design sessions, and jobs-to-be-done analysis. Architect solutions spanning Salesforce's agentic AI platform, Data Cloud, and enterprise systems, with responsible AI governance baked in from the start.
  • Deployment Oversight & Program Management: Manage engagement delivery end-to-end timelines, stakeholder communication, risk escalation, and progress reporting. You are the operational backbone of your delivery team, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Adoption & Consumption: Own adoption, consumption, and expansion metrics within your engagement scope. Identify blockers early and develop strategies to drive measurable value realization
  • Delivery Team Coordination: Partner closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on your team to align strategy with technical execution. Keep the team focused, unblocked, and on track to hit delivery milestones.
  • AI-Supported Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions supported by leading-edge AI tools: Including
  • Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development. 
  • Customer Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary customer-facing contact, building trust-based relationships with senior stakeholders and present proposals, decisions and outcomes in terms of business value, not just technical detail.
  • AI Readiness: Assess customer readiness for AI adoption and guide change management and process transformation to maximise the benefits of intelligent agents
  • Product Feedback Loop: Synthesise field insights and translate them into actionable product feedback that influences Salesforce's Agentic AI platform roadmap.


Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years experience in strategic solutioning, technical advisory, or delivery leadership or programme management for enterprise cloud or SaaS technology
  • You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Prior customer-facing delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or technical advisory) - this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have
  • Demonstrated understanding of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem, including Agentic AI capabilities and Data Cloud
  • Working knowledge of one or more programming languages: Python, JavaScript, Java, or Apex
  • Proven ability to lead and own complex, ambiguous engagements end-to-end — from discovery through to measurable outcomes
  • Experience leading AI/LLM solution design, including agentic AI strategy, conversation design, and responsible AI practices
  • Strong project and programme management skills — ability to run multiple workstreams, manage stakeholder expectations, and keep delivery on track in ambiguous environments
  • Ability to travel 25% of the time to customer sites


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, Agentforce platform, and Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, Marketing)
  • Experience designing and deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e.g., public sector, financial services, healthcare)

Un impact client dès le premier jour. Une vision stratégique claire et une exécution qui dure.

This role is designed for a versatile expert who thrives at the absolute intersection of customer relationship management and rigorous technical execution. You will act as a trusted advisor, bridging the gap between the customer’s legacy environment and their future-state platform by aggressively driving the adoption of automated playbooks and cutting-edge AI tools to dramatically compress delivery timelines. Beyond execution, you serve as a critical voice of the customer within the migration team feedback loop, systematically capturing real-world field insights, user friction, and system limitations to advocate directly to Product and Engineering for tool optimization. By orchestrating a unified front between the client, the account team, and your GDC engineering partners, you ensure that every engagement eliminates bespoke manual effort in favor of scalable, automated transformation.


Responsibilities

Customer Engagement and Value Alignment

  • Serve as the primary lead for customer migration engagements, responsible for the technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.

  • Partner closely with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration technical goals with the broader customer business strategy and renewal/expansion targets.

  • AI-Driven Delivery: Drive the adoption and usage of toolkits, using AI agents and automation to accelerate discovery, mapping, and code conversion.
  • GDC Collaboration: Partner deeply with the Global Delivery Center (GDC) team, offloading repeatable technical tasks while maintaining overall accountability for the quality of the output.

You will own feature-level work on the pipelines that discover vulnerable packages, decide what to upgrade, open fix PRs across many repositories, and track those fixes through to deployed production artifacts.

Pipeline Development & Operations


  • Contribute to data pipelines that ingest vulnerability data, dependency manifests, SBOM artifacts, and deployment metadata into a queryable analytics store.

  • Operate what you ship: on-call for the pipelines you own, debug production failures, and reduce toil through automation.

Repository-wide Automation


  • Build scripts and small services that interact with many repositories at once — opening PRs, parsing diffs, reading CI feedback, and reconciling the results back into a central store.
  • Author and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated test coverage so remediation PRs can be reviewed and merged with confidence.
  • Resolve attribution issues at the source rather than patching symptoms downstream.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Write clear design docs, runbooks, and PR descriptions; keep documentation current when behavior changes.

Quality & Growth


  • Write Python and Java code that matches the conventions of the existing codebase and holds up under review.
  • Add regression tests for every bug you fix; treat failing tests as signal rather than noise.
  • Learn the supply chain domain on the job — vulnerability lifecycle, dependency resolution, artifact provenance — and bring that knowledge back into the pipelines you build.

Required Skills / Experience

  • Industry Experience: 3+ years in software engineering with strong proficiency in Python and Java, and reading-fluency in at least two of Node.js, Go, and Ruby.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Hands-on experience contributing to data pipelines — batch or streaming — including writing idempotent steps and reasoning about retries.
  • CI/CD: Direct experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with automated test coverage.
  • Repo-wide Automation: Comfort writing scripts or small services that interact with many repositories — opening PRs, parsing diffs, handling CI feedback.
  • Workflow Orchestration and Query Engines: Experience with a workflow orchestrator (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Temporal) and a lakehouse / columnar query engine (Trino, Presto, Spark, Snowflake, BigQuery, Athena, Databricks, or Iceberg).
  • SQL: Non-trivial joins, window functions, CTEs.
  • Individual Impact: End-to-end ownership at the feature level — design, implementation, deployment, and the maintenance work that follows.
  • Educational Background: B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Preferred / Bonus Skills

  • Supply Chain Security Standards: Working familiarity with CVE, CVSS v3, EPSS, KEV (CISA), and SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX)
  • Scanner & Remediation Tooling: Direct experience with at least two of Snyk, Trivy, Grype, Dependabot, Renovate, Semgrep SCA, OSV-Scanner, or Dependency-Track.

Your work will help teams adopt AI safely and effectively, improve developer productivity, and avoid solving the same platform problems independently.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

Set architecture and adoption direction for MCP, including server and client patterns, tool discovery, interoperability, identity, authorization, and lifecycle management.
  • Define reusable platform capabilities for agent orchestration, tool and skill integration, agent runtimes, state and memory, human oversight, evaluation, and production operations.
  • Set technical direction for agentic framework adoption, including the use of Mastra AI and LangChain/LangGraph. Guide framework integration and evolution while keeping the platform coherent, extensible, and adaptable to new approaches.
  • Establish patterns that help teams move from prototypes to dependable production agents, with clear paths for customization, evaluation, observability, and ongoing improvement.
  • Drive new AI-enabled developer experiences across the SDLC, including code understanding and generation, test creation, code review, debugging, modernization, documentation, and release or operational workflows.
  • Define how MCP fits into agent runtimes and the broader platform, enabling agents to connect to enterprise tools and systems through secure, governed, and reusable integrations.
  • Define the architecture and evolution of a secure, extensible LLM Model Gateway that provides consistent model access, policy enforcement, observability, resilience, and governance across providers and deployment types.
  • Drive a cost-effective model portfolio spanning small language models (SLMs) and large language models (LLMs). Evaluate when to use hosted, open-weight, fine-tuned, or specialized models for different workloads.
  • Develop ways to measure and improve model economics, including cost per successful task, token and context efficiency, retry rates, inference utilization, and the impact of model or routing changes.
  • Own the strategy for context engineering and enterprise knowledge management so agents can access relevant, grounded, and permission-aware information.
  • Guide the architecture of enterprise retrieval systems, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Graph RAG, and determine how they work with enterprise data, knowledge sources, and agent workflows.
  • Set shared standards for security, privacy, governance, reliability, observability, evaluation, and human oversight across agents, models, tools, and data.

  • Align engineering, product, security, data, and infrastructure partners around platform strategy, adoption, and delivery.
  • Communicate architectural decisions clearly, influence across teams, and mentor engineers and technical leaders.
  • Design complex systems where AI agents fit smoothly into human workflows, and ship secure, high-quality software with AI as a core part of your own development workflow. Build and maintain the shared system context that lets AI work accurately, and review code, whether written by people or AI, for correctness, quality, security, and performance.

  • You have strong expertise in agentic platform architecture and experience creating platform capabilities that make agent development and operation effective for application teams.
  • You have hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as Mastra AI and LangChain/LangGraph, including the ability to evaluate their tradeoffs and establish scalable platform patterns.
  • You have experience designing model gateways, inference platforms, model-serving systems, model orchestration layers, or equivalent shared services.
  • You have experience evaluating models against real workloads, with a practical understanding of quality, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost tradeoffs.
  • You are familiar with SLMs, LLMs, model routing, fine-tuning, quantization, inference optimization, or other ways to improve cost and performance.
  • You have experience building enterprise knowledge or retrieval systems using RAG, Graph RAG, search, or related approaches.
  • You have experience designing application programming interfaces (APIs) and extensible integration patterns. Familiarity with MCP or comparable tool and protocol ecosystems is a plus.
  • You have expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as identity and authorization, data platforms, retrieval and search, context management, workflow orchestration, platform security, or developer experience.

  • You use sound judgment around security, privacy, reliability, performance, and operational cost in fast-changing technical environments.
  • You have strong communication skills and the ability to build alignment across engineering, product, security, and business teams.
  • You bring a genuine AI-first approach to engineering. You use AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor to move faster and work across the stack, and you write precise, structured prompts that make AI output reliable, secure, and production-ready.
  • A related technical degree required.

The Experience

職務の目的「グローバル標準手法とAIを駆使し、日本のデリバリーの変革を自ら主導する」

本ポジションは、グローバル標準手法である Salesforce Professional Services Methodology (SPSM) をベースに、グローバルの Global Delivery Center (GDC) が主導する AI-Native Delivery（AI-Native Agentic Delivery）を自ら主導し、日本の Delivery Method の変革を通じてお客様のビジネス成果を支援する役割です。

AI-Native Delivery とは、従来の「人が一つひとつ手作業で構築する」デリバリーから、「AIエージェントが技術成果物（メタデータ・設定・コード・テスト・ドキュメント等）を生成し、人が意図の定義・検証・承認・ガバナンスに注力する」新しいデリバリーモデルへの転換を指します。GDCが世界規模で確立したこのモデルを日本市場に導入・定着させ、日本のデリバリーのあり方そのものを変革することが最大のミッションです。

お客様にとっての Trusted Guide（信頼できるガイド）として、業務の可視化と意図の明確化を起点に、Agentforce をはじめとする Salesforce ソリューションの設計・構築・検証・本番展開・定着化・内製化までを一貫してリードし、お客様のビジネス成果と ROI（投資対効果）を最大化します。

本ポジションの特徴

(1) SPSMをベースにGDC主導のAI-Native Deliveryを自ら主導し、日本のデリバリーを変革する

グローバル標準手法である SPSM を土台に、GDCがグローバルで確立した AI-Native Delivery を、日本のお客様のプロジェクトで自ら主導します。単にグローバルの手法を適用するだけでなく、日本固有のビジネスコンテキストや商習慣に合わせて最適化し、日本の Delivery Method そのものの変革をリードします。GDCの世界水準の技術力・知見と密に連携しながら、日本市場における AI-Native Delivery の推進役を担います。

(2) AI-Nativeプロジェクトのデリバリーを主要な工程で自ら主導する

AIエージェントによる自動化（agentic automation）を、エンドツーエンドのAIプロジェクトデリバリーの主要な工程に適用し、デリバリーのタイムラインを大幅に加速します。要件分析／ユーザーストーリー作成／意思決定の記録／自動ビルド・デプロイ／オブザーバビリティという5つの主要な工程でエージェンティックな自動化を活用し、各工程でAIが生成・実行し人が検証・承認する「AI generates, humans decide（AIが生成し、人が判断する）」を実践します。生成の速さと人による品質統制を両立させ、Trusted Guide として工程全体を主導します。

(3) AI-Native Delivery を軸に、広範な技術領域へ拡大する

技術領域は Agentforce にとどまらず、Data Cloud、Salesforce プラットフォーム全般（Sales / Service / Marketing）、外部AIサービス連携まで広がります。AIツール群を適材適所で活用し、デリバリーのスピードと品質を両立させます。従来型と比べて高い生産性を実現し、短いサイクルでの開発サイクルを推進します。

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • AI-Native Delivery の主導と日本市場への定着 GDCがグローバルで確立した AI-Native Delivery と SPSM を、日本のお客様のプロジェクトで自ら主導する。日本固有のビジネスコンテキストに合わせて手法を最適化・適用し、日本の Delivery Method の変革をリードする。
  • AI-Nativeプロジェクトのデリバリー（agentic automationの活用） エンドツーエンドのAIプロジェクトデリバリーを加速するため、以下の主要な工程でAIエージェントによる自動化を活用し、各工程を主導する。要件分析: 複雑なお客様要件の抽出・分析・構造化を高速化し、手作業による認識合わせのループを最小化する。ユーザーストーリー作成: 詳細で着手可能なユーザーストーリーと受入基準を自動生成し、スプリント計画の時間を大幅に短縮する。意思決定の記録: 重要なアーキテクチャ上の決定や設計上の選択を自動的に文書化し、継続的で信頼できる「唯一の情報源（source of truth）」を維持する。自動ビルド・デプロイ: エージェンティックなワークフローにより、コード生成・CI/CDパイプライン・環境構築を効率化する。オブザーバビリティ: 能動的なモニタリングとトレーシングを実装し、エージェントの最適なパフォーマンス・信頼性、およびデプロイ後の迅速なトラブルシューティングを確保する。
  • 品質統制 AIエージェントが生成したメタデータ・設定・コード・テスト・ドキュメントを レビューし、検証し、承認する。生成の速さだけでは価値にならず、人による検証と承認をセットにして初めて成果になるという原則を徹底する。LLMの柔軟性とルールベースの正確性の境界を見極め、ハイブリッドなアプローチで決定論的に制御する。
  • 成果ベースのデモンストレーション ステータス報告資料ではなく、実際に動作するソフトウェア（実画面・実フロー・実データ）でビルドの成果を実証する。
  • GDCとの協働 グローバルのGDCと密に連携し、その世界水準の技術力・知見を活かしながらデリバリーを推進する。お客様と直接対話してスコープを合意し、GDC側へは日本固有のコンテキストを排除した明確で誤解のない指示として伝達する。



You're Our Person If...

  • 実務経験: 5-11年以上のエンタープライズ・システムにおけるコンサルティング、または要件定義から設計・開発・テスト・本番移行に至る構築プロセスの主導的な実務経験。
  • IT構築プロセスの理解: 戦略策定・意図定義から要件定義、設計・開発・テスト・移行に至る一連のプロセスの深い知見。
  • AIリテラシーと実務活用経験: AI・LLMを活用したソリューション構築、またはAIツール群を用いた実務効率化の経験。「推論・確率ベース」と「ルールベース」の双方の基礎理解。
  • 論理的コミュニケーション力: 意図を明確に言語化し、お客様やチームと合意形成できる力。
  • 言語能力:日本語: 流暢（お客様と円滑に合意形成できること）英語: ビジネスレベル（GDCのメンバーと技術的な詳細を議論・指示できること）



Even Better If...

  • 業務分析・モデリング（UML / BPMN / DMN 等）の経験
  • 顧客折衝・合意形成、エンタープライズアーキテクチャの経験
  • API／インテグレーション設計、新技術導入提案・PoC の経験
  • Salesforce プラットフォーム（Apex / Flow / Data Cloud）の開発経験
  • Agentforce をはじめとする対話型AI・エージェント開発（プロンプトエンジニアリング、AIオーケストレーション、エージェントフレームワーク）の経験
  • 異文化環境での協働経験、およびインドGDC等の海外技術者と英語で協働した経験
  • Salesforce 認定資格（Administrator / Platform Developer / Application・System Architect 等）



SPSMをベースにGDC主導のAI-Native Deliveryを自ら主導し、日本のデリバリーの変革を通じてお客様のビジネス成果を支援します。特定の役割に固定されず、AI-Native Delivery の全フェーズを幅広く担当します。

本ポジションで得られる経験グローバル標準手法（SPSM）とAI-Native Deliveryを、自ら主導して日本市場に導入・変革する実務経験AI・データを前提とした最先端デリバリーモデルの専門性意図定義から定着化までを一貫して担う、業務変革の実務経験複数の技術領域を横断する総合的なコンサルティング能力グローバルチーム（GDC）と協働し、グローバル標準手法を日本市場に適用する経験

求める人物像AIを武器にできる方: 従来のやり方に固執せず、AIや新しいテクノロジーを積極的に取り入れ、デリバリーの形そのものを進化させたい方。変革を自ら主導できる方: グローバル標準手法とAI-Native Deliveryを日本市場に導入し、日本のデリバリーのあり方そのものを変えていく当事者意識を持つ方。Trusted Guide たりうる方: 「自ら建てる」から「方向付け・レビュー・承認する」への発想転換を楽しみ、AIの生成物を的確に検証・判断できる方。高い当事者意識: 案件の成功に向けて自らプロセスと品質をコントロールするプロフェッショナリズムを持つ方。戦略的リーダーシップ: 文化や背景の異なる多国籍チームを統合し、共通のゴールへ力強く導ける方。


【セールスフォース・ジャパンの働きがいとダイバーシティ】

株式会社セールスフォース・ジャパンは、Great Place To Work® Institute Japan（GPTW）が発表した2026年版「働きがいのある会社」女性ランキングにおいて第2位に初ランクイン、また大規模部門（1,000人以上）においても第3位に選出されました。

私たちは「Equality（平等）」をコアバリューの一つとして掲げ、性別やライフステージに関わらず、すべての社員が能力を最大限に発揮できるインクルーシブな環境づくりを推進しています。社内コミュニティ「Salesforce Women’s Network（SWN）」をはじめとするネットワーキングやキャリア形成支援、メンターシップ制度も活発に稼働しています。


【柔軟な働き方・ワークライフバランスの推進】

  • ハイブリッドワーク / リモートワーク制度: 業務内容やチームの取り決めに応じた在宅勤務（リモートワーク）とオフィス勤務の柔軟な組み合わせが可能です。
  • フレックスタイム制度: コアタイムにとらわれない柔軟なスケジュール調整が可能で、育児や介護、個人のプライベートな事情に応じた働き方を尊重しています。
  • 充実した両立支援制度: 産前産後休暇・育児休業（女性の復職率は非常に高く、男性社員の育休取得実績も多数）、復職後の短時間勤務や看護・介護休暇など、ライフステージの変化に寄り添う各種サポートプログラムが整っています。
  • ウェルビーイング支援: 心身の健康を支援するウェルネス手当、社員サポートプログラム（EAP）など、持続可能なキャリアを支える包括的な福利厚生を提供しています。

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Account Executive, Growth Market Sales
descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Account Executive, Growth Market 
Our Growth Market Team is part of our wider Enterprise Sales Teams, focusing on working with exciting growth organizations. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast paced team with varied customers and personalized training and career opportunities.


Why Join Salesforce as an Account Executive?

This team is extremely tight knit; we celebrate our differences and wins and learn from losses. You’re joining our Ohana, and we’re all working towards the same goals.
This role is the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in all things Salesforce. You will get exposure to a range of internal teams and business units, so your overall knowledge of how we work and operate will grow very quickly.
We have a strong and tenured leadership team who come to work every day full of energy and looking for opportunities to support the team. We offer formal and informal training for all people coming into this role, and this will be entirely focused around your strengths and goals. We encourage 360 degree feedback, so you have the opportunity to take your own initiative and blaze your own trail.
 

Day to Day

  • Our Account Executives engage with existing customers and new leads to sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform. They build positive, trusted relationships with both key team members and decision makers within their patch, and become naturals at helping customers realize value from their Salesforce investments.
  • You will use your new business development skills to develop opportunities, through both warm leads and whitespace prospecting.
  • Close opportunities at assigned existing accounts and drive sales at new accounts
  • Drive sales within assigned segment (medium size business)
  • Acquire new logos within assigned territory
  • Speak to Salesforce offerings as they relate to the customer’s needs and engage other Salesforce resources as required
  • Manage high volume of accounts and sales

Who you are

We have an open mind in Growth Market and we’re not just looking for Account Executives who have experience in SaaS. If you have been in a quota carrying sales role looking after end-to-end sales processes, then we want to talk to you!
Embody a growth mindset – You’re thinking ahead and have a plan for yourself.
You're able to craft a point of view, hold an opinion, and build credibility as a ‘Trusted Adviser’ within your customers.
Self awareness is very important, and you must understand your ‘why’. You’re naturally curious and will be excited about the chance to absorb all Salesforce has to offer.
We don’t need you to have used Salesforce before, but it would have an advantage. A genuine passion for technology, disruption and innovation is also ideal.
Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

  • 5+ years of IT software sales experience
  • Business level of Korean and English language skills

Working at Salesforce

  • Working at Salesforce isn’t all about selling. It’s also about learning, and we heavily invest in you with a month-long immersion and onboarding, including: a week-long product bootcamp, mentorship program, weekly coaching and development programs.
  • Benefits
  • We are pioneers of the Pledge 1% model, providing product, grants and community service to those in need. We are proud to be#1 in PEOPLE's Top 50 Companies that Care, and are on Fortune’s Change the World list.
  • We provide every employee with 7 paid volunteer days off a year, and donation matching for all approved charitable donations.
  • We provide other world-leading benefits to all our employees, including;
  • Health, life insurance, retirement saving plan
  • Monthly wellness allowance
  • Flexible time off & leave policies
  • Parental benefits
  • Perks and discounts


------
Growth Market Account Executive
Growth Market 팀은 광범위한 엔터프라이즈 영업 팀의 일부이며, 흥미로운 성장 조직과 협력하는 데 중점을 둡니다. 다양한 고객과 함께 빠르게 변화하는 팀에서 일하고, 개인 맞춤형 교육 및 경력 개발 기회를 얻을 수 있습니다.


Salesforce Account Executive로 합류해야 하는 이유
우리 팀은 매우 긴밀하며, 서로의 차이점과 성공을 축하하고 실패로부터 배웁니다. 여러분은 우리의 ‘오하나(Ohana)’에 합류하게 되며, 우리는 모두 같은 목표를 향해 나아갑니다.
이 역할은 Salesforce의 모든 것을 경험할 수 있는 완벽한 기회입니다. 다양한 내부 팀과 사업 부문에 노출되어 우리의 업무 방식과 운영 방식에 대한 전반적인 지식을 빠르게 넓힐 수 있습니다.
우리는 매일 활력이 넘치고 팀을 지원할 기회를 찾는 강력하고 숙련된 리더십 팀을 보유하고 있습니다. 우리는 이 역할에 새로 합류하는 모든 사람에게 공식 및 비공식 교육을 제공하며, 이는 여러분의 강점과 목표에 완전히 집중될 것입니다. 우리는 360도 피드백을 장려하여 여러분이 주도적으로 자신의 길을 개척할 수 있도록 지원합니다.


일상 업무

  • Account Executive는 기존 고객 및 신규 리드와 소통하여 전체 Salesforce Customer 360 플랫폼을 판매합니다. 담당 지역 내 주요 팀원 및 의사 결정권자와 긍정적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 관계를 구축하고, 고객이 Salesforce 투자를 통해 가치를 실현하도록 돕는 데 능숙해집니다.
  • 따뜻한 리드와 화이트스페이스 영업을 통해 새로운 비즈니스 개발 기술을 활용하여 기회를 창출합니다.
  • 할당된 기존 계정에서 기회를 성사시키고 신규 계정에서 매출을 창출합니다.
  • 할당된 세그먼트(중견 기업) 내에서 매출을 주도합니다.
  • 할당된 지역 내에서 새로운 로고를 확보합니다.
  • 고객의 요구와 관련된 Salesforce 제품을 설명하고 필요한 경우 다른 Salesforce 리소스를 참여시킵니다.
  • 많은 계정 및 영업을 관리합니다.

어떤 분을 찾고 있나요
우리는 Growth Market에서 열린 마음을 가지고 있으며, SaaS 경험이 있는 Account Executive만 찾는 것은 아닙니다. 엔드 투 엔드 영업 프로세스를 담당하는 할당량 기반 영업 역할을 수행한 경험이 있다면, 우리는 여러분과 이야기하고 싶습니다!

성장 마인드를 구현합니다. 미래를 내다보고 자신을 위한 계획을 세웁니다. 자신의 관점을 만들고, 의견을 제시하며, 고객 내에서 ‘신뢰할 수 있는 조언자’로서 신뢰를 구축할 수 있습니다. 자기 인식이 매우 중요하며, 자신의 ‘왜(why)’를 이해해야 합니다. 자연스럽게 호기심이 많고 Salesforce가 제공하는 모든 것을 흡수할 기회에 흥분할 것입니다. Salesforce를 사용해 본 경험은 필수는 아니지만, 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 기술, 혁신 및 파괴적 혁신에 대한 진정한 열정이 있다면 더욱 좋습니다.
학위 또는 동등한 관련 경험이 필요합니다. 경험은 역할의 핵심 역량(예: 과외 리더십 역할, 군 경험, 자원 봉사 역할, 직장 경험 등)을 기반으로 평가됩니다.

  • 5년 이상의 IT 소프트웨어 영업 경험
  • 비즈니스 수준의 한국어 및 영어 능력

Salesforce 근무 환경
Salesforce에서 일하는 것은 단순히 판매하는 것만이 아닙니다. 학습도 중요하며, 우리는 한 달 간의 몰입형 온보딩을 통해 여러분에게 많은 투자를 합니다. 여기에는 1주일간의 제품 부트캠프, 멘토십 프로그램, 주간 코칭 및 개발 프로그램이 포함됩니다.


혜택

  • 우리는 도움이 필요한 사람들에게 제품, 보조금 및 지역 사회 봉사를 제공하는 Pledge 1% 모델의 개척자입니다. 우리는 PEOPLE의 ‘배려하는 50대 최고 기업’ 1위 및 Fortune의 ‘세상을 바꾸는 기업’ 목록에 이름을 올린 것을 자랑스럽게 생각합니다.
  • 우리는 모든 직원에게 연간 7일의 유급 자원 봉사 휴가를 제공하고, 승인된 모든 자선 기부에 대해 기부금 매칭을 제공합니다.
  • 우리는 모든 직원에게 다음과 같은 세계 최고 수준의 기타 혜택을 제공합니다.
  • 건강, 생명 보험, 퇴직 저축 계획
  • Monthly Wellness 수당
  • 유연한 휴가 및 휴가 정책

North Enterprise Account Executive, Apromore


Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands (Covering Benelux, the Nordics, and Switzerland)


At Salesforce, we're seeking outstanding individuals to join our team as an Apromore Account Executive with a strong technical background and expertise in process intelligence & AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will be pivotal in driving revenue growth, encouraging enduring client relationships, and applying innovative process intelligence technology to redefine customer engagement across Benelux, the Nordics, and Switzerland.


About Apromore

Apromore is a global leader in AI-driven process intelligence technology. Now part of Salesforce, Apromore provides organizations with an "Intelligent Process Twin" to gain complete operational transparency. As enterprises rush to scale AI, Apromore bridges the gap between process perception and reality, acting as the critical backbone that enables organizations to systematically discover, de-risk, deploy, and govern Agentic AI automation across the enterprise.


About the Role

As a part of our Apromore AE selling team, you will act as a strategic hunter and evangelist for Apromore, Salesforce’s process intelligence platform, focusing heavily on Agentic AI adoption. You will target enterprise clients across Benelux (Belgium, Netherlands, Luxembourg), the Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland), and Switzerland who are scaling AI into production, positioning Apromore as the definitive mechanism to identify the ideal high-propensity, high-ROI use cases for AI agents (such as Agentforce).

You will navigate complex, enterprise-grade B2B sales cycles by helping C-level executives move away from broad anecdotes and scope precisely defined, value-driven automation pipelines. We are looking for individuals with strong experience in selling process intelligence/process mining solutions, understanding AI and cloud-based services, and designing bespoke B2B solutions for technical and business leaders alike.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Drive Agentic AI Adoption in Northern Europe: Employ your wealth of sales knowledge to position Apromore as the key solution for scaling AI initiatives such as Agentforce across Benelux, Nordic, and Swiss enterprises, showing customers how clean process context, clear handoffs, and well-understood workflows are required to deploy agents safely and productively.
  • Deliver Value-Based Messaging: Target executive decision-makers across Automation/AI, Digital Transformation, Operational Excellence, and Risk & Compliance to map process frictions directly to financial business impact.
  • Technical Discovery & POV Creation: Conduct comprehensive technical discovery to analyze sophisticated business problems and craft compelling Points of View that underscore the tangible value of Apromore across both business and technical users.
  • Manage Full Sales Lifecycles: Own end-to-end B2B sales processes—from pipeline generation and prospecting to qualifying and closing complex enterprise software transactions within your assigned territory.
  • Sustain Continuous Value Post-Deployment: Shift clients from an initial deployment mindset to long-term partnerships. Drive ongoing account expansion by selling further process intelligence capabilities to ensure realized value scales with their business.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Value Engineers, Solution Consultants, and regional Salesforce sales teams to deliver a unified "One Salesforce" enterprise experience.

What you should have:

  • 10+ Years of Enterprise Software Sales Experience: Proven track record of selling enterprise SaaS, cloud software, or complex business analytics tools to executive buyers, specifically within the Benelux, Nordic, and/or Swiss markets.
  • Proven Process Intelligence Expertise: Deep background selling process intelligence and related technologies, such as process analytics, task mining, and simulation (e.g., from Celonis, SAP Signavio, ARIS).
  • Technical Acumen: Sophisticated intuition for business and the ability to conduct technical in-depth discovery mapping, aligning clients' existing architectures to the Apromore platform.
  • Strong Technical Selling Skills: The ability to explain complex process intelligence concepts to non-technical clients and translate data/architecture discussions into clear business outcomes.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistently surpassing sales targets within a technical sales environment, underscoring your proficiency in intricate, multi-stakeholder sales processes.
  • Language Skills: Fluent/Native in English. Fluency in Dutch, a Nordic language (Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish), German, or French is highly preferred.
  • Industry/Vertical Knowledge: Deep insight into key regional industries such as Retail & eCommerce, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, or Manufacturing & Supply Chains.
  • Education: A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with an extensive background in technology sales.

Characteristics:

  • This role requires an outstanding blend of technical depth and sales competence, with the ability to articulate complex AI-driven solutions to a diverse mix of customers.
  • Results-motivated: You show your ability to exceed sales goals.
  • Business-focused outlook: Skillfully translates technical solutions into palpable business value.
  • A talent for relationship-building: Establishes enduring client connections across cultural nuances in Benelux, the Nordics, and Switzerland.
  • A curiosity about problem-solving: Devises innovative solutions to address sophisticated client challenges using your extensive technology sales experience.
  • Agile and Creative: A roll-up-your-sleeves demeanor with a "progress over perfection" mindset.

The Experience

The Digital Wallet team powers consumption-based pricing at Salesforce. We give customers real-time visibility and control over how they use consumption-based products — so they pay only for what they use, and can budget, forecast, and optimize with total confidence. Digital Wallet drives near-real-time usage and consumption tracking across products like Agentforce and Data 360, powering consumption cards, entitlement draw-down, consumption insights, and proactive notifications. We own high-scale, business-critical systems where accuracy and reliability directly protect customer trust and Salesforce revenue.

We're looking for a dynamic Principal Member of Technical Staff (PMTS) to lead the technical direction of our most complex, high-scale consumption and usage-metering systems. This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role — you'll set architecture, drive execution, and own delivery end-to-end across the full software development lifecycle, from design and code through rollout and long-term production ownership. You're the force multiplier: the go-to technical authority across team boundaries, the one who raises the bar through reviews and mentorship, and the one whose architectural calls keep Digital Wallet accurate, performant, and scalable for every Salesforce customer.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Own the technical direction for one or more teams within Digital Wallet — across our full distributed systems stack — driving performance, scalability, and security without compromise.
  • Architect and ship complex, end-to-end features spanning multiple services, systems, and teams — from near-real-time usage ingestion and entitlement draw-down through consumption insights and customer-facing experiences.
  • Author the architectural documents, design specs, and test strategies that multiple teams build against; set and approve test plans with rigorous attention to accuracy, reliability, performance, and scalability.
  • Be the definitive technical voice for your team(s) on cross-boundary plans and problems — negotiate interfaces and resolve conflicts with peer teams (Data 360, billing, provisioning) so everything integrates seamlessly.
  • Take ownership of Customer Trust for consumption and billing accuracy: define SLIs/SLOs, design telemetry and rollout strategy across pre-release, canary, and staggered releases, and lead through critical incidents to minimize customer impact.
  • Set a bold, multi-release technical vision — manage backlog and tech debt with judgment, balancing calculated risk against long-term business needs.
  • Set the bar for design reviews, code reviews, testing, and CI practices across your teams.
  • Mentor and elevate senior/lead engineers and peer teams, primarily through reviews, and lead service-ownership practices — on-call rotations, readiness reviews, and automation.
  • Command the room: explain broad initiatives, high-level architecture, and technical vision with clarity and confidence to VP-level leadership, Product, and cross-functional stakeholders.



You're Our Person If...

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong track record of designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated history as a senior IC driving architecture and execution across multiple teams or domains.
  • Mastery of engineering fundamentals — fault tolerance, concurrency, API design, data modeling, maintainability, security, scalability, testability — across multiple domains.
  • Hands-on experience across the full SDLC (hybrid engineering), owning features end-to-end from design through production support.
  • Experience building high-scale services across both Platform (Core) and Off-Core / distributed service environments.
  • Strong ability to communicate technical vision, trade-offs, and strategy to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, up to VP level.
  • Proven ability to mentor engineers and elevate the technical capabilities of the teams you work with.
  • Passion for innovation and staying current with industry trends and technologies.



Even Better If...

  • Deep experience driving operational maturity — post-incident reviews, process improvement, best practices for critical systems.
  • Skill translating broad business goals into sharp, actionable technical roadmaps.

descriptionHtml:

Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Fixed-term contract
Duration: 12 months
Start Date: February 2027

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced Solution Engineer Buddies during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions.

By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a fast-paced, successful career. We are a proud member of the Fortune 100 Best Places to Work list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of Great Place to Work awards.

Who are we looking for?

  • You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds.
  • You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & Dutch (essential)

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations

  • During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
  • If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddies who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers.   • You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business
  • You are a creative problem-solver
  • You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset
  • You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning
  • You thrive in a team environment
  • You have excellent interpersonal skills
  • You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment
  • You are fluent in English & Hebrew is Essential

What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?


The program is structured as follows:


Introduction Month


During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce
  • Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni

Rotations


  • During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. Essentially you will gain exposure to both the Sales and Solution Engineering Roles. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend 60% of your time immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining 40% will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path.
  • If your first rotation (months 2 through 4) is in Sales, you will then join the Solution Engineering Rotation from months 5 through 7, and vice versa. Over these six months, you will have built the fundamental skills for these complementary disciplines. Having gone deeper on your solution knowledge, learning how to demo and having exposure to later stages of the sales cycle during the solution engineering rotation will set you up for sucess as you promote throught the various sales roles - SDR, BDR, AE and beyond.

    Throughout the rotations, there will be self-paced certifications and skills assessments. You must meet all eligibility criteria before you can panel for promotion.

Sales Graduate Rotation


  • Learn Salesforce’s best-in-class prospecting and qualification methodologies
  • Learn how to use social, digital, video, chat, and phone platforms to effectively engage Salesforce prospects
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Specialists to run campaigns and help build sales pipeline for the EMEA Sales organisation

Solution Engineering Graduate Rotation


  • Learn our solutions at a deeper, more technical level
  • Work closely with the Solution Engineering organisation, supporting the creation of cutting-edge customer demonstrations
  • Learn the art of customer discovery and how to create a compelling customer point of view

What’s in it for you?


  • A clear and structured career path within our Sales organisation
  • The opportunity to work in an international team within a nurturing environment
  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups
  • A comprehensive benefits package
  • Relocation budget and guidance throughout your relocation process
  • An additional seven days of paid time off for charitable causes – learn more about our 1-1-1 model

Map your future for the coming years


With the EMEA Graduate Program – Sales Path, you can continue to progress:


  • After your Grad Program Rotations you can progress to Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative and then Account Executive, where you will position our solutions to potential customers. In some instances, this path may vary or be subject to change.

About Salesforce
