Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We’re building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.


Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup—backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback, without layers of approvals slowing you down.


The Role


Software Factory is a new team that makes coding agents dependable in Qualified’s codebase and how work gets planned, implemented, shipped, and monitored. We run the best off-the-shelf agents (Claude, Codex, Cursor, and whatever comes next) rather than building our own.
This team's product is everything around those agents. That means a monorepo agents can orient in quickly, secure sandboxes where they run our full build, and a feedback loop that measures where agents stall or work from bad context, then fixes the cause.
As one of the team's first engineers, you'll shape that work from the ground up while shipping to demanding internal customers from day one: every engineer, product manager, and designer at Qualified.


What You'll Do

  • Make our monorepo agent-native: instruction files, skills, and progressive disclosure that get an agent to the right code in minutes, re-audited with every new model
  • Build the feedback loop: session telemetry across Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex, evals, and PR review analysis that separates wrong decisions from bad context
  • Own the agent sandbox: a full dev environment in a container, with proxy-only network access and secrets swapped at the proxy so agents never hold real credentials
  • Evaluate and integrate orchestration that starts agent work from Slack, Linear, GitHub, and schedules, with sound build-vs-buy judgment
  • Build the guardrails (verification, evals, and review) that let more agent work merge with less human hands-on time
  • Teach the engineering org to work with agents day to day, through enablement sessions and shared patterns
  • Own delivery from design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

Who You Are

  • A heavy daily user of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar), with real opinions about where they shine, where they fail, and how to instruct them
  • Experienced building developer tooling or developer experience that other engineers depend on daily
  • Comfortable owning a containerized environment end to end, including its network rules and secrets handling
  • Able to turn messy signals (session logs, PR threads, eval results) into a specific fix and show it worked
  • Experienced leading engineers to deliver complex systems
  • Energized by ambiguity: a new team means the roadmap and conventions are still being written
  • Pragmatic about build versus buy: the ecosystem moves weekly, and you'd rather integrate something great than rebuild it

Why Join Qualified

  • Define how software gets built: This isn't one product's roadmap. It's how the whole engineering org builds everything else, and your leverage compounds with every team that adopts it.
  • Day-one greenfield: A brand-new team where the approach is yours to shape, with real internal customers and real constraints from the first week.
  • The frontier, applied: Coding agents are the fastest-moving area in software. This role is about making them effective, safe, and trustworthy at company scale.
  • High bar, low bureaucracy: Work with a team that values craft and decisive execution, where strong ideas win and shipping is the default.

If you're excited to make coding agents do real, dependable work for an entire engineering org, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll work alongside a high-talent-density team that cares deeply about craft, performance, reliability, and user experience, and that raises the bar through collaboration, code review, and strong engineering principles. You'll make architecture decisions, solve meaningful system design challenges, and see your work land quickly with customers, without layers of approvals slowing you down. 


The Role 


As an Engineer on the AI Core team, you'll operate as a technical leader who turns ambiguous, high-stakes AI problems into durable, high-quality systems, while raising the technical bar for the broader team. AI Core builds the retrieval systems and agent infrastructure that power how our AI agents find, trust, and use knowledge, and the developer tooling that lets engineers across the company ship production agents quickly and safely. 


You'll lead significant initiatives end to end: faithful answering over a customer's own knowledge, retrieval that combines RAG and hybrid search, content lifecycle controls such as freshness, deduplication and source precedence, transcript processing, and the frameworks, registries, and evaluation tooling that make building a production agent a paved path. You'll partner closely with product, design, and engineering leadership to decide what we build, how we build it, and how we measure whether answers actually got better. 


What You'll Do 


Lead retrieval initiatives end to end: Design, build, and operate retrieval systems using RAG and hybrid search (lexical plus vector, reranking, filtering) so agents answer from the right content with the right amount of context. Own delivery from scope and design through launch, monitoring, and iteration. 


Build developer tooling for production agents: Drive technical design for the frameworks and platform pieces our engineers use to build agents, including multi-agent orchestration, shared primitives for prompts, tools, tracing, and evaluation. 


Own answer quality: Diagnose why answers are thin, wrong, or inconsistent by separating retrieval problems from generation problems (prompt, token budget, model choice). Set a quality bar we can test against, and lead the 

work to reach it. 


Design content and data models: Define how content from documents, 

knowledge bases, and call transcripts is ingested, segmented, labeled, and retrieved, including the primitives behind freshness, dedupe, source 

precedence, and internal versus external visibility.

The Experience

Monitoring Cloud is seeking engineers to architect, implement, deliver, and operate the telemetry agents and instrumentation libraries that power observability at Salesforce scale.

Monitoring Cloud is an integral part of the Salesforce Infrastructure, providing the insights every development team relies on to detect and remediate incidents and keep Salesforce products highly available for our customers. This cloud owns the entire telemetry stack, from the agents that emit, collect, and ship telemetry to the large-scale backends that store it and serve low-latency queries. We support all the key pillars of telemetry (metrics, logs, traces, and events) at massive scale, built from a combination of open source and home-grown technologies architected from the ground up to run efficiently in the public cloud.

The Monitoring Agent team sits at the very front of that stack. We own every telemetry collection agent and instrumentation library at Salesforce: we instrument, collect, transform, and export logs, metrics, traces, and events across Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), GovCloud, and Agentforce/LLM services. Our work spans OpenTelemetry Collector pipelines, eBPF-based edge instrumentation, an OpAMP fleet-management control plane, agent-side anomaly detection, and instrumentation libraries embedded in thousands of services. These agents run on millions of hosts, so efficiency, reliability, and safe rollout are first-order design constraints.

We are looking to add engineers with experience building and owning distributed services who can step up and own big chunks of this vision. You will be challenged to blend customer-centric principles, industry-changing innovation, and the reliable delivery of new technologies. You will work directly with engineering, product, and design to build agents and instrumentation that development teams across Salesforce depend on every day.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • You proactively design, develop, and implement critical functionality, tackling features of increasing complexity with confidence.
  • You are adaptable and eager to learn new technologies, solving ambiguous problems quickly to accelerate business impact.
  • You take pride in your work, applying engineering best practices to build scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • You are innovative, always looking for ways to improve services and are unafraid to propose new ideas.
  • You care about operating what you build, treating agent footprint, host impact, and safe rollout across a large fleet as part of the design.
  • You are comfortable presenting your team's work to peers, leadership, and broader engineering groups, whether in team meetings, leadership reviews, or Tech Talks.
  • You write understandable, testable code with an eye toward maintainability.



You're Our Person If...

  • B.S/M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent field with 8+ years of software development experience
  • Experience building highly scalable, available, and real-time data management or data collection services
  • Deep understanding and experience building services on the public cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc.)
  • Strong experience developing services/software in a Linux/UNIX environment using Go, Java, or Python
  • Hands-on experience with containers and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), including operating workloads such as DaemonSets or sidecars in production
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment focused on delivering production code at a regular cadence using Agile techniques, tools, and methodologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication that helps you collaborate effectively in distributed scrum teams
  • Experience building and operating services while ensuring 99.99% reliability in production



Even Better If...

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry (Collector, SDKs, or instrumentation) or comparable telemetry pipelines and agents

You’ll start with well-scoped work: triaging cases, investigating failures, following and improving runbooks, and building monitors and automations. As you grow, you’ll own root-cause analysis and a piece of platform reliability. We write down what we learn, and we favor automation over manual effort.

Who thrives here: You’re curious, you like finding out why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people. We’ll teach you the platforms and the operating practices.

As a Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you’ll independently run day-to-day production support and administration for Salesforce’s enterprise data and analytics platforms, working from established runbooks. You’ll own your case backlog, respond quickly and keep requesters informed, escalate with clear context, and help keep our support documentation accurate. You’ll grow toward owning escalations, root-cause analysis, and platform reliability.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Frontline Case, Alert & Escalation Management

  • Working with regional peers and leads, be among the first to respond to key signals and hand-raises from customers, agents, and alerts.
  • Start investigations, open issues, and help triage.
  • Be a frontline responder when an incident starts: connect first, gather evidence and impact, and swarm with the team alongside Incident Command. Follow the runbook to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) when needed. SREs own incident resolution.
  • Provide Tier-2 production support: ticket triage, case management, and keeping backlog health. You are measured on the intake and investigation lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART).
  • Support case and stakeholder satisfaction (CSAT, NPS) by communicating clearly, setting expectations, and closing the loop on every case.
  • Escalate cleanly on cases, intake, investigations, and gaps in SOPs: hand off to the right team with the evidence, impact, and steps already taken, and follow the escalation paths and time-zone handoffs in the runbooks. Growing toward owning escalations independently.



Platform Administration & Operations

  • Handle user provisioning, role hierarchy, and access management requests.
  • Troubleshoot declarative configuration, validation errors, and data discrepancies.
  • Execute scheduled data updates, bulk data loads and migrations, and basic sandbox maintenance.
  • Deliver moderate declarative solutions (for example Flows and validation rules) and platform enhancements.

  • Contribute to RCAs, growing toward owning RCA and resolution for application bugs.
  • Help build and tune monitors, alerts, and automations. Flag technical debt and recommend fixes.



Process, Documentation & Playbooks

  • Follow and improve lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs), using team templates. Flag gaps and stale content, and draft updates from what you learn on cases.
  • Write knowledge articles and process maps so Tier-1/Tier-2 teams can reuse what you learn.
  • Map processes end to end with business partners.
  • Execute support playbooks as an SME and point of contact for development partners.

  • Follow security policies and change controls.
  • Execute technology compliance activities, audit reporting, and SOX reporting.
  • Follow the SDLC (Agile) and change, deployment, incident, and problem management processes.

  • Communicate clearly with business partners, engineers, and vendors across time zones.
  • Share knowledge and mentor new joiners.
  • Try new tools and practices, including automation and AI.

  • On-call and travel as required, subject to local regulations. Other related duties as required.

  • 1-3 years of hands-on platform or systems support experience in an enterprise IT environment.

  • Foundational knowledge of Salesforce native functionality: objects, access management, reports and dashboards, and data model administration.
  • Experience with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules) and data loading (Data Loader, Workbench).

  • Ability to work with growing independence in a distributed, global team.

DET TEAM
Mexico City


We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and models that power analytics, AI, and business insights. You will work across modern data platforms such as dbt, Snowflake, Informatica, Airflow. You will also use AI-native development tools and agentic workflows to build faster, validate more rigorously, and keep data products reliable.


Key Responsibilities

Data and AI engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain automated pipelines and dimensional/star/snowflake models using dbt, Snowflake, Informatica, and Airflow. These power analytics, reporting, and ML/AI use cases.
  • Integrate data from multiple systems, including Salesforce Core and Data 360, into unified, high-quality datasets.
  • Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency through validation, observability, and automated monitoring. Troubleshoot issues and optimize for performance, scalability, and cost.
  • Partner with analysts, product managers, and business teams to turn ambiguous requirements into production-ready data products.
  • Use AI-native tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) to accelerate development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Build agentic workflows for ETL, automated QA, anomaly detection, and pipeline remediation. Agents propose fixes, and you review and approve them.
  • Design verification patterns (self-correction loops, peer-review agents, human-in-the-loop checkpoints) so agent output is validated before production.
  • Develop MCP servers that give agents secure, governed access to Snowflake, Salesforce, and internal data catalogs. Use agents to keep documentation, lineage, and metadata current.
  • Supervise long-running agent tasks with checkpoints, cost controls, and audit trails. Contribute to agent-assisted modeling and simulation workflows, reviewing assumptions and uncertainty before decisions are acted on.

Governance, quality, and security

  • Apply governance as code to pipelines and agents: lineage, access controls, semantic definitions, and audit logging.
  • Support data quality and governance initiatives in line with standards and best practices.
  • Contribute to red-team and validation agents that probe pipelines and agents for logic flaws, vulnerabilities, and integrity risks.

Team and craft

  • Lead and mentor peers on AI-assisted engineering practices.
  • Improve tools, standards, and documentation, and evaluate emerging data and AI technologies with sound judgment.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5–7 years of hands-on data engineering experience.
  • Strong data modeling skills (dimensional, star/snowflake) and data curation experience. Production experience with dbt and Snowflake. Working knowledge of Informatica and Airflow.
  • Proven use of AI coding assistants and generative AI to deliver measurably faster, with examples.
  • Hands-on context engineering and agent design (tool use, reasoning, self-correction).
  • Sharp judgment to catch logic errors and hallucinations in AI-generated output before it reaches production.
  • Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional communication.

Preferred Skills (Must)

  • Agentic frameworks and building or consuming MCP servers.
  • Salesforce Core and Data 360 knowledge.
  • Data Mesh, Data-as-a-Product, event-driven architecture, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs.
  • AI evaluation, guardrails, and adversarial testing of agents.
  • Statistical and simulation literacy, and experience orchestrating long-running agent workloads.

Who We Are and Where We're Going

Assurance at Salesforce is being rebuilt as an engineering discipline.

Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove that controls worked months ago. We're replacing that model with one that is continuous, automated, and built into how Salesforce ships. Controls are code. Evidence comes from pipelines, not people chasing tickets. We work to improve the state of controls, drive decisions with risk, govern with code, and make compliance a streamlined business process.

Our strategy:

  • Risk-informed, control managed. We monitor, validate, and improve the security controls that stand against threats and failures. This proves trust while delivering risk operations, compliance artifacts, and outputs, and it opens access to new markets through the product we build and the behavior we change.
  • Visibility and invention. We give Salesforce a clear, current view of its security posture. We equip the Assurance team with a new way of protecting Salesforce, through the invention we create together. We also invest in the people who work here, with room to grow, take on new challenges, and drive excellence.
  • Always in front. We turn gaps into signals, alerts, and escalations. When a control fails, it flows into a workflow built to help stakeholders meet their trust obligations. Nothing waits for the next audit to surface.



We're hiring people who want to build this future. You'll have real ownership, a real roadmap, and the chance to define what modern assurance looks like for the industry.

How We Work

  • Engineering-first culture. We use version control, code review, CI/CD, and backlogs. Assurance work ships like software.
  • Automate first. If it's done manually twice, it's a candidate for a build.
  • Signals, not surprises. Gaps become alerts and workflows, and control failures resolve through defined escalation paths.
  • Embedded partners. We work alongside T&P teams and solve problems with them, not at them.
  • Outcomes over activity. We measure risk reduced, effort saved, and audit friction removed.
  • Room to grow. Learn the engineering side if you come from GRC, or the risk side if you come from engineering. We support both paths.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Triage and track Third-Party Security Assessment (TPSA/TPSD) cases in ProcessUnity from intake to closure, including supplier follow-up questions.
  • Do first-pass review of supplier questionnaire responses against a documented rubric, and escalate exceptions to the senior reviewer.

  • Collect and organize evidence for audit readiness
  • Maintain intake hygiene in ProcessUnity: bulk imports of new supplier TPSAs, templates and intake fields for new supplier categories, and consistency across cases.
  • Chase outstanding evidence and documentation from vendors and internal stakeholders.

  • 年間目標達成経験及び表彰経験

Salesforce Commerce Cloud is looking for a Sales Executive, mainly covering the Tokyo area, as we expand our business in Japan. Your counterparts will mainly be business leaders such as executives and directors, so you can carry out sales activities with a strong consulting element.

The Account Executive is a signature sales position at Salesforce. While it teaches you the sales skills to maximize results from an account-conquest perspective, a product Specialist AE is expected to think about how to grow the business of the segment you cover. This means you will sharpen the sales skills to close the deal in front of you, and you can also gain experience driving the business with a Generalist's perspective.   • Propose and sell Commerce Cloud, a B2C/B2B platform, through a direct sales model.
  • Make proposals tailored to realizing customer needs, including an understanding of Salesforce's other solutions.

  • You may work on proposals in collaboration with key partners such as digital agencies, system integrators, and fulfillment/logistics partners.

  • Direct sales experience carrying an individual quota

We are thrilled to invite ambitious graduate candidates who would like to build a career in Salesforce to apply for the next cohort of our EMEA Graduate Rotation Program - Sales Path.

This exciting 12-month program is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their Salesforce Sales careers. The promotion window opens from month 7 onwards.

Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced Sales Development Buddys who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like?

Introduction Month

During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will:

  • Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values
  • Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools
  • Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce

  • Access to our diverse internal employee groups

Map your future for the coming years

The Experience

Are you a performance leader who still loves the details? A systems performance expert? A builder of teams and of systems? Want to be part of something big? How about owning the performance of the distributed database technology that is powering growth of the Salesforce Platform across the globe? SalesforceDB is the transactional database behind Salesforce CRM. It runs more than 1.1 trillion transactions per month on thousands of database instances.

The Salesforce Database team is fast-paced and highly collaborative, and works across all areas of our distributed transactional database technology stack. We are seeking a Senior Director to own the SDB Performance technology line: the strategy, the organization, and the results that drive Salesforce DataBase.

You set direction on a year-plus horizon and you are accountable for it. You craft and deliver the V2MOM for the performance portfolio. You are a subject-matter expert in how a large distributed database behaves in production, and you build the managers and principal engineers who turn that expertise into shipped improvements. You are comfortable making hard calls on priority, resourcing, and trust, and you stand behind the outcomes.

Our performance organization partners closely with database and storage system developers, query processing engineers, application performance engineers, infrastructure engineers, and our analytics team to deliver all the pieces that add up to high performance in production at scale. Your organization's improvements ship across the whole production fleet every release, and some of our work is published at database research conferences such as CIDR. We are a high-performing team with high standards: we value integrity, rigor, and continuous learning.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

* Own the SDB Performance technology line. Craft and deliver the V2MOM for that portfolio, on a planning horizon of a year or more
* Set the direction for performance and scalability across the database engine, storage service, and query processing, and bring peer leadership along to see it through
* Be accountable for architecture: own the architectural decisions of the performance organization, and hold a consistent architecture and design process with partner clouds
* Own performance qualification of SalesforceDB releases, and deliver a record of successful performance capabilities across release qualification, production performance, capacity management, and query and systems optimization
* Lead benchmarking and modeling that guide hardware selection and capacity planning for the fleet, and the telemetry, dashboards, and analysis that show how the production fleet performs against its targets
* Hold the organization to trust standards, including scalability, service health, and the performance plans behind every release. Put proactive plans in place for systemic performance issues and technical debt
* Drive a production-first culture of service ownership. Personally coordinate performance-related production incident response within the cloud, and defuse cross-cloud performance issues on behalf of the database
* Make the hard resourcing decisions that keep the portfolio on its commitments, and shift teams as business priorities move
* Stay close to teams and customers who feel database performance, and use that insight to change what we build and how we operate
* Lead a collection of teams that make up the performance portfolio. This role manages other engineering managers
* Develop talent from Manager through Director, and coach engineers from early career through principal
* Build a high-performing, inclusive, geographically distributed organization. Motivate your teams and peer leaders. Share bad news early, solve the problems you can solve, and escalate when scope requires it
* Be the partner senior leaders in other clouds call when performance, capacity, or release risk is on the table. Build durable relationships with directors, senior directors, VPs, and the architects who support this area, and keep those architects informed and empowered

You're Our Person If…

* BS or higher degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Subject-matter expertise in the performance of large-scale databases, storage, or distributed systems
* Proven record of owning a technology portfolio and delivering successful services or capabilities across multiple releases, on a year-plus horizon
* 10+ years of engineering management experience, including 5+ years managing other managers, and a track record of developing both managers and senior individual contributors
* 15+ years of experience in performance engineering or software engineering on databases, storage, or distributed systems, including 5+ years leading performance, scalability, or release-qualification teams
* Performance engineering background on systems software, ideally databases, storage, or distributed systems, with strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, concurrency, memory management) and the technical depth to engage on designs and code in Java or C/C++
* Hands-on experience with load, benchmark, and regression testing, ideally for multi-tenant workloads at scale, and with root cause analysis of performance and scalability problems in complex distributed systems
* Strong SQL and performance data analysis (CPU, latency, throughput, per-tenant resource use)
* Accountability for architecture and for trust outcomes, not only for a single team's sprint
* Strong judgment on prioritization, resourcing, and when to escalate
* Excellent communication across database, storage, infrastructure, application performance, and analytics teams: you can set a vision, tell the truth about risk, and bring peer leaders with you
* Integrity, high energy, and a growth mindset: you report what the data shows, seek feedback, and keep learning, with a collaborative style

Even Better If…

* MS or PhD in databases or distributed systems
* Deep knowledge of database internals: optimizer, query execution and optimization, storage, transactions, concurrency control, memory management
* Experience with performance workloads, system benchmarks, release qualification, and production performance investigation
* Splunk or similar telemetry, dashboards, and fleet-scale performance management
* Systems programming experience (C/C++ or Java), profiling, JVM tuning, and heap dump analysis
* SQL, Linux, data analysis and visualization, and experimental design
* Statistical analysis, benchmarking, and capacity modeling
* Operating system and network fundamentals: processes, threads, memory, file systems, storage, TCP/IP
* Cloud platforms and infrastructure (AWS, GCP), Docker, and Kubernetes
* Experience leading engineering organizations through V2MOM planning, agile delivery, service ownership, and incident response

  • Go-Getter: You are self-directed, resourceful, and have a strong work ethic. You are driven to build strategic relationships and maximize account revenue.
  • Excellent Communicator: You have outstanding presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and business audiences.
  • Technically Savvy: You are proficient with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and other business tools. A Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience is preferred.
  • Company Builder: You are always on the lookout for great talent to help us continue building one of the best companies in the world.

한국 전략 고객을 담당하는 전담 세일즈 리더로서, 디지털 네이티브 분야 상위 기업의 성장을 이끌게 됩니다. 이 역할은 가시성이 높은 포지션으로, 한국을 대표하는 기업들과 깊이 있는 전략적 파트너십을 구축하고, Tableau의 분석 플랫폼을 전사적으로 도입하도록 지원하여 디지털 전환을 가속화합니다.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • 전략적 어카운트 관리: 담당 핵심 고객사를 위한 종합적인 어카운트 플랜을 수립하고 실행하며, Tableau 솔루션을 고객의 핵심 비즈니스 목표와 연계하여 영업 목표를 달성하고 초과 달성합니다.
  • 경영진 관계 구축: 고객 조직 전반에서 C-레벨과 탄탄한 관계를 구축하고 유지하며, 고객의 데이터 및 분석 여정에서 신뢰받는 어드바이저 역할을 수행합니다.
  • 전 단계 영업: 기회 발굴부터 계약 체결까지 전체 영업 사이클을 주도하며, 복잡한 파이프라인을 능숙하게 관리하고 대기업의 조달 프로세스를 원활히 진행합니다.
  • 부서 간 협업 총괄: 세일즈 엔지니어, 커스터머 석세스 매니저 및 기타 전문가로 구성된 가상 어카운트 팀 간의 협업을 이끌어 설득력 있는 제품 데모, 평가, 종합 솔루션을 제공합니다.
  • 파이프라인 및 예측: Salesforce(CRM)에서 모든 고객 및 거래 정보를 꼼꼼하게 관리·추적하고, 파이프라인과 예측을 정확하게 정기적으로 보고합니다.
  • 시장 전문성: 시장 환경에 대한 전문가로서 업계 동향을 지속적으로 파악하고, Tableau의 가치 제안을 효과적으로 전달합니다.

descriptionHtml:

Job Details

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Senior Director, Technology and AI Innovation – Life Sciences is responsible for defining and accelerating the AI-enabled delivery strategy for Salesforce's global Life Sciences Professional Services business.
This executive will serve as the strategic bridge between Professional Services, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, and Global Delivery, ensuring that customer implementation experience directly influences product evolution, AI innovation, and delivery transformation.

Working across more than 50 global Life Sciences customer implementations today, with significant growth expected over the next several years, this leader will identify implementation patterns, prioritize innovation investments, and help shape the next generation of industry-specific AI capabilities, reusable assets, and delivery accelerators.

Leading a global team, this role will help transform delivery intelligence into scalable solutions that improve customer outcomes, accelerate AI adoption, and enable consistent, high-quality delivery across the Life Sciences industry.

Key Responsibilities

Industry Delivery Intelligence

  • Develop a comprehensive view of implementation trends, customer challenges, and delivery opportunities across Salesforce's global Life Sciences portfolio.
  • Identify common patterns across customer engagements and translate those insights into strategic opportunities for AI, automation, reusable assets, implementation accelerators, and delivery innovation.
  • Establish a continuous feedback model that transforms implementation experience into scalable delivery capabilities.

Agentic Delivery Strategy

  • Define the roadmap for Life Sciences-specific agentic delivery capabilities that improve implementation quality, delivery productivity, and customer outcomes.
  • Prioritize the AI assets, accelerators, reusable frameworks, and implementation capabilities needed to bridge the gap between current product capabilities and customer demand.
  • Recommend strategic investment priorities for industry-specific AI innovation and partner across Professional Services Technology to bring those capabilities to market.

Product & Customer Partnership

  • Serve as the primary liaison between Global Professional Services, Customer Success, and Product Management for Life Sciences.
  • Capture customer and delivery feedback and translate it into actionable product enhancements, roadmap priorities, and implementation best practices.
  • Partner closely with Product Engineering to ensure implementation insights directly influence product strategy and future platform capabilities.

Cross Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the executive subject matter expert for Technology and AI Innovation within the Life Sciences industry.
  • Partner closely with Professional Services Delivery, Customer Success, Product, Global Delivery Centers, Agentic Innovation, Global Tools & Productivity Engineering, and Global Technology Foundations & Architecture to accelerate AI adoption across Life Sciences engagements.
  • Help align industry priorities across delivery methodology, AI investments, reusable assets, and product innovation.

Industry Innovation Portfolio

  • Define and prioritize the portfolio of Life Sciences-specific AI assets, implementation accelerators, reusable delivery patterns, and agentic solutions.
  • Partner with the ProServ Agentic Innovation Lab and engineering teams to convert customer insights into scalable technical capabilities.
  • Establish governance to measure adoption, business impact, customer outcomes, and value realization across the Life Sciences innovation portfolio.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing global team of approximately 20 professionals focused on industry innovation, architecture, delivery excellence, and AI enablement.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, customer obsession, continuous learning, and AI-first thinking.
  • Drive measurable improvements in customer success, delivery productivity, AI adoption, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

Required

  • 15+ years of leadership experience in Professional Services, enterprise software, digital transformation, Life Sciences consulting, or technology organizations.
  • Deep understanding of the Life Sciences industry, enterprise implementation programs, and customer transformation initiatives.
  • Proven experience partnering across Product Management, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success translating customer needs into product strategy, technology investments, reusable assets, or delivery innovation.
  • Experience leading global, cross-functional organizations and influencing without direct authority.
  • Strong executive communication, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with AI-enabled delivery models, Agentforce, agentic technologies, automation platforms, or enterprise AI solutions.
  • Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud or broader Salesforce ecosystem experience.
  • Experience building industry accelerators, reusable implementation assets, or customer success frameworks.
  • Background in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, biotechnology, or regulated industries.

Leadership Expectations

  • Champion AI-enabled ways of working and accelerate the adoption of agentic capabilities across the Life Sciences delivery ecosystem.
  • Serve as the voice of delivery by ensuring customer implementation experience directly shapes product evolution, AI investments, and delivery innovation.
  • Foster strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Global Delivery to deliver measurable customer outcomes.
  • Act as a multiplier by identifying patterns, scaling best practices, and enabling reusable solutions that benefit customers globally.

* Proven experience translating business requirements into structured automated workflows or solutions

* Experience in Life Sciences commercial operations, HCP/HCO engagement, field force automation, or clinical operations technology

* Familiarity with the Salesforce platform ecosystem (APIs, platform services, Data Cloud)

The Experience


私たちCustomer Success Strategyチームは、Salesforceの戦略部門であるStrategy & Programsに属し、契約後（Post Sales）のお客様を支えるCustomer Success Group（CSG）の目標達成に責任を持っています。グローバルや他領域の戦略チームと連携しながら会社のGo-To-Market（GTM）戦略をCSGの施策に落とし込み、お客様との関係の維持・拡大に向けて、CSGのリーダー陣の意思決定をデータと戦略的思考で支えています。

CSG Data & Insights Analystは、CSG内の特定の部門に固定されず、CSG全体を横断して支援するポジションです。チーム内のBusiness Partner（CSG各部門のリーダーの参謀役）や、営業戦略・財務・オペレーション・イネーブルメント（人材育成）など多様な部門との連携を主導しながら、お客様のSalesforce活用促進・解約リスクの最小化というCSGの重要な目標の達成に貢献します。

本ポジションは単なるレポーティング担当ではありません。Customer Successのビジネスモデル・業務プロセス・KPIと関係者（Stakeholder）の状況を理解したうえで、取り組むべきビジネス上の問いを自ら設定します。そして、データの収集・分析や分析用のデータマート・ダッシュボードの整備を通じて、意思決定を動かすInsightを届けることが求められます。戦略をビジネスの現場で実現することに情熱を持ち、周囲とのコラボレーションを楽しめる方を歓迎します。


What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Problem Framing：Customer Successのビジネスモデル・KPIとStakeholderの状況を踏まえ、取り組むべきビジネス上の問いと分析の優先度を主体的に定める
  • Insight Generation：お客様のSalesforce活用促進・製品利用量（Consumption）・解約リスクに関わる動向をデータで分析し、具体的な改善提案に落とし込む
  • Decision Support：Business Partnerと対等な立場で連携し、CSGのリーダー陣との議論、営業戦略部門との連携、経営層の意思決定といった場面で必要となるInsightを迅速に届ける
  • Analytics Foundation：分析手法・プロセスの継続的な改善に加え、AIによるデータ活用の広がりも見据え、データ品質の確認・データ定義の整理・アクセス管理などのデータガバナンスの整備にも、関係部門と連携しながら取り組む

You're Our Person If...


  • 経験：データを用いて事業課題の分析や意思決定の支援を行う業務（例：経営企画・事業企画、営業企画、データアナリストなど）における5年以上の実務経験があり、Customer SuccessまたはSaaSのビジネスモデル・業務プロセスへの理解がある
  • テクニカルスキル：SQLによるデータ抽出・集計の実務経験に加え、BIツール（Tableau等）でのエグゼクティブ向けダッシュボード構築、CRM（Salesforce等）・クラウドDWH（Snowflake等）のデータを活用した分析、Excel / Google Sheetsでの定量分析・財務モデリングのうち、複数の実務経験がある
  • ビジネススキル：Stakeholderの課題を踏まえてデータ活用の方向性を自ら判断し、複数の依頼を優先度管理しながら、分析結果をシニアリーダーに提言した経験がある
  • 語学力・コミュニケーション能力：ビジネスレベルの日本語力（日本語での会議進行・資料作成ができる水準。日本語能力試験N1相当以上）と、英語でのビジネスコミュニケーション力（英語での資料読解・会議参加・プレゼンテーションなど）がある

Even Better If...


  • Python / R等を用いた統計モデリング・機械学習などの高度な分析経験
  • Tableau関連の認定資格またはSnowPro認定資格
  • コンサルティングファーム・SaaS企業での戦略・分析業務の経験、または営業戦略部門・全社データ分析部門と連携した経験
  • データガバナンス（データ品質管理、データ定義・メタデータの整備など）またはデータエンジニアリング（分析用データを自動で整備する仕組みの設計・構築など）の実務経験

Salesforce Professional Services is evolving how we deliver world-class value to our customers. This transformation is being fundamentally redefined by AI - from how we deliver services to how our consultants operate.

We are seeking a sharp, highly analytical, and detail-oriented Strategy Manager. In this role, you will support strategic planning and operational research across the global Professional Services business. You will work closely with Strategy Leads and leadership to conduct market research, perform data modeling, extract key operational insights, and draft executive-ready presentation decks. You will also assist in designing metrics and supporting review processes that track our transformation's impact on real-world business outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

  • Research & Data Analysis: Conduct quantitative analysis, qualitative research, market benchmarking, and operational capacity modeling to support strategic initiatives across Professional Services.
  • Synthesize Telemetry & Insights: Partner with the PS analytics organization to extract operational data, identify friction points, and build data-driven recommendations for project teams.
  • Draft Executive Presentations: Translate complex analytical findings and strategic options into visually compelling, structured slide decks, strategy briefs, and executive deliverables.
  • Support Business Reviews: Assist in preparing quarterly and annual operational review materials for global Professional Services leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with PMO and OCM teams to pass along data models, requirements, and metric tracking frameworks for strategy execution.
  • Leverage AI Tools: Utilize modern AI productivity, visualization, and analytical software to streamline desk research, automate reporting, and enhance daily operational output.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 3-5 years of experience in business analysis, management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations. Experience in Professional Services, Tech, or SaaS is a plus.
  • Analytical Rigor: Strong proficiency with data analysis, qualitative research techniques, data modeling, and data visualization tools.
  • Presentation & Storytelling Skills: Ability to distill raw data into clean, logical, and visually polished presentation slides for executive audiences.
  • Proactive Problem-Solving: Comfortable taking loosely defined guidelines and independently structuring an organized analysis and research plan.

You will play a pivotal role in securing our distributed micro-services architecture on GCP, moving security by building automated, high-performance tools that empower our entire engineering organization.

  • Engineering Mindset: 5+ years for SMTS, 7+ years for LMTS; 9+ years for PMTS in Security Engineering with a focus on building tools, not just managing them.

  • Security Domain Knowledge: Practical experience with network protocols, OS hardening (Linux), and modern attack vectors.
  • Collaborative Spirit: A desire to work cross-functionally with DevOps to embed security into the SDLC.

descriptionHtml:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience
The Experience Services Competency within Salesforce Professional Services is seeking a Business Strategy Director. The Business Strategy Director is responsible for ensuring overall delivery excellence and quality across Salesforce Professional Services customers. Partnering with C-level customers, Business Strategists craft innovative, industry-specific strategies that clearly define the vision, metrics, and roadmap to achieve desired business outcomes. They work with our key enterprise customers, partners, and technical delivery leaders to drive scale, speed to value, and a sustained landscape for future success. They bring deep expertise in enterprise business strategy, operating model design, and value realization — translating customer ambitions into actionable, multi-year programs. They have strong Financial Services and/or Healthcare & Life Sciences consulting experience and a deep understanding of Business Strategy services deliverables. They strive to better understand and improve processes to help our Experience Services team thrive. The Business Strategy Director also partners with other roles on customer engagements to ensure customer and Salesforce Professional Services success.

We believe the best Business Strategists are those who obsess over the creation of customer and business value. They have a customer-centric and collaborative mentality, a willingness to commit to the customer, and the drive to break down barriers to ensure customer success.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Strategic Advisory: Provide business strategy subject matter expertise as it relates to Salesforce products and services during delivery cycles. Work cross-functionally within Salesforce to define program scope, team, value narrative, and pitch. Uncover future sales opportunities to drive ongoing customer value.
  • Strategic Discovery & Assessment: Perform and distill customer, industry, and end-user research to identify key customer needs, expectations, and experience-led business opportunities. Conduct assessments and facilitate workshops to develop future-state operating models and business visions. Identify enterprise business process and operations improvements to realize efficiencies and increase impact. Take ownership of the vision and value narrative established during pre-sales and carry it into delivery, translating it into an actionable “Phase 0” roadmap without loss of momentum or customer trust. Leverage AI tools in creation and execution of deliverables or activities.
  • Strategy Roadmap: Develop multi-year, strategic roadmaps that prioritize investments and support business objectives. 
  • Business Value: Perform business value assessment and gain alignment to develop strategic use cases to project the value of strategy, case for change, and organizational implications. Define the metrics for tracking value realization. 
  • Transformation & Organizational Alignment: Drive stakeholder alignment, engagement, and buy-in across functions. Facilitate cross-functional partnerships to craft and implement new ways of working across functions. Help business and technology leaders adopt new digital operating models, governance strategies, and approaches. Cultivate solution and organizational adoption, driving strategy evolution to deliver value through quicker delivery cycles.
  • Operational Excellence: Collaborate closely with program management, experience design, change management, and technical teams to integrate business value strategies into program delivery. Identify and proactively manage risk areas and commit to seeing an issue through to complete resolution.
  • Team Leadership: Coach and develop other Business Strategists and project team members to a consistent, repeatable delivery standard. Serve as a point of escalation and lead team members to drive results on customer engagements. Positively impact customer renewals and extensions when applicable.
  • Business & Practice Impact: Support building the Business Strategy capability within the Experience Services Competency; share standard methodologies and collaborate with and advise peers. Identify and lead internal strategic initiatives to grow the consulting practice; serve as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise. Generate positive feedback from internal teams and leadership.

You're Our Person If…

  • Professional Experience: Minimum 15 years of experience in customer-facing roles leading complex experience-led engagements with large-scale transformation, as part of a cross-functional team. Track record of delivering exceptional experiences from start to finish.
  • Industry Expertise: Proven experience working with customers or internally at companies within the Financial Services and/or Life Sciences industries.Strong understanding of key business value drivers and success metrics typical of large-enterprise Financial Services / Healthcare & Life Sciences organizations. Ability to develop industry POVs, including identifying market trends, responses, and solution offerings.
  • Product Knowledge: Salesforce product knowledge and solution design experience is required.
  • Core Competencies: Experience in Business Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, Product Management, Agile, Program Governance, and/or Value Realization. Application of AI tools in services delivery.
  • GTM Support: Go-to-market (GTM) support experience, including scoping, proposal development, RFP responses, and executive presentations.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills. Passionate about delivering transformation with the ability to articulate business value to stakeholders at all levels. Strong workshop design and facilitation skills. Comfortable pitching to C-suite executives, including strong objection-handling abilities.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to analyze and synthesize information. Sets a clear direction in situations where data is absent or ambiguous and stakeholders are misaligned, making defensible recommendations and holding the roadmap steady rather than only building consensus. A proactive, resourceful, creative thinker with the ability to inspire others and who can navigate dynamic situations.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce AI Research is a global leader in Enterprise AI, driving innovations that advance the state of AI while powering enterprise products at worldwide scale.

Our research has helped shape multiple generations of modern AI: we helped pioneer prompt engineering through DecaNLP; introduced BLIP, a foundational breakthrough in multimodal AI; trained state-of-the-art large language models including CodeGen; and pioneered foundation models for time series with Moirai. Today, we continue to advance the frontier of enterprise AI through innovations in AI simulation environments like eVerse, our simulation and agent-training environment; the Atlas Reasoning Engine, which powers Agentforce reasoning capabilities; and other AI systems that are redefining how enterprises reason, plan, and act.

What makes our team unique is our ability to take ideas from research to real-world impact at scale. We work closely with product teams and enterprise customers to translate cutting-edge research into production AI capabilities used by millions of users. We also continue to publish at the world's top AI conferences, open source influential research, and collaborate with leading academic institutions. Learn more at Salesforce AI Research.

We are looking for entrepreneurial Research Interns for Summer 2027 who want to help build the next generation of Enterprise AI. This is not a traditional research internship. You will work like a founder within Salesforce: exploring high-impact research directions, prototyping cutting-edge AI capabilities, and seeing how ideas are validated with customers and turned into production-ready solutions. You will have the freedom to propose and explore new ideas, alongside mentors and research scientists, with access to Salesforce's global customer and product ecosystem. We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, bring energy and focus to their work, and care as much about customer adoption as technical innovation. If you want the pace and ownership of a startup, combined with the reach and resources of Salesforce, this internship offers a unique opportunity to do research with global impact.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Collaborate with research scientists and engineers on a project focused on real-world product impact, with the opportunity to publish your work at top-tier conferences.
  • Explore research directions with the potential to transform Enterprise AI.
  • Help turn promising ideas into zero-to-one AI product prototypes.
  • Build models, agents, and AI systems for real-world enterprise use.
  • Learn how research partners with product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to bring solutions to market.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have a strong publication record at top AI venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ACL, EMNLP) and/or experience building AI research into real-world systems.
  • You have experience with Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or DeepSpeed.
  • You are motivated by real-world impact and care about seeing your research leave the lab and reach users at scale.
  • You bring expertise in one or more core focus areas:
    • Agentic AI and Reasoning: LLM-powered agents, reinforcement learning (RL), reasoning and planning, autonomous workflows, computer use agents, deep research agents, and coding agents.
    • Multimodal and Computer Vision: Vision-language models, video understanding, and multimodal AI agents.
    • Speech Intelligence: Voice intelligence, text-to-speech/automatic speech recognition, and low-latency audio processing.
    • Core Modeling and Post-Training: Pre-training and post-training techniques including RLHF and direct preference optimization, model distillation, evaluation, and time series modeling.
  • You can conduct research with guidance from mentors, and you are ready to grow toward independence and translate ideas into impactful systems.



Even Better If...

  • You are a PhD or MS candidate in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.
  • You have experience building and scaling ML models for real-world applications.
  • You have strong programming skills (competitive programming, e.g., ACM-ICPC, or open source experience).
  • You are thoughtful about responsible AI, trust, and the real-world impact of the systems you build.
  • You are a fantastic problem solver, able to tackle challenges the world hasn't solved before.
  • You have excellent written and spoken communication skills.
  • You collaborate effectively with teammates.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer’s workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems.


This is an Individual Contributor position.


Responsibilities:

Customer Accountability and Value Alignment

  • Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
  • Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle
  • Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
  • Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
  • Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
  • Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.
  • Conduct enablement sessions on opportunity and case management, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, knowledge creation, and omni-channel routing
  • Share best practices for sales and service process optimization, data quality, and customer experience

Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management

  • Drive adoption of Sales and Service Cloud features with reps, agents, managers, supervisors, and ops teams
  • Track usage metrics (opportunity updates, activity logging, forecast submissions, report usage, case resolution times, knowledge article usage, channel adoption, and CSAT scores)
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer’s business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
  • Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
  • Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
  • Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.
  • Conduct quarterly reviews of feature usage to drive adoption of tools like Journey Builder or Commerce Promotions, ensuring platform stability and performance.
  • Identify underutilization of contracted entitlements (e.g., messaging volume or GMV tiers) and align platform features with customer priorities to increase throughput.

Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management

  • AI  Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
  • Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
  • AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
  • Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
  • Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask ** effective diagnosis questions**, and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
  • Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
  • Serve as the primary interface for major incidents (e.g., checkout failures or email deliverability drops) to protect peak revenue.
  • Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
  • Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.
  • Escalate complex automation, data model, routing, or integration questions to technical resources

Required Qualifications: 

  • 5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Customer Success, SaaS platform use, or related fields. 
  • Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
  • Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer’s business.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
  • Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development

Cloud/Platform Requirements: 

  • 3-4 years experience supporting customers using Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
  • Working knowledge of core features:
    • Sales Cloud: Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Forecasting, Reports & Dashboards
    • Service Cloud: Cases, Knowledge, Queues, Service Console, Omni-Channel routing
  • Understanding of Sales (lead-to-cash, opportunity management, pipeline management) and Service (case management, escalation, SLA management) processes.
  • Familiarity with Sales Cloud automation (workflows, process builder, flows for sales processes) and Service Cloud automation (email-to-case, web-to-case, case assignment rules, macros)
  • Ability to demonstrate Lightning Sales/Service Console and mobile app
  • Knowledge of common sales (territory management, lead assignment, opportunity stages) and Services (case deflection, knowledge management, multi-channel support) use cases.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Sales Cloud Consultant and Service Cloud Consultant certifications
  • Additional Salesforce product certifications are a plus (AI Associate, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, Data 360 Specialist, Agentblazer).
  • Experience with Einstein for Sales (lead scoring, opportunity insights, activity capture) and Service (case classification, article recommendations, next base actions).
  • Understanding of how Sales Cloud integrates with marketing automation and service tools and how Service Cloud integrates with telephony, chat, messaging, and self-service portals.

The Migration Delivery Lead is an individual contributor who leads complex customer migration engagements from kickoff through successful go-live. You serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact for your migration pod — building trust with customers, coordinating with our Global Delivery Center (GDC) engineering partners, and ensuring every engagement drives real, measurable value as customers move to modern cloud architectures.

This role sits at the intersection of customer relationship management and hands-on technical execution. You'll act as a trusted advisor who bridges a customer's legacy environment with their future-state platform — accelerating timelines through automated playbooks and AI-assisted tooling, while serving as a direct feedback channel to Product and Engineering on what's working (and what isn't) in the field.

  • Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.
  • Partner with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration goals with customers' broader business strategy, renewal, and expansion objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, translating complex migration challenges into clear, actionable decisions.
  • Develop and execute focused delivery plans that prioritize high-impact milestones and hold pod-level timelines to account.
  • Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.
  • Drive adoption of AI agents and automation toolkits to accelerate discovery, data mapping, and code conversion — reducing manual effort and compressing delivery timelines.
  • Collaborate closely with GDC partners, delegating repeatable technical tasks while maintaining full accountability for output quality.
  • Work in close alignment with Outbound Product Managers to stay current on product roadmaps and translate field insights into product improvements.
  • Identify underutilized platform capabilities and incorporate them into migration roadmaps to increase customer throughput and adoption.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
  • Apply AI literacy and prompt engineering skills to guide AI agents in data retrieval, migration health reporting, and task automation.



You're Our Person If...

  • 6+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a strong focus on large-scale platform migrations.
  • Deep, hands-on domain expertise in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and navigate complex stakeholder conversations.
  • Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business-friendly language and guide customers through data transformations.
  • Proven experience working with global or offshore delivery models (such as GDC) to accelerate project delivery.
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service Cloud) or specialized clouds (Marketing, Data, Revenue, or Tableau).
  • Familiarity with AI agents or automation tools applied to data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
  • Understanding of how target cloud platforms integrate with telephony systems, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.



Even Better If...

  • Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist).
  • Prior experience as an individual contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation engagements.
  • Salesforce AI Associate or Agentblazer certifications.

You'll join a team that is shaping how Salesforce customers adopt the next generation of cloud technology — with access to cutting-edge AI tools, a collaborative global delivery model, and a direct line to the Product teams building the platforms you work with. We're building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.


Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup—backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback, without layers of approvals slowing you down.


The Role

Product Core builds the foundational product systems everything depends on: identifying prospects, scheduling and routing meetings, synchronizing data with calendars and go-to-market platforms, executing workflows, and supporting enterprise authentication. We also enable customers and partners to extend the product through public APIs, webhooks, and custom integrations. These capabilities power critical parts of the customer journey and have a meaningful impact on conversion, revenue, and customer trust.


The team also builds the data, context, and execution capabilities behind our agentic product experiences, including meeting preparation, routing investigation, and product explainability.


As an engineer on Product Core, you'll operate as a technical leader: leading complex initiatives from early design through production, shaping architecture, writing substantial production code, influencing technical direction, and helping other engineers do their best work.


What You'll Do

  • Lead complex product initiatives from an ambiguous problem through technical design, implementation, launch, and ongoing ownership
  • Build reliable meeting-booking, calendaring, routing, and workflow experiences that directly affect customer conversion and revenue
  • Build and evolve integrations with CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, collaboration, calendaring, and data-enrichment platforms
  • Build intuitive public APIs and reliable webhooks that let customers and partners extend the product
  • Design for the realities of third-party systems: API limits, OAuth credentials, inconsistent data, retries, synchronization, and partial failures
  • Advance AI-assisted capabilities such as meeting preparation, routing investigation, and explanations of product behavior
  • Improve the scalability, observability, security, and supportability of critical production systems, and own difficult customer issues to their root cause
  • Raise the engineering bar through technical leadership, design and code reviews, and mentorship

Who You Are

  • A track record of independently delivering complex SaaS capabilities from design through launch and ongoing operation
  • Strong full-stack skills, with particular depth in backend systems, APIs, relational data models, and background processing
  • Experience building or operating integrations with complex third-party platforms
  • Sound technical judgment around reliability, data integrity, security, and incremental system evolution
  • Excellent debugging skills across application, integration, and data boundaries
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: you influence architecture and execution beyond your immediate workstream
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity: you can frame problems, propose solutions, and align others
  • Product-minded: you care about UX and customer outcomes, not just implementation
  • Experience with modern web frameworks (Rails/React/Postgres/AWS is a plus; adaptability matters most)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CRM, marketing automation, scheduling, routing, enrichment, or workflow products
  • Familiarity with OAuth, webhooks, synchronization pipelines, rate-limited APIs, or eventual consistency
  • Experience with enterprise identity systems such as SSO, SAML, or SCIM
  • Experience building production AI or LLM applications, agent tooling, or explainability features

Why Join Qualified

  • Own systems that move revenue: Meeting booking, routing, and workflows sit directly in the customer conversion path. When they get better, customers win more deals.
  • Integration problems with real depth: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, sync, and partial failure: the hard, interesting problems of connecting enterprise systems at scale.

Volume of contracts managed each month tends to be around 50 ~ 100(depends on assigned territory) for Direct and Reseller’s customers in Japan, Korea and Taiwan. You own driving the renewal to completion. You partner with the account team and develop a renewals strategy for every customer. You build quotes, review contract terms, negotiate pricing, look for up-sell opportunities, and handle objections. It is also needed to plan how to improve the current operation process and manage some contractors or outsource partners who are doing renewal management for small size of contracts .

You will be measured on renewal rate, contract term length, and KSO (Key Strategic Objectives) driving specific sales goals of your renewals and ability to negotiate favorable terms.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Drive all managed renewals thoroughly in assigned territory by identify risk as early as possible as well as generating revenue growth opportunity via add-on, upsell, upgrade, price adjustment (working location is Japan Tokyo Office)
  • Achieve or exceed monthly renewal targets and provide senior management with an accurate forecast and risk analysis of all assigned accounts
  • Develop and execute win/win negotiation strategies for contract renewals that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing the customer relationship
  • Build strong working relationships across Sales and Customer Success Group Leadership
  • Closely monitor at risk accounts. Work with Customer Success, Support, and Services leadership to resolve customer issues and help remove barriers for the team
  • Serve as point of escalation for critical customer issues; provide summary of the overall ‘health’ of the account and use of our services
  • Answer customer questions and successfully negotiate issues related to renewal contracts
  • Attend and lead monthly regional calls to discuss renewal forecast, top renewals, at risk accounts (if required)
  • Managing some contractors or outsource partners to deal with high transaction volume customers.
  • Help develop and educate renewal best practices across the team
  • Maximize account growth opportunities by playing an active role on the account team and helping to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities upon contract renewal
  • Own, drive and manage the renewals process in collaboration with the account team
  • Work with internal resources (Competitive Intelligence, Pricing, Product Management, Customer Success, Account Executives, etc…) to develop comprehensive ‘win’ strategies for renewals
  • Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and demonstrate strong account management capabilities to drive renewal to on-time closure
  • Communicate risk clearly and take the lead in developing resolution strategies
  • Accurately maintain a rolling 180 day weekly forecast of renewals of your territory



You're Our Person If...

  • High-level fluency in Japanese language (speaking, reading, writing, listening)
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (TOEIC 730+ )
  • 3 years or relative experience or sales/account and/or renewal management experience from a software or SI/solution Selling industry are preferable.
  • Vast knowledge or experience of Business Application (CRM/SFA/MA experience as user/sales is preferable)
  • Fundamental understanding of Salesforce product solutions
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Considerable interpersonal skills are mandatory, including the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others
  • Strong negotiation skills that allow for value-based contract negotiations
  • Knowledge of restructuring contract term and condition relating legal, finance and billing
  • Excellent computer skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Google Apps)
  • Degree or Relevant Work Experience Preferred



Leadership Qualities

  • BEGINNERS MIND: Always learning, approaches each interaction with open mind, great listener and hands-on
  • LEADERSHIP: Self-aware and strategic thinker; proficient at building strong relationships
  • TEAM PLAYER: Proficient at collaboration and working with members of a team
  • URGENCY: Ability to move fast and drive business value and results
  • OHANA: Embodies Aloha culture: A team player that everyone enjoys working with and has a generous heart
  • TRUST: Trust the company’s core values
  • ADAPTABLE: Excels in high levels of uncertainty and change

About Salesforce
