What is a Solution Engineer?

Also known as a "Pre-Sales Engineer" or "Sales Consultant," the Solution Engineer presents our product offerings to prospects and customers, builds confidence in our technology, and helps remove technical objections throughout the sales cycle. To do this, Solution Engineers draw on their technical and sales skills to gather business requirements, develop a technical sales strategy, and configure and demonstrate solutions that deliver business value.

Specialist Solution Engineer

Are you a technically minded, curious communicator who loves turning data into clear, compelling stories? As a Specialist Solution Engineer, you'll be the subject matter expert for Tableau and its family of products, including Tableau Cloud, Tableau Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics. You'll help customers across LATAM become more data-driven by showing how a trusted, governed semantic foundation turns data into decisions. You'll work side by side with Account Executives and account-team Solution Engineers to bring the value of Analytics to every conversation.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll support the technical sales cycle for Analytics, from discovery and storytelling demos to hands-on workshops, showing customers the "why" and the "what." You'll listen closely to business and data needs, then demo how Tableau helps customers define metrics and business rules once and reuse them in governed, trusted analytics. You'll show how analytics interoperability across Tableau Cloud, Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics works, and how recent innovations such as Tableau Knowledge, Tableau Studio, and Tableau Semantics fit the customer's existing data stack. You'll also act as an evangelist for Analytics with internal teams, helping them position Tableau with confidence.

Your Impact

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand each customer's business goals and challenges throughout the sales cycle
  • Build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders by understanding their data and analytics strategy and identifying the right Tableau solution
  • Run discovery sessions and workshops with business users to define and build solution prototypes
  • Build and deliver customized demos that prove business value, including semantic models (Tableau Semantics, Published Data Sources) and analytics interoperability across Tableau Cloud, Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics
  • Present the value of Tableau clearly to business users, managers, and leaders
  • Demo and position Tableau's latest innovations, such as Tableau Knowledge and Tableau Studio, and show how they fit with the customer's existing data stack
  • Contribute technical responses to RFPs/RFIs
  • Enable the broader Solution Engineering team and adjacent teams to position Analytics within the Salesforce portfolio, through webinars, best practices, and knowledge sharing
  • Share customer feedback with the Product and GTM teams
  • Manage several customer engagements at once across LATAM, prioritizing with the sales team
  • Keep growing your expertise in Tableau, CRM Analytics, and the Salesforce platform
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel as needed


What we're looking for

We're seeking a proactive, collaborative professional with presales or technical experience in the software/IT industry or as an end user of analytics tools. You bring solid technical knowledge and hands-on expertise in data visualization/analytics or BI.

  • Experienced: 3+ years in technical pre-sales, consulting, or analytics roles, and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, or equivalent experience
  • Technically strong: Hands-on experience with Tableau, CRM Analytics, or similar BI tools (Power BI, Looker). Experience analyzing data, identifying trends, and building visualizations. Python and/or JavaScript is a plus
  • Specialized knowledge: Familiarity with data modeling, semantic layers, and data warehouse concepts. Experience building demos or proofs of concept is a plus
  • Strong communicator: Excellent verbal and written communication, and the ability to present in person and online to diverse audiences
  • Languages: English and Spanish required
  • Sales-minded: Able to support the sales team with business value articulation and product positioning
  • Creative: A mindset that looks for new ways to solve customer problems and bring fresh ideas to customers and the team
  • Organized: Strong time management to run multiple projects and sales cycles in parallel
  • Team player: Committed to team goals as well as individual ones


How you differentiate yourself

  • Salesforce certifications (Tableau Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist, CRM Analytics, Administrator)
  • Experience with semantic layers or metrics layers (Tableau Semantics, Published Data Sources, dbt, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, etc.)
  • Prior experience as a Salesforce power user or admin

  • Join our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, where you work alongside Infrastructure and Research and Development partners to keep Salesforce cloud services available for customers around the clock.
  • With Agentforce woven into every layer of our platform, you help build resilient systems that millions of customers depend on every day.
  • This role is based in Herndon, VA and is eligible for an onsite work arrangement.
  • Candidates must have an active TS/SCI with Polygraph clearance.



What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Monitor customer-facing services and respond to Severity 0 and Severity 1 incidents, leading technical reviews and contributing to root cause analyses.
  • Automate the detection and resolution of recurring production issues to reduce repetitive manual work.
  • Contribute to compliance, resiliency, and self-healing initiatives, including destructive testing and resiliency drills.
  • Partner with and mentor teammates to stay current on industry technology and drive team development.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have experience in enterprise-scale internet service engineering or support, with hands-on experience using the command line on Unix variants, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
  • You have experience with Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) networking technologies and protocols.
  • You have experience with incident management in a 24/7 environment.
  • You write scripts in Python, Go, or similar languages and have experience provisioning and operating Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure.



Even Better If...

  • You have a solid understanding of IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) service operations.
  • You have experience with configuration management tools such as Chef or Puppet, and pipeline tools such as Jenkins, Bamboo, or Spinnaker.
  • You have hands-on experience supporting and managing Kubernetes-based applications and services.
  • You hold certifications in Linux+, Red Hat, or AWS.
  • You are familiar with Agile processes and DevOps practices.



Changes to know about:

The Experience

Salesforce is looking for an experienced, dynamic Account Executive to manage Commercial Accounts in Poland. This region is part of the Emerging Markets group and is seen as a growth engine for the EMEA business unit, in essence a dynamic start up within a larger organisation.

Based from Poland, the Account Executive will be responsible for growing both a defined number of existing Commercial accounts as well as building new revenue streams through targeted new logo aspirations. This role is defined as a Core role within Salesforce to lead and take responsibility for the overall Account Management.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Assigned to medium, complex, highly visible, Strategic Accounts
  • Leads the entire sales process to ensure delivery against key performance metrics, with a strong emphasis on new business sales, while expanding existing accounts
  • Engages with prospect organisations to position Salesforce solutions through strategic value based selling, business case definition, ROI analysis, references and analyst data
  • Drives significant coordination amongst groups such as Sales Engineers, Professional Services, Executives, Partners etc. to drive account strategy
  • Accurately forecasts and achieves revenue goals



You're Our Person If...

  • Quota carrying Software or Technology sales and Account Management experience selling to Commercial organisations in Poland
  • Demonstrable track record of success, achieving/exceeding quota in recent sales positions
  • A minimum of 5 years selling into Commercial accounts
  • Preference given towards recent and successful experience in the software industry (Cloud experience would be a plus)
  • Evidence of relationship building skills with an ability to grow and nurture relationships
  • Excellent at Managing C-level and LOB relationships
  • Collaborates cross functionally internally to actualize deal strategy

Clear and structured career path into Senior and Leadership positions within the company. World - Class Training & Development in the areas of professional growth and product knowledge. Join an agile team with deep startup roots. We operate as a high-velocity ‘startup-within-Salesforce,’ following our recent acquisition. You’ll be managed by the same founders and engineers who built the original company, offering the autonomy of a small team backed by the global scale and trust of Salesforce.

We have successfully moved past the "0 to 1" phase. We have a product that works, customers who love it, and the backing of Salesforce. Now, we are entering the "1 to 100" phase: scaling our architecture to handle global demand, hardening our systems for enterprise-grade resilience, and integrating deeply with the Agentforce ecosystem. This is your chance to help lead that transition.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

As a Production Support Engineer (PMTS), you will be a senior technical member of staff within our embedded reliability team. You aren’t building the foundation alone—you’ll work alongside a group of engineers and product owners to ensure the Agentforce Operations platform is the most reliable AI-powered engine in the industry.


This is a role for an engineer who loves the "scaling" problem. You will focus on production excellence, performance tuning, and infrastructure automation. Because you are embedded in the product organization, you’ll have a seat at the table during design reviews, ensuring that as we add new agentic capabilities, they are built to scale from day one.

We want people who have a proven track record of delivering real, measurable outcomes and get excited about the prospect of getting to own and steer the direction of our technical architecture. 

  • Scaling & Reliability: Own the reliability roadmap for major product areas, working to transition our systems from startup-speed architectures to highly-available, global-scale enterprise solutions.
  • Technical Leadership: As a Principal-level member of technical staff, the team will be expecting you to provide the expert insights to help guide and steer the technical direction of our team. 
  • Mentorship: The LMTS and SMTS members of our team will be looking to provide both formal mentorship via direct engagement as well as informal mentorship via setting a high bar of technical excellence. This is not a role where you will work in a silo - close collaboration amongst the team is required and expected and it will be your job to initiate that.  
  • Infrastructure as Code: Maintain and evolve our automated environments, focusing on making our "infrastructure-as-plugins" model more robust and developer-friendly.
  • AI Operations (AIOps): Support the scaling of our AI/ML infrastructure, ensuring our models have the GPU resources and data pipelines required to deliver real-time supply chain insights.
  • Production Excellence: Lead the "1 to 100" hardening of our observability stack. You won’t just respond to incidents; you’ll build the tooling that prevents them and the telemetry that explains them.
  • Performance Engineering: Deep-dive into SQL optimization, API latency, and cross-service communication to ensure our data-intensive supply chain platform remains performant under heavy load.
  • AI-First Workflow: Lean into the future of engineering by using AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) to automate routine operational tasks and accelerate infrastructure delivery.

You're Our Person If...

  • 9+ years of experience in SRE, Production Engineering, or Backend Engineering with a heavy focus on operations and scale.
  • Proven Scaling Experience: You have previously helped take a product through a high-growth phase (the "1 to 100" journey), dealing with the technical debt and architectural shifts that come with it.
  • Effective Communicator: This is an integral role within our organization as you’ll be responsible for implementing the product vision and then communicating that reality back to a variety of stakeholders with varying degrees of technical expertise. As such, strong communication abilities are a must. 
  • Coding Mastery: You are an expert in writing production-grade code in either Golang, TypeScript, or Python—you view automation as a software engineering problem.
  • Technical Breadth: Strong proficiency in Kubernetes, Terraform/OpenTofu, and AWS/GCP/Azure.
  • Observability Expert: Demonstrated experience with properly instrumenting applications and platforms with SLO-based monitoring and alerting. 
  • Systems Expert: Deep understanding of distributed systems, including how to debug complex interactions between microservices, databases, and AI agents.
  • Low-Ego Collaboration: Experience working within a senior team of Principal engineers, capable of both leading specific initiatives and supporting the broader group’s technical vision.
  • AI Fluency: A demonstrated ability to use modern AI development tools to move faster and build more reliable systems.
  • Ownership Mentality. We are a senior team who operate with a high degree of autonomy. As a result, we’re looking for someone who can independently identify issues and own the solution all the way through final implementation.  

Even Better If...

  • M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Database Specialist: Strong experience with PostgreSQL at scale (partitioning, indexing, query tuning).
  • Distributed Systems: Advanced knowledge of microservice orchestration and durability patterns, including hands-on experience with Temporal for workflow reliability and Istio service meshes for secure, observable service-to-service communication in high-growth SaaS environments.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Tracing, profiling, monitoring, logging, dashboard creation - we’re looking for someone who has demonstrated prior results across a wide breadth of the monitoring and observability stack. Specific experience in Prometheus, Grafana, and Pagerduty is desired. 
  • Search Indexing: Prior experience with Elastisearch implementations or Typesense.
  • Salesforce Knowledge: Familiarity with Salesforce infrastructure, Hyperforce, or Data Cloud is a plus.

The Experience

Join Product Operations to own licensing and entitlements for new product launches at Salesforce. You'll turn packaging and pricing decisions into the licenses, entitlements, and selling rules that shape how customers, sellers, and operators experience our products. You'll partner with Pricing Strategy, Product Management, Engineering, Finance, and Sales Operations, and your business requirements will influence the roadmap for our provisioning systems. This is a hybrid role with three days in office each week.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Own licensing and entitlement design for launches. Define the entitlement model for each offer: which features are on, which limits apply, and how capacity is provisioned and enforced.
  • Recommend license and entitlement structures to Product and Pricing teams, tying each option back to the business outcome you want.
  • Validate license and entitlement compatibility, and make sure each one maps correctly to license containers and to SKU and product records in our CRM.
  • Keep traceability from SKU to license to entitlement to feature, so every sellable item provisions what the customer bought.
  • Partner with Engineering and Provisioning on how entitlements behave in the product, including hard vs. soft limits, overage handling, and trial-to-paid conversion.
  • Build licensing governance into the NPI process for all new launches and repackaging efforts, moving strategy and technical validation earlier. Own license and entitlement sign-off for launches.
  • Train Product Operations project leads to run baseline project-level reviews, and rebalance review work between them and this role as NPI volume changes.
  • Create operating standards, including QA checklists, configuration menu options, and use cases. Develop enablement materials that support scalable, agentic question answering for product and pricing stakeholders.
  • Close current licensing gaps. Define an ownership model for cross-cloud licensing decisions between Product and Prod Ops (including legacy products), with a clear split of responsibility between Prod Ops and the Platform team. Build an M&A licensing playbook for bringing acquired-company user licensing into our model.
  • Assess financial and operational impact. Evaluate how usage-based pricing affects ACV, bookings, revenue recognition, forecasting, and sales compensation. Work with Finance, Deal Desk, and Sales Comp so new models fit approval workflows, discounting rules, and quota crediting.
  • Assess the experience each design creates for customers (buying, provisioning, usage visibility), sellers (quoting, configuration), and internal operators (order management, support, renewals).
  • Translate technical licensing capabilities and constraints into clear business terms, covering options, tradeoffs, and recommendations. Bring feasibility issues into packaging discussions early, before launch commitments are made.
  • Write and maintain launch documentation, standards, and playbooks. Build and maintain a central licensing resource with our provisioning team that shows which tools exist, who owns what, and how licensing choices affect commercial outcomes.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 7+ years in product management, engineering, commercial operations, IT, or a similar role at a SaaS or enterprise software company, including 2+ years leading technical cross-functional programs.
  • You have experience constructing licensing or entitlements for B2B SaaS, or experience in the product and engineering development lifecycle for SaaS products.
  • You've taken new products or pricing models from packaging concept to launch as a product manager or engineer.
  • You can develop business and technical requirements that drive the product and engineering roadmap for license construction, data model enhancements, and stakeholder tooling.
  • You can read, write, and troubleshoot XML (structure, attributes, namespaces, schema validation) and catch errors in license and entitlement definitions before they reach production.
  • You use SOQL, SQL, and AI tools to query product, license, and entitlement data, find mapping gaps, and audit catalog consistency.
  • You can master the data model for licenses and entitlements and drive requirements to update it as commercial and product needs evolve.
  • You work with source control (e.g., Git) and structured engineering release processes for configuration changes.



Even Better If...

  • You're familiar with metadata-driven platforms such as Salesforce metadata and CPQ/Revenue Cloud.
  • You've set structure and standards in ambiguous environments where none existed.
  • You can go deep on license mechanics with engineers, then summarize the decision and its impact for executives in a few sentences.
  • You've driven alignment across Pricing, Product, Finance, Sales, and Engineering without direct authority.
  • You bring strong systems thinking and attention to detail, since a single mapping error can block provisioning or misstate revenue.

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today.


Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.


The Builder Leadership Experience

  • Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale.
  • AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.
  • Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.
  • Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.
  • Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.
  • Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.
  • Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.
  • Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Person If...

  • Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.
  • You Have Proven Leadership: 3+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.
  • You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.
  • You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.
  • You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Even Better If...

  • Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.

The Experience

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real-time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands-on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness.

Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real-time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You’ll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent-to-agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build.

You’ll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff.

This is a hands-on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you’re looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn’t it.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use-case requirements. Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer-scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer - RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases - that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real-time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols - including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent communication - that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs, and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling - including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers - to automate the build process and compress customers’ time to value.
  • Co-build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases - with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior - directly to Product and Support.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands-on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi-table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery - Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript - and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You’ve built retrieval systems for AI applications - vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases - and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You’ve implemented secure service-to-service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event-driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent-to-agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline-driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platfororm

Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.

Our Enterprise Business team focuses on working with our most strategic customers and organizations of 10,000+ employees. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast paced team with various customers and receive personalized training and career opportunities.


You will be aligned to the following clouds:

    • Public Sector / State Government / Selling to the Rocky Mountain territory

We're hiring a builder. This Account Executive will own Salesforce's state government business in the Rocky Mountain territory where the white space is real and the relationships are still being written.

These are lean, pragmatic states where agencies do a lot with a little, and where trust is earned in person, over time. There's no inherited book of business to coast on. You'll pick the right agencies, map the people and the money, and turn a handful of first conversations into a durable, multi-agency footprint.


You'll sit on the Public Sector team for the Rocky Mountain region, partnered closely with Solution Engineering, our partner ecosystem and an RVP who is in the field with you. If you want to look back in three years and say "I built that," this is the seat.


What you'll do:

Build the territory plan

• Own a written territory and account plan for the Rocky Mountains that ranks agencies by need, budget timing and executive sponsorship, and update it every quarter.

• Map each priority agency's org chart, budget cycle, legislative calendar and technology debt (legacy case management, mainframe systems, paper-based processes).

• Track biennial budget sessions, federal funding streams and IT modernization initiatives so your pipeline lines up with when money actually moves.

Open doors and earn trust

• Create pipeline from zero through prospecting, events, partner co-selling and relentless follow-through.

• Build relationships with agency heads, CIOs, CFOs, program directors and state IT leadership, and become the person they call when they're thinking about a problem.

• Show up in person. Travel across all three states regularly for executive meetings, site visits, government technology summits and association events.

Run disciplined, complex sales cycles

• Lead long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals from first discovery through procurement, contracting and launch.

• Navigate public sector buying paths, including cooperative contracts (e.g. NASPO ValuePoint), reseller partners and agency-specific RFPs.

• Shape solutions across Salesforce's platform, including Agentforce, Data Cloud, Service Cloud and industry solutions for Public Sector, with your SE and partners.

• Forecast accurately and keep a clean, honest pipeline in Salesforce.

Land and expand

• Turn first wins into lighthouse references, then use them to expand across agencies and toward enterprise-wide agreements.

• Work with Customer Success and partners to make sure every customer goes live and gets value, because in a small state, every reference travels.

What you bring

• 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise software sales, with at least 3 selling into state or local government.

• A record of building a territory from scratch. You can walk us through a time you started with no pipeline and a list of names, and what you built from it.

• Exceptional account planning. You think in agency org charts, budget cycles and multi-year roadmaps, and you write plans other people can actually execute against.

• Executive presence. You're credible in the room with a cabinet secretary or state CIO, you listen more than you pitch, and you can tie technology to mission outcomes like faster benefits, shorter wait times and stronger compliance.

• Perseverance. Public sector cycles run 12 to 24 months. You stay curious and consistent through stalled budgets, RFP delays and leadership turnover, and you treat "not yet" as information, not rejection.

• Public sector buying fluency, including RFPs, cooperative purchasing vehicles, reseller partners and the role of the legislature in funding.

• Partner savvy. You know how to co-sell with SIs and resellers and make them want to bring you into their accounts.

• Willingness to travel regularly across WY, ND and SD. Based in or near the territory (or the Rocky Mountain region) is preferred.

Nice to have

• Existing relationships with state agencies in WY, ND, SD or neighboring states.

• Experience selling CRM, case management or platform solutions into Health and Human Services, Labor, Revenue, Transportation or Public Safety.

• Familiarity with modernization themes like legacy mainframe replacement, federal compliance frameworks and AI adoption in government.

• Salesforce ecosystem experience, as a customer, partner or seller.

What success looks like

• First 90 days: a written territory plan, priority agencies identified, and executive meetings on the calendar in all three states.

• First 6 months: qualified pipeline across multiple agencies, with active partner co-sell motions and at least one opportunity in procurement.

• First 12 months: first lighthouse customer signed and live, a reference you can take to the next agency, and a clear path toward a multi-agency agreement.

Why this role

You'll get the autonomy of building something new with the backing of a team that has done it before in neighboring states. You'll have a leader who joins you in the field, an SE partner invested in your wins, and a front-row seat as AI changes how government serves people.


Day to Day

Our Enterprise Account Executives engage with existing customers and new leads to sell the entire Salesforce Customer 360 platform. They build positive, trusted relationships with both key team members and c-suite decision makers within their patch, and become naturals at helping customers realize value from their Salesforce investments.


You will use your skills to develop opportunities, through both warm leads and whitespace prospecting.


      • Develop key customer stakeholder relationships and drive customer satisfaction at assigned accounts
      • Develop and drive the overall long-term strategy for the account, aligned to customer business objectives
      • Coordinate internal Salesforce resources to meet customer business needs
      • Perform account planning at assigned accounts, coordinating with Prime and Cloud sales resources to ensure strategic alignment
      • Share Salesforce value proposition for existing and/or new customers

Working at Salesforce

Working at Salesforce isn’t all about selling. It’s also about learning, and we heavily invest in you with a month-long immersion and onboarding, including: a week-long product bootcamp, mentorship program, weekly coaching and development programs.


Benefits

We are pioneers of the Pledge 1% model, providing product, grants and community service to those in need. We are proud to be#1 in PEOPLE’s Top 50 Companies that Care, and are on Fortune’s Change the World list.

We provide every employee with 7 paid volunteer days off a year, and donation matching for all approved charitable donations.

The Experience


Build at enterprise scale. Launch like a founder. Start this summer.


Salesforce AI Labs is seeking exceptional emerging AI and computer science talent for our highly selective, 12-week summer internship designed to develop the next generation of AI builders.


As an AI Labs intern, you'll spend 12 weeks embedded in one of four disciplines, tackling real technical, product, or customer challenges, building with frontier AI technologies, and contributing to solutions at enterprise scale. You'll work alongside experienced researchers, engineers, product managers, and technical leaders, with access to AI-native development tools and opportunities to take meaningful ownership of your work.


Interns will be placed in one of four disciplines:

  • Build (Product Engineering): Design, build, and ship AI-powered products, developing technical expertise in production-scale engineering.
  • Shape (Product Management): Translate customer needs into product strategy, define priorities, and help shape the next generation of AI products.
  • Deliver (FDE / Builders): Work with teams developing and deploying AI solutions that solve real-world customer challenges.
  • Transform (DET / Customer Zero): Reimagine enterprise workflows and operations, leveraging AI to drive transformation at scale.

While you'll spend the summer gaining hands-on experience in one discipline, you'll also collaborate with interns across the other three disciplines on a cross-functional capstone project. Together, you'll bring engineering, product strategy, customer solutions, and enterprise transformation perspectives to a shared AI challenge, culminating in a final presentation at Demo Day.


The internship provides an opportunity to build technical depth, develop a broader understanding of the AI lifecycle, and experience how cross-functional teams bring innovative solutions to life.


This internship is designed as a feeder into the 24-month AI Labs Rotational Fellowship, where Fellows complete four six-month rotations across Build, Shape, Deliver, and Transform. Interns who demonstrate strong performance and potential may be considered for full-time opportunities in the Fellowship following graduation.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Build and Deliver AI Solutions: Spend 12 weeks embedded in one AI Labs discipline, contributing to meaningful projects that solve real technical, product, or customer challenges.
  • Work with Frontier AI: Gain hands-on experience with AI-native development tools, AI agents, and emerging technologies to accelerate experimentation, development, and problem-solving.
  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner with interns from Build, Shape, Deliver, and Transform on a cross-functional capstone project, combining different perspectives to develop an innovative AI solution.
  • Own Meaningful Work: Take ownership of assigned projects, from problem definition and experimentation through development and delivery, with guidance from experienced AI Labs leaders.
  • Present Your Work: Showcase your team's capstone project at an in-person Demo Day, presenting your solution, approach, and impact to an executive panel.
  • Learn from AI Leaders: Engage with engineering, product, FDE, and DET teams through mentorship, workshops, and cohort experiences that broaden your understanding of the AI lifecycle.

You're Our Person If...

  • Computer Science & Engineering Fundamentals: Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028. Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, software engineering, and technical problem-solving.
  • Practical Coding Experience: Experience developing software through academic projects, research, internships, or independent technical projects.
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python and experience building software, AI, or machine learning applications.
  • AI & ML Foundations: Understanding of core AI/ML concepts and experience using modern AI development tools to accelerate experimentation, development, and problem-solving.
  • Builder Mindset: Demonstrated curiosity, high ownership, and ability to solve complex problems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across disciplines and explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Even Better If...

  • Proven Build History: Portfolio evidence of building, deploying, or open-sourcing software or AI applications through projects, research, hackathons, or public repositories.
  • Applied AI Experience: Previous internship, research, or project experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, product development, or solutions architecture.

As part of this team, you will work across agent runtime, capability and skill design, evaluation infrastructure, and the systems that let agents find and act on the right data.We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer to help us build agentic experiences for product setup and configuration. You will help design a core agent framework, contribute to a growing skills ecosystem, and build the evaluation infrastructure that keeps agent behavior trustworthy as it scales. This role is based in San Francisco. You'll join a team building intelligent systems that automate the repetitive, elevate the strategic, and power better decisions at scale.What You'll Actually Be Doing 

Design and build a core agent framework that hosts many specialized capabilities, orchestrates sub tasks reliably, and integrates seamlessly into human workflows.

Define the contract for reusable agent skills, focusing on API design, versioning, and composability so many teams can build and contribute consistently.

Build evaluation infrastructure that measures agent quality even when outputs are non deterministic, and use that signal to catch regressions over time.

Help agents efficiently find the right records and context using structured queries, catalogs, and semantic search.

Build and ship high quality, production grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow, pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high quality code.

Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably.

Critically evaluate code, human or AI generated, for correctness, quality, security, and performance.

You're Our Person If... 

You have 6+ years experience designing and building large scale, distributed backend systems.

You have experience with API design, versioning, and building systems that many teams build on top of.

You have strong skills in at least one modern programming language and experience shipping production code.

You can reason clearly about ambiguous, large scale systems and communicate tradeoffs to a team.

You have a demonstrated, genuine AI first approach to engineering, using AI tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Cursor) to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty.

You have advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts, cultivating the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production ready.

You have a related technical degree.

Even Better If... 

You have experience building or working with AI agents, large language model (LLM) based systems, or evaluation infrastructure for non deterministic outputs.

You have experience with retrieval systems such as semantic search or structured data catalogs.

SENIOR SALESFORCE TECHNICAL CONSULTANT – CORE (SALES & SERVICE CLOUD)

Location: Mexico City (CDMX), Mexico

ROLE OVERVIEW
The Senior Technical Consultant – Core (Sales & Service Cloud) is a hands-on execution role within the Strategic Migration CoE / Migration Factory. The role supports end-to-end migrations and implementations from legacy CRM platforms (e.g., Siebel, Microsoft Dynamics, legacy or custom CRMs, other Salesforce orgs) to Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. Unlike the Technical Architect (who owns solution strategy and design), this role focuses on detailed technical implementation: platform configuration, declarative and programmatic development, data migration, integrations, and quality validation. You will work under the architect's guidance and in direct contact with client teams, and you will mentor junior consultants and set technical quality standards on the team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Configure and build Sales Cloud and Service Cloud components: Lead/Opportunity management, Accounts and Contacts, Products/Price Books/Quotes, Forecasting, Cases, Omni-Channel, Entitlements/Milestones, Knowledge, Service Console, and Email-to-Case/Web-to-Case.
  • Build declarative automation (Flow, Process Builder migration, validation rules, approval processes) and customizations with Apex, SOQL, and LWC, following best practices and governance limits.
  • Execute technical data migration (Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Cases, attachments, history) per the architect's blueprint, using Data Loader, Data Import Wizard, and/or ETL tools.
  • Configure security and access models: profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, and field-level security.
  • Design and configure integrations with external systems (ERP, telephony/CTI, marketing platforms) via REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, and MuleSoft.
  • Build and execute test plans (unit, integration, UAT support) and data validations ahead of cutover and go-live.
  • Perform code reviews, and mentor and guide junior consultants on best practices.
  • Document configurations, code, and technical decisions for Migration Factory playbooks and accelerators.
  • Participate in discovery workshops and client validation sessions, proactively identifying and escalating technical risks to the architect.



MUST-HAVE

  • Strong hands-on experience configuring Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud (Lead-to-Opportunity, Case management, Service Console, Omni-Channel).
  • Solid knowledge of Flow and declarative automation.
  • Advanced Apex, SOQL, and LWC (or Aura).
  • Deep understanding of the Salesforce data model, the security model, and data migration best practices for large volumes.
  • Experience with API integration (REST/SOAP) and/or middleware.
  • Experience with CRM migration or implementation projects.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce DevOps tools (Git, SFDX, CI/CD, sandboxes, and deployment strategies).



PREFERRED

  • Prior experience migrating from Siebel, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP CRM, Oracle, or other legacy CRMs.
  • Exposure to CPQ, Experience Cloud, Field Service, or Revenue Cloud.
  • Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud and Agentforce / Einstein capabilities.
  • ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, MuleSoft, Azure Data Factory).
  • Experience with telephony/CTI integrations (e.g., Service Cloud Voice).
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.



EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of Salesforce experience.
  • 3+ years working directly in Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud (ideally including at least 1 migration or full implementation project).
  • Experience collaborating on client-facing teams under the direction of an architect or technical lead.
  • Experience mentoring or guiding other consultants.



CERTIFICATIONS
Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant. Preferred: Platform Developer II, Integration Architecture Designer, Data Architect.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Dedication to time and tasks
  • Communicate Efficiently
  • Collaborate to Drive Success
  • Work well in group
  • Demonstrate Business Insight
  • Display Emotional Intelligence
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment
  • Highly motivated and results-oriented
  • Engage in Fearless Conversations
  • Manage Ambiguity
  • Solve Problems Creatively



OUR TEAM VALUES

  • TRUST: Trusts the company's core values; shows integrity, clarity, and reliability
  • TEAM PLAYER: Proficient at collaboration and working with members of a team
  • COMMUNICATOR: Speaks and writes with clarity, brevity, and purpose; explains the area of expertise clearly and confidently to others; influences and engages C-Level with authority and confidence

  • Expert-level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds.

  • Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL).

Salesforce is building the AI-powered future of enterprise software — and we need a world-class recruiter to help us win the most high-demand talent market in the industry. This is a strategic seat at the table for a recruiter who has spent their career deeply embedded in technical recruiting, with the range to run both high-volume pipelines and complex, high-touch searches for hard-to-fill roles, at a company where the bar for talent is set at the top of the market for the next generation of innovators and builders.

You’ve recruited at scale across technical and non technical disciplines — software engineering, infrastructure, product, security, marketing an more! . You understand the nuances between technical specialties and can speak credibly to them. You’ve navigated nuanced leveling conversations, complex compensation structures, and competing offers from the best companies in the world — and you’ve won. You’re equally comfortable running a high-volume req load and going deep on a single critical hire.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing...


• Own full-cycle recruiting across a mix of high-volume and specialized technical roles across Salesforce’s engineering, product, and marketing org across EMEA.

• Partner deeply with senior leaders to shape hiring strategy, define ideal candidate profiles, and influence how we compete for elite technical talent

• Build and maintain high-quality talent pipelines — proactively mapping the market and engaging passive talent before requisitions open, while efficiently managing volume across multiple open roles

• Lead complex offer negotiations, including sign-on and equity exception packages, with a clear understanding of market compensation benchmarks across top tech companies

• Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers — pushing back, advising on tradeoffs, and bringing market intelligence that sharpens decision-making

• Collaborate with sourcing partners, recruiting coordinators, and peer advisors to run an efficient, high-touch candidate experience at scale

• Contribute to team-level recruiting strategy, pipeline health reviews, and market talent intelligence initiatives


You’re Our Person If...

• 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience, with demonstrated success managing both high-volume pipelines and complex, specialized searches

• Deep experience at a top-tier tech company — where the talent bar is exceptionally high and the competition is fierce

• Proven ability to recruit across a range of technical roles and disciplines

• Strong fluency in technical concepts — enough to hold credible conversations with candidates and hiring managers about the work they’ll be doing

• Track record of building proactive talent pipelines in highly sought-after, hard-to-fill talent pools, alongside experience efficiently running high req-volume

• Experience navigating complex compensation conversations, including base, equity (RSU), sign-on, and competing offer dynamics

• Consultative, data-informed approach to recruiting — you bring market data, market intelligence, and candidate insights to every hiring manager interaction

• Strong communicator and relationship builder who earns trust quickly with both candidates and senior technical leaders


Even Better If...

• Experience recruiting for emerging or specialized technical domains (e.g., AI/ML, infrastructure, security)

About Futureforce University Recruiting

Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

Job Category

Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

TITLE: Service Management - Analyst, Global Public Sector


The Experience

Salesforce Global Public Sector is now our fastest growing industry business at scale, growing 80% year over year. We help organizations modernize their operations, strengthen trust, and deliver mission-critical outcomes with the power of the #1 AI CRM.


Behind that growth is an equally important opportunity to transform how our own Public Sector teams operate. We build secure, scalable, and compliant solutions that enable Salesforce teams across Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success to serve highly regulated customers with greater speed, confidence, and efficiency, while creating a trusted digital foundation for continued growth.


We are seeking a Service Management Analyst to help build the next generation of AI-powered engineering. Join our AI-native team as an early-career service manager to solve real production challenges, build intelligent automation and strengthen system reliability. With hands-on guidance from a senior mentor, you'll combine AI-assisted investigational skills with production support experience to grow into broader product or technical roles.


You'll investigate support cases, troubleshoot production issues and participate in support rotations—gaining firsthand insight into how complex systems work and where they can improve. Your mandate goes beyond resolving individual issues: you'll adopt and nurture AI-assisted solutions that eliminate recurring manual work and prevent problems from returning.


Your projects could include agentic case automation, trend analysis, automated access workflows, technical knowledge retrieval, log analysis and system hardening. You'll have the opportunities to own improvements from identifying the problem to measuring the result. It's a chance to learn through practical ownership, deliver meaningful improvements and build a foundation for a successful support & services career.


Must be a U.S. Citizen operating on U.S. Soil with ability to meet customer and government screening standards applicable to this role, including a Criminal Justice Information Services screening with fingerprint scan. Due to the citizenship requirement for this role, which supports U.S. federal, state, and/or local government customers, citizenship will be verified through two of the following REAL ID Act documents: U.S. Passport, Passport Card, REAL Driver's License, Global Entry Card, U.S. Government CAC/PIV.


What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Production Support & Monitoring
    • Monitor daily batch jobs, system health dashboards, and application alerts to catch and address anomalies before they impact end-users.
  • Incident & Problem Management
    • Participate in incident response and scheduled support or on-call rotations, with training and guidance appropriate to your experience.
    • Triage, troubleshoot, and document incoming production incidents (P1/P2 events), coordinate fix actions, and assist with root-cause analysis (RCA).
    • Partner with Engineering to improve code, monitoring, tests and documentation to prevent recurring incidents.
  • Application Lifecycle & Service Management
    • Track application performance metrics, maintenance windows, and compliance checks aligned with ITIL Service Operation frameworks.
    • Support to Salesforce Security mandates and best practices such as certification & token refresh, password rotation, QAR and federal audits.
  • Ticket & Request Handling
    • Manage service request fulfillment, user access coordination, and vendor-escalated support tickets within established SLAs.
    • Support Production Deployments
  • Tools & Automations
    • Build automation for recurring tasks such as access requests, case responses, log analysis, troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Develop AI agents and workflows that help classify cases, retrieve relevant knowledge and execute approved actions with appropriate safeguards.
    • Help train AI agents to stay up-to-date, improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Act as an operational touchpoint between site IT, software engineering teams, and external third-party software vendors.
  • Reporting & Documentation
    • Compile operational KPI reports, update runbooks and knowledge-base articles, and document recurring system anomalies or process gaps.

You're Our Person If...

  • A technical background, such as an MIS degree or a CS minor, with an understanding of computer systems and troubleshooting. Writing code is not required.
  • A Salesforce Platform Administrator I certification. The advanced certification can come after joining.
  • At least one internship or some industry experience
  • Willingness to work swing shifts and take PagerDuty on-call rotation
  • An ability to investigate problems using logs, error messages and system behavior.
  • Clear communication, a collaborative approach and a willingness to ask questions and learn from feedback.
  • Self-starter, willing to learn new technologies (Mulesoft, AI, Agentforce) and a Salesforce trailblazer who thrives on working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to engage with self awareness as required to avoid conflicts with customers based on personality differences and to make suggestions in a manner that is more likely to result in a desired outcome.

Even Better If...

  • Experience with sandboxes and deployments, and familiarity with Salesforce enterprise environment, SOX protocols, Change Management and Release Management standards
  • Platform or Salesforce internship experience, familiarity with PagerDuty or incident management, and basic AI literacy
  • Curiosity and a passion for helping end users discover and resolve issues, asking good questions, breaking problems down and thinking on your feet
  • Initiative, such as self-study or certifying on your own, and comfort with operational, on-call work

The Service Management Analyst serves as an individual contributor within the operations and service management team. This role monitors core applications, resolves or escalates production incidents, tracks Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and supports continuous operational improvement. You will work closely with engineering, vendor partners, and business stakeholders to ensure application stability, data integrity, smooth incident workflows and standards.


We welcome evidence of your skills from internships, coursework, personal projects, open-source contributions or professional experience. The scope and independence expected will reflect the level of the role.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

SMB Account Executive - Specialist (Evergreen) - Central Market


About the Role

Join Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, as a Specialist Account Executive focusing on the Central market. Based in our Dublin hub, you will lead the agentic era of technology, helping Central businesses transform through AI, Data, and CRM. You'll sell specialist solutions that sit at the heart of Customer 360, helping customers unify their data, deploy agentic AI, and create innovation that drives measurable business outcomes.

Key Requirements:

  • Language: Full professional fluency in German and English is mandatory.
  • Location: This is an office-based role based in Dublin, Ireland (relocation assistance included).

Relocation Support


Relocate to Dublin with Ease

We know that relocation is a big decision, which is why we walk with you every step of the way. From the moment you accept your offer to the day you arrive in Dublin, you'll have access to a full support system.

How it works:

  • Offer Acceptance: Your relocation support begins immediately.
  • Relocation Consultation: We'll connect you with our relocation experts to plan your move.
  • Moving & Settling In: We provide dedicated assistance with PPS applications, housing searches, and relocation benefits.
  • Onboarding in Dublin: You'll join your new team at our world-class Dublin campus for Day 1 orientation.

The Experience


As a Specialist Account Executive, you are the go-to expert for our specialist solutions across your dedicated Central customer set. You'll own the full sales cycle for specialist opportunities, from prospecting through close. You'll use your solution selling expertise and deep product knowledge to respond efficiently to customer needs, identify specialist-specific business potential, and build a strategic, long-term partnership with your customers.

What You'll Actually Be Doing


  • Specialist Sales Leadership: Serve as the subject-matter expert for our specialist solutions, partnering with core Account Executives across a dedicated customer set in the Central market to drive specialist-led opportunities, across a complex SMB territory spanning new logo and expansion business.
  • Strategic Growth: Drive performance against key metrics with a primary focus on pipeline generation, deal acceleration, and expansion of specialist solutions within existing and net-new accounts.
  • Solution Selling: Bring deep expertise to uncover business challenges and align tailored solutions to customer goals through a consultative approach.
  • Relationship Building: Develop trusted relationships with business and technical decision-makers through regular digital engagement, demos, and face-to-face meetings, independently identifying decision-makers and influencers.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with core AEs, Pre-sales, Business Development, Marketing and other teams to shape deal strategy, optimize the sales funnel, structure and close specialist deals, bringing in SEs and cross-functional resources as needed.

You're Our Person If...


  • Full-Cycle Sales: Proven track record of quota-carrying, tech/SaaS sales experience managing the sales cycle from prospecting through close.
  • Territory & Account Planning: Create territory & account plans to identify, qualify, and successfully close specialist-led opportunities.
  • Research & Discovery: Uncover prospect's business challenges, processes, and strategic goals.
  • Solutioning: Craft value propositions that map to customer needs, demonstrating deep understanding of specialized technology solutions.
  • Communication: Clear, effective and timely engagement across writing, speech, presentation, and tools (Slack, Zoom, Google Slides).
  • Resourcefulness: Drive results using all tools and resources available.
  • Team Selling: Align with core AEs, Pre-sales, and partners to support deals and customer success.
  • Mindset: Coachable, competitive, and motivated by ambitious goals.
  • Language: Professional fluency in German and English.

Even Better If...


  • Methodology: Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Value Selling.
  • Strategic Alliances: Ability to develop cases and lead strategic partnerships.
  • Adaptability: Thriving in a fast-paced environment.
  • Track Record: Consistently meeting or exceeding quota.

What's In It For You (Benefits & Growth)


  • Personal Wellbeing: Private health insurance, life insurance, a retirement savings plan, and a monthly wellness allowance.
  • Flexibility: Flexible time off and leave policies, plus comprehensive parental support programs.
  • Career Development: Access to world-class AI and sales training, mentorship, and a clear path for promotion within the global Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Giving Back: 7 paid volunteer days per year and donation matching for the causes you care about.
  • Perks: Employee discounts, inclusive resource groups, and a culture that celebrates Equality.

At Salesforce, we're seeking outstanding individuals to join our team as an Account Executive with a strong technical background and expertise in AI-driven process automation and orchestration. In this role, you will be pivotal in driving revenue growth, encouraging enduring client relationships and applying innovative Agentic AI technology to redefine back-office operations.

About Agentforce Operations (formerly Regrello)
As part of our Agentforce OperationsSpecialist selling team, you will act as a strategic seller and evangelist for Regrello, helping enterprises operationalize Agentforce and agentic AI at scale. You will engage organizations moving AI agents into production, positioning Regrello as the orchestration layer that turns high-value Agentforce use cases into governed, measurable, end-to-end operations.

  • Drive Agentic AI Adoption: Employ your wealth of sales knowledge to position Agentforce Operations as the key solution for scaling AI initiatives such as Agentforce, showing customers how clean process context, clear handoffs, and well-understood workflows are required to deploy agents safely and productively.
  • Deliver Value-Based Messaging: Target executive decision makers across Automation/AI, Digital Transformation, Operational Excellence, and Risk & Compliance to map process frictions directly to financial business impact.
  • Conduct comprehensive technical discovery to analyze sophisticated business problems and craft compelling Points of View that underscore the tangible value of Agentforce Operations across both business and technical users.
  • Manage Full Sales Lifecycles: Own end-to-end B2B sales processes — from pipeline generation and prospecting to qualifying and closing complex enterprise software transactions
  • Sustain Continuous Value Post-Deployment: Shift clients from an initial deployment mindset to long-term partnerships. Drive ongoing account expansion by selling further process automation capabilities to ensure realized value scales with their business.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Value Engineers, Solution Consultants, and Salesforce sales teams to deliver a unified "One Salesforce" enterprise experience.


What you should have:

  • Proven track record of selling enterprise SaaS, cloud software, or complex business process/workflow automation tools to executive buyers.
  • Strong technical selling skills including the ability to explain AI-driven process automation solutions to non-technical clients and how such solutions translate to business outcomes.
  • A proven track record of consistently surpassing sales targets within a technical sales environment, underscoring your proficiency in intricate sales processes.
  • Outstanding communication and negotiation skills honed through your experience.
